fdroid:com.filestech.sms.name: SMS Tech
fdroid:com.filestech.sms.summary: Private SMS / MMS app with voice messages, encrypted vault, biometric unlock.
fdroid:com.filestech.sms.description:
SMS Tech is an ad-free, tracker-free SMS / MMS app for Android. It replaces the stock messaging app while keeping every message on your device — no cloud, no analytics, no third-party SDK shipping your data anywhere.
 Features 
 SMS and MMS — full default-SMS-app support on Android 8 (API 26) through 15+
 Voice messages — push-to-talk recording sent as a real MMS, capped at 120 s / 280 KB so every carrier accepts it
 Encrypted vault — hide sensitive conversations behind SQLCipher, with the key wrapped in the Android Keystore. Toggle "Lock vault on leave" to re-lock it every time the app goes to background
 Decoy PIN — a second PIN that opens the app in a decoy view where the vault stays invisible and inaccessible
 Emergency mode — hold the button for 3 s to send an alert SMS to your Safety Call contacts, with a single GPS fix if you granted location; without that permission the SMS still goes out, only without coordinates. Quick access to the emergency numbers of the country your phone is connected to, and shortcuts on the lockscreen notification. The emergency numbers open in the Phone app, ready to call: Android lets only it call them directly
 Biometric unlock — fingerprint or face, with a PIN fallback you set yourself
 Contextual reply — long-press a message, pick "Reply" and your composer shows a mini-quote so the recipient sees what you are answering
 Delegated translation — long-press a message and pick "Translate" to hand the text to whichever translation app you have installed (Google Translate, DeepL, Aves Translate …) through a system Intent. No translation model is bundled, and SMS Tech itself sends nothing anywhere
 Scheduled messages — write an SMS, pick a date and time, and it is sent at that moment even if the app is closed
 OS-wide blocked numbers — at first launch, SMS Tech mirrors the system blocklist (Phone app, Samsung Messages) and retroactively deletes the conversations that match; a conversation you block moves to its own folder
 Attachment picker — Photo, Video, File, Contact card. Photos are automatically re-encoded as JPEG to fit MMS carrier caps. Tap a photo to view it in the app (zoom, animated GIFs)
 Full-text search across every conversation, with FTS4 indexing
 Export a conversation as a PDF for archival
 Encrypted local backup using a passphrase distinct from your unlock PIN
 Themes — Light / Dark / AMOLED / "Dark Tech" slate-blue accent
 English, French, German, Italian and Spanish UI
 Confirmation toggle in Settings → Send → "Confirm before send" requires a confirmation dialog before any SMS, MMS or attachment is dispatched
 Privacy 
 No analytics, no crash reporters, no third-party tracking SDK
 No network access: SMS Tech does not hold the Internet permission; Android's own MMS service carries MMS. Nothing but your messages leaves the phone
 Location and phone-call permissions serve Emergency mode only. Both are opt-in, neither is ever used in the background, and the app works without granting either
 Apache License 2.0 — source code at https://github.com/gitubpatrice/SMS-TECH
 Security model documented at https://github.com/gitubpatrice/SMS-TECH/blob/main/SECURITY.md
Project home: https://files-tech.com/sms-tech.php

fdroid:com.github.mofosyne.tagdrop.name: tagdrop
fdroid:com.github.mofosyne.tagdrop.summary: Decode data URIs in QR codes
fdroid:com.github.mofosyne.tagdrop.description:
TagDrop turns small files — text, HTML pages, images, audio, SVGs — into self-contained QR codes that work completely offline. Print one on a sticker or sheet of paper and leave it somewhere; anyone with the TagDrop app (or any QR scanner that follows tagdrop: links) can scan it and view the content immediately, with no internet connection, server, or account required.
Think of it as a digital geocache: instead of a logbook in a box, the "cache" is the QR code itself.
 What you can do with it 
 Drop a single page — encode text, an HTML page, an SVG image, or JSON into one QR code, either in-app (Create Cache) or with the web generator.
 Drop a whole "paper" — a printable sheet with a directory QR code (a paper manifest) plus one QR per file, built in-app (Create Paper) or with the web generator. Pages can link to each other with ordinary relative links, so a small static site survives being printed and scanned back in.
 Spread large content across multiple codes — split a payload too big for one QR into multiple sector codes placed along a trail. The app collects sectors in any order, reassembles and verifies them, and can recover a single missing sector from an optional parity code.
 Build trails, collections, and replies — link papers together with location hints, tag a loose set of stickers with a shared collection so they group into one card on the home screen and map, or mark a code as a reply to another to thread a conversation across drops.
 Browse offline — scanned pages render in an in-app viewer, with search and #hashtag filtering, and a hex/CBOR inspector for the curious. The Collections, History, and Map tabs let you revisit, locate, and manage everything you've found, and a single file can back up or restore it all.
 Tap instead of scan — write any TagDrop code to a blank or rewritable NFC tag, then read it back with a tap instead of the camera.
 Sign your drops — post-quantum (ML-DSA-44) Verified Authorship signing lets anyone who scans your codes recognise them as genuinely yours after the first scan (trust-on-first-use), with a ✅/⚠️/🔏 badge shown on every signed item. Back up your signing identity to a passphrase-protected file to keep the same recognisable signer across devices.
 How it works 
Every code carries a tagdrop: URI — a QDEF container of CBOR Records, Base41-encoded so it packs efficiently into a QR code's alphanumeric mode. Content can optionally be DEFLATE-compressed and split across multiple codes with parity recovery. IDs are content-addressed (SHA-256 based), so identical content always gets the same ID regardless of who created it. The full wire-format spec is browsable in-app, no internet connection required.
 Status 
V2.5 — QDEF-based wire container encoding with content split into codes plus optional parity recovery, post-quantum (ML-DSA-44) content signing with trust-on-first-use verification, paper manifests with multi-file directories and relative-link navigation, geographic trails via "related" hints, ad-hoc collections, reply threading, an in-app scanner with a live scan board, NFC tag read/write, search and #hashtag filtering, full backup/restore, a Map tab for located finds, and remote drop-source feeds that pre-populate the map with community drops before you scan them.

fdroid:com.hackerapps.c2k.name: C2K — Couch to 5K & 10K
fdroid:com.hackerapps.c2k.summary: Offline Couch to 5K & 10K trainer with voice cues. No ads, no tracking.
fdroid:com.hackerapps.c2k.description:
C2K is an offline running trainer that guides you from the couch to running 5K, 10K, and beyond. Follow a clear plan, hear hands-free coaching, and keep your progress private — with no ads and no tracking.
Programs:
• Pre-C25K — 3-week gentle starter for absolute beginners
• Couch to 5K (C25K) — 9-week program, 3 runs per week
• Couch to 10K (C210K) — 14-week program, continues from C25K
• Bridge to 10K (B210K) — 6-week bridge for C25K graduates
• One Hour Runner — 13-week progression from 30 to 60 minutes continuous running
• 5K Improver — 8-week speed and stamina program for runners who can already complete 5K
Features:
• Audible voice prompts — "Start running", "Walk for 90 seconds", countdown warnings
• Customizable coaching — adjust voice speed/volume, countdown warning timing, and mid-interval cues
• Test voice playback before a workout, with Android text-to-speech diagnostics
• Vibration cues as an alternative or addition to voice
• Smartwatch and fitness band alerts — interval changes arrive as notifications, so a paired Wear OS watch or Gadgetbridge band buzzes too. No watch app needed.
• Tones mode — short chimes instead of a voice for interval changes and countdowns
• Adjustable vibration strength and language selection
• Background workout timer — continues with screen off
• GPS tracking (optional) — records distance and pace; works without GPS too
• Treadmill mode — indoor runs without GPS
• Skip the warm-up or cool-down — in Settings, or with one tap during a workout
• Workout history — weekly streak, session log, totals, best pace, longest run and calorie estimates
• Progress tracking — remembers which weeks and days you've completed, with the option to reset
• Step back when it's tough — stop the same workout early twice and C2K suggests repeating the week before
• In-app running guide — FAQ covering pacing, gear, and terminology
• Available in 8 languages — English, German, Spanish, French, Galician, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Turkish
• Works offline — no internet permission required
• No proprietary services required — compatible with GrapheneOS and privacy-focused devices
Permissions:
• FOREGROUND_SERVICE (health, location) — keeps the workout timer running with the screen off
• ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION — Android requires it for a fitness timer that runs in the background; C2K reads no sensor data, and workouts still start if you decline
• ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION / ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION — optional GPS distance and pace, only asked for workouts that use GPS
• POST_NOTIFICATIONS — the workout notification with pause and stop, and smartwatch alerts
• REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS — offers to exempt C2K from battery saving so it can't end a workout mid-run
• WAKE_LOCK — prevents the CPU sleeping mid-workout
• VIBRATE — optional vibration cues during workouts
C2K is free software released under the GNU General Public License v3.

fdroid:com.hwanderer.entropysdefiance.name: Entropy's Defiance
fdroid:com.hwanderer.entropysdefiance.summary: Calendar-first minimalist launcher: your agenda, and traces left for later.
fdroid:com.hwanderer.entropysdefiance.description:
Entropy's Defiance is a minimalist Android launcher built around your calendar. The home
screen is your agenda: today, then the days ahead, straight from the calendars you already
keep. There is no separate task database, so everything syncs wherever your calendar
syncs: DAVx5 or any CalDAV server, Google, or a local calendar.
Next to your events live your traces : anything you take out of your head to keep —
a task, an idea, a note, something not to forget. Traces live in one calendar of your
choosing, whatever it is called. Leave one with + and a horizon — Today ,
 This Week , This Month , This Year or This Life — meaning "not
relevant before then", and it stays out of sight until its day comes. A trace left undone
is carried onto today and marked in red, until you move it or mark it done.
 Features 
* Home screen agenda with "in 20 min" and "10 min left" hints and a progress line for what is under way
* Traces shown with a ring and kept together within each day, events with a bar
* Swipe an entry right to move it: +1h, +1d, +1w, next free slot, today, or a later horizon
* Long-press for Done and Edit, plus Focus and Navigate where they apply
* Long-press the date for a list of all traces by horizon
* Focus: Do Not Disturb until an event ends, restoring your previous setting
* Every change can be undone for a few seconds before it is written
* App drawer with your most-used apps first and instant search; hide and rename apps
* Accent colour from Material You, a preset, or your own; left-handed mode; fullscreen; adjustable wallpaper dim
* Upgrading from 3.x: open tasks from the old task file can be brought into your trace calendar
 Permissions 
* Query all packages — needed to list installed apps in the drawer
* Read and write calendar — to show your events and traces and change them when you ask
* Do Not Disturb access — only used for Focus, granted in system settings
* Exact alarms — to end Focus on time
* Set wallpaper — used by the launcher to restore your wallpaper
* Request package deletion — lets the drawer's Uninstall open the system dialog
The app is offline, has no internet permission, and contains no trackers, no analytics,
and no ads. Source code is published under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at
https://gitlab.com/hwanderer/entropysdefiance.
If you'd like to support development:
https://buymeacoffee.com/hwanderer

fdroid:com.rouf.freeview.name: FreeView
fdroid:com.rouf.freeview.summary: Read Medium articles for free through your choice of reader service
fdroid:com.rouf.freeview.description:
FreeView is a lightweight, ad-free reader for Medium articles. Share a Medium link to FreeView (or paste it into the app) and it opens the full article through the free reader service of your choice - no browser clutter and no login.
 Features 
 Multiple reader services: Read-Medium, Freedium, Archive.today, Archive.is, and a Medium parser vercel app
 Open a link by sharing it from any app, pasting it into the in-app address bar, or tapping a medium.com link and choosing FreeView
 Optional reading history - keep your last 20, 50, or 100 articles and reopen them with a tap
 Multi-select in the history list (long-press) to delete entries
 Settings for the reader service, theme (light / dark / system), and article text size
 Clean Material 3 interface with a collapsing top bar and full light and dark support
 How it works 
 Pick a reader service in Settings. Share or paste a Medium link - or tap a link and choose FreeView - and it rewrites the link for that service and loads the article. You can switch services any time and revisit past reads from History or your saved Bookmarks. Tapping works for Medium articles on any domain (medium.com and custom publication domains alike); FreeView is offered for web links in the system "Open with" chooser.
 Note 
 FreeView is not affiliated with Medium or any of the reader services it opens. It hosts, scrapes, and modifies nothing - it only opens publicly available pages in a WebView. Those services are third-party and outside FreeView's control.

fdroid:dev.marchello.sharik.name: Sharik - file sharing via WI-FI
fdroid:dev.marchello.sharik.summary: An open-source, cross-platform solution for sharing files within a local network
fdroid:dev.marchello.sharik.description:
Sharik is an open-source, cross-platform solution for sharing files via Wi-Fi or Mobile Hotspot.
This app allows you to easily send photos, apps, files, text, literally anything, to any kind of device connected to the same network. It's convenient and blazing fast.
After selecting a language and going through the intro, you can see the sharing buttons and the history of files you shared on the main screen. You can share images, files, installed apps, or simply text. After selecting the file, you will be shown the Sharing screen. Here you can see your connectivity status (Wi-Fi/Mobile Hotspot) and the URL you need to open on the other device. After typing this URL in the browser and hitting Enter on the other machine, the file will start downloading. Please make sure that both devices are connected to the same network.
If you have Sharik installed on both devices, you can simply click the button "Receive" on the bottom panel of the app. After clicking, the Receiver screen will be shown. If Sharik detects another device sharing a file in your local network, it will be displayed. If you click on it, the browser will appear, and the download will start.
Sharik is entirely free to use, and it contains no ads. Moreover, its source code is published on GitHub so that everyone can contribute to the development process. So, if you like it, please leave a star on our GitHub repository, and consider contributing: add a new language or help us with code.
Sharik was built using Flutter. It is published under an open license (MIT).
YOU CAN SEND:
1. Photos (jpg, png, gif, etc)
2. Applications (apk)
3. Files (zip, rar, 7z, pdf, etc)
4. Text

fdroid:io.github.deprec8.enigmadroid.name: EnigmaDroid
fdroid:io.github.deprec8.enigmadroid.summary: The smartest Enigma2 companion for Android.
fdroid:io.github.deprec8.enigmadroid.description:
EnigmaDroid is a modern, user-friendly app that lets you control your Enigma2-based satellite or cable set-top box directly from your Android device.
Everywhere in your home, EnigmaDroid gives you full access to your receiver’s features and content.
 Features 
 Channel & Bouquet List : Quickly navigate your full channel lineup and favorite bouquets.
 Timer Management : Add, remove or edit timers and scheduled recordings.
 Stream Recordings : Browse and play your saved shows and movies.
 EPG Support : View Electronic Program Guide data with detailed show info for every bouquet.
 Remote Control : Full on-screen remote control with keypad.
 Live TV Streaming : Watch live broadcasts from your Enigma2 box on your device using a compatible video player.
 Search & Filter : Find channels or programs with built-in search functionality on every page.
 Multi-Box Support : Connect to multiple receivers and switch between them with ease.
 Streaming 
 EnigmaDroid currently uses external media players for streaming live TV and recordings.
 VLC is recommended, though other media players may also work.
 Requirements 
 An Enigma2-based set-top box (satellite or cable).
 Up-to-date OpenWebif plugin enabled and configured.
 Compatibility 
Tested with popular Enigma2 images.
Some images, like VTi , may require manually updating the OpenWebif plugin to ensure full compatibility.
 Free & Open Source 
EnigmaDroid is fully open-source, respects your privacy and contains no ads or trackers. Contributions and feature requests are welcome on the project's GitHub repository.

fdroid:io.github.wildebeast2521.kalimory.name: Kalimory
fdroid:io.github.wildebeast2521.kalimory.summary: Calm, offline bodyweight training with guided workouts and progressions
fdroid:io.github.wildebeast2521.kalimory.description:
Kalimory plans your bodyweight training, runs it with you, and remembers every set. There is no account, and nothing goes online: your workouts stay on your phone.
 Today 
• This week at a glance, what is due, and a suggestion for what to train next
• Start any workout from one button
 Guided workouts 
• Rep counting, hold timers and rest timers that keep going with the screen off
• Programs of several exercises, which you can pause and resume later
• Interval routines with timed work and rest
• Log past workouts, with several exercises in one session
 157 steps in 29 progression chains 
• From the wall push-up to the planche, the dead hang to the front lever, and the assisted squat to the pistol squat
• Every step has form cues, a muscle map, the equipment it needs, and clear standards to start and to move on
• Skills such as the muscle-up and the human flag show the steps they build on
• Nothing is locked: train any step whenever you like
 Progressions 
• For each chain you follow: your current step, how close you are to moving on, and the dates you started and met each step
 Progress 
• Calendar, lists, graphs, personal bests and a weekly goal
 Your data, your files 
• Complete JSON backups, CSV import and export, and recovery files if the database is ever damaged
 Calm by design 
• Light, dark and true-black AMOLED themes, optional wallpaper colours, and ten languages
 Privacy 
• No internet permission, no ads, no analytics and no crash reporting
Kalimory began as a fork of Calisthenics Memory by Gonbei774 and is free software under the GPL-3.0.

fdroid:org.mozilla.fennec_fdroid.name: Fennec F-Droid
fdroid:org.mozilla.fennec_fdroid.description:

apple-macos:866773894.name: Quiver - take better notes
apple-macos:866773894.description:
Quiver is a notebook built for programmers. It lets you easily mix text, code, Markdown and LaTeX within one note, edit code with an awesome code editor, live preview Markdown and LaTeX, and find any note instantly via the full-text search.
# Mix Text, Code, Markdown and LaTeX
A note in Quiver is comprised of cells --- snippets of text, code, Markdown, LaTeX (via MathJax) or diagrams (sequence diagram, flowchart). You can freely mix different cell types within one note. You can set different languages for different code cells, too.
# An Awesome Code Editor
The programmer's notebook should make code editing effortless. Quiver packs the awesome ACE code editor in code cells, with syntax highlighting support for more than 120 languages, over 20 themes, automatic indent and outdent, and much more.
# Markdown Support
Quiver lets you write in Markdown with inline formatting and custom CSS options. A live preview window renders Markdown as you type.
# LaTeX Support
Quiver uses MathJax to typeset mathematical equations written in LaTeX. Please note that MathJax doesn't provide a full LaTeX environment. Only math-mode macros are supported.
# Images, Files and Links
Drag an image into a text cell and it will be saved locally with the note. Drag a file into a text cell and it will become a clickable file link. URLs in text cells are automatically detected.
# Instant Full-Text Search
Notes are only useful if you can find them quickly. Quiver's full-text search is based on Search Kit, the same technology used to power Spotlight on your mac. That's how Quiver can search through thousands of notes in a blink of an eye.
# Beautiful, Fully Customizable Themes
Quiver comes with several beautifully designed UI themes, and they are fully customizable.
# Live Preview
Quiver supports live preview of Markdown and LaTeX cells.
# Presentation Mode
Quiver provides a full-screen presentation mode for your notes. This is great for classroom use, team meetings, presentations, as well as reviewing notes on your own.
# Tags
Quiver has tagging support. You can assign multiple tags to a note or assign a tag to multiple notes at once. Combined with notebooks and linked notes, you have many different ways to organize your notes.
# Autosave
Quiver automatically saves all your changes as you work, so you never need to worry about losing changes.
# Plain JSON Data Format
Quiver saves all your data in plain JSON files. These data files reside on your local machine. You can easily export your notes in different format such as HTML and PDF.
# Cloud Syncing
Quiver lets you sync all your notes across multiple computers via Dropbox, iCloud Drive, Google Drive, or any other file-based cloud services.
# Team Collaboration
It’s easy to collaborate in Quiver. You can create a shared notebook so everyone on your team can view or edit notes in the notebook. This is a great way to build a shared knowledge base for the team.
# Version Control
Since Quiver stores all the data in plain JSON files, it’s easy to put the whole library (or a specific notebook) under version control. This is another way to collaborate with your team.
# Backup and Recovery
Quiver lets you back up your entire library with a single click. Restoring your library from a backup is just as easy.
# Integrations
Quiver doesn’t lock you in. It stores data in a well-documented plain JSON format. So it’s easy to write scripts to integrate Quiver notes with other tools you use. Common scripts are provided on the Quiver documentation site.
# Tutorials and Documentation
Quiver comes with in-app tutorials and a comprehensive online wiki. Anyone can contribute to the wiki and make it better.

debian-packages:fsarchiver.name: fsarchiver
debian-packages:fsarchiver.description:
FSArchiver is a system tool that allows you to save the contents of a
file system to a compressed archive file. The file system can be restored
on a partition which has a different size and it can be restored on a
different file system.
Unlike tar/dar, FSArchiver also creates the file system when it extracts
the data to partitions.
Everything is checksummed in the archive in order to protect the data. If
the archive is corrupt, you just lose the current file, not the whole archive.
 Tags :
 System Administration: 
 Backup and Restoration , 
 Data Recovery , 
 Implemented in:

 interface::commandline, 
 Role: 
 Program , 
 Scope:

flathub:im.fluffychat.Fluffychat.name: FluffyChat Matrix Messenger
flathub:im.fluffychat.Fluffychat.description:
The open-source, non-profit European alternative to big tech’s messaging and video-call monopoly.
 End-to-end encrypted, decentralized, and easy to use for everyone.
 Messaging how it should be
 Whether for your friends, your company or local community, FluffyChat supports a variety of
 features to cover all your daily needs.
 Easy to use
 Simply install, log in and start chatting. The intuitive user interface makes secure communication
 as easy as possible.
 Secure
 With olm/megolm end-to-end encryption, encrypted message backups and an automated key trust
 system, FluffyChat is among the most secure messengers available.
 Decentral
 Based on the open Matrix protocol we build a decentralized messaging network together, which
 no entity can control. Host your own chat server while remaining in contact with everyone.
 Feature rich and reliable
 From public chats with tens of thousands of participants and polls to custom stickers, spaces,
 rich moderation tools, and multi-device support, FluffyChat delivers a comprehensive communication
 suite.
 Secure video calls
 Direct calls and video conferences, fully secured with Matrix RTC-compatible encryption.
 Not another walled garden
 We do not build another walled garden! FluffyChat is fully compatible with any other Matrix
 client like Element, Nheko, Cinny or NeoChat. Learn more at matrix.org.
 Made by volunteers
 FluffyChat is a non-profit project based on open standards and driven entirely by volunteers.
 Infrastructure is funded by donations, and participation is open to everyone.

flathub:org.gnome.Calculator.name: Calculator
flathub:org.gnome.Calculator.summary: Perform arithmetic, scientific or financial calculations
flathub:org.gnome.Calculator.description:
Calculator is an application that solves mathematical equations.
 Though it at first appears to be a simple calculator with only basic
 arithmetic operations, you can switch into Advanced, Financial, or
 Programming mode to find a surprising set of capabilities.
 The Advanced calculator supports many operations, including:
 logarithms, factorials, trigonometric and hyperbolic functions,
 modulus division, complex numbers, random number generation and prime
 factorization.
 Financial mode supports several computations, including periodic interest
 rate, present and future value, double declining and straight line
 depreciation, and many others.
 Programming mode supports calculations using common bases (binary, octal,
 decimal, and hexadecimal), bitwise operations, two’s complement,
 character to character code conversion, and more.
 Conversion mode supports conversions between common units, currencies and
 number bases.

flathub:org.nongnu.enigma.name: Enigma

 to stop you from your goal. You need dexterity, intelligence, patience, and curiosity to succeed.
 Enigma features over 1000 levels with ever new objects, problems, and challenges.

fedora-packages:daemonize/daemonize.name: daemonize
fedora-packages:daemonize/daemonize.summary: Run a command as a Unix daemon
fedora-packages:daemonize/daemonize.description: daemonize runs a command as a Unix daemon. As defined in W. Richard Stevens' 1990 book, Unix Network Programming (Addison-Wesley, 1990), a daemon is "a process that executes 'in the background' (i.e., without an associated terminal or login shell) either waiting for some event to occur, or waiting to perform some specified task on a periodic basis." Upon startup, a typical daemon program will: - Close all open file descriptors (especially standard input, standard output and standard error) - Change its working directory to the root filesystem, to ensure that it doesn’t tie up another filesystem and prevent it from being unmounted - Reset its umask value - Run in the background (i.e., fork) - Disassociate from its process group (usually a shell), to insulate itself from signals (such as HUP) sent to the process group - Ignore all terminal I/O signals - Disassociate from the control terminal (and take steps not to reacquire one) - Handle any SIGCLD signals Most programs that are designed to be run as daemons do that work for themselves. However, you’ll occasionally run across one that does not. When you must run a daemon program that does not properly make itself into a true Unix daemon, you can use daemonize to force it to run as a true daemon.

fedora-packages:dieharder/dieharder.name: dieharder
fedora-packages:dieharder/dieharder.summary: Random number generator tester and timer
fedora-packages:dieharder/dieharder.description: dieharder is a fairly involved random number/uniform deviate generator tester. It can either test any of its many pre-built and linked generators (basically all of those in the Gnu Scientific Library plus some others) or a potentially random data-set in a file. With file input, it can manage either a variety of ASCII-formatted input or a raw binary bit string. It is thus suitable for use in testing both software RNG's and hardware RNG's. dieharder does all of its work with a standalone, extensible library, libdieharder. Therefore its tests can be integrated into other programs. dieharder encapsulates following random number tests: George Marsaglia's "Diehard" battery of tests, STS (v1.6) from NIST FIPS, Knuth's tests, and more. Check the documentation for complete list of the tests and references where possible. It is intended to be the "Swiss army knife of random number testers", or "the last suite of random number testers you'll ever wear".

fedora-packages:dislocker/dislocker.name: dislocker
fedora-packages:dislocker/dislocker.summary: Utility to access BitLocker encrypted volumes
fedora-packages:dislocker/dislocker.description: Dislocker has been designed to read BitLocker encrypted partitions ("drives") under a Linux system. The driver has the capability to read/write partitions encrypted using Microsoft Windows Vista, 7, 8, 8.1 and 10 (AES-CBC, AES-XTS, 128 or 256 bits, with or without the Elephant diffuser, encrypted partitions); BitLocker-To-Go encrypted partitions (USB/FAT32 partitions). The file name where the BitLocker encrypted partition will be decrypted needs to be given. This may take a long time, depending on the size of the encrypted partition. But afterward, once the partition is decrypted, the access to the NTFS partition will be faster than with FUSE. Another thing to think about is the size of the disk (same size as the volume that is tried to be decrypted). Nevertheless, once the partition is decrypted, the file can be mounted as any NTFS partition and won't have any link to the original BitLocker partition.

fedora-packages:ghc-filepath-bytestring/.name: ghc-filepath-bytestring

fedora-packages:ghc-filepath-bytestring/.description: This package provides functionality for manipulating 'RawFilePath' values. It can be used as a drop in replacement for the filepath library to get the benefits of using ByteStrings. It provides three modules: * "System.FilePath.Posix.ByteString" manipulates POSIX/Linux style 'RawFilePath' values (with '/' as the path separator). * "System.FilePath.Windows.ByteString" manipulates Windows style 'RawFilePath' values (with either '\' or '/' as the path separator, and deals with drives). * "System.FilePath.ByteString" is an alias for the module appropriate to your platform. All three modules provide the same API, and the same documentation (calling out differences in the different variants). This package is now deprecated, since filepath 1.4.100.0 provides an OsPath type that is based on a bytestring. See https://hasufell.github.io/posts/2022-06-29-fixing-haskell-filepaths.html.

The 'Text' type represents Unicode character strings, in a time and space-efficient manner. This package provides text processing capabilities that are optimized for performance critical use, both in terms of large data quantities and high speed. The 'Text' type provides character-encoding, type-safe case conversion via whole-string case conversion functions (see "Data.Text"). firefox-addons:747733.summary: Easily block websites of your choice!
firefox-addons:747733.description:
Block Site is a browser addon to help you block desired websites. To operate, simply right-click on any webpage and then click on the "Block this website" context-menu item. The website will be added to the block list. Please note, the whole domain will be added to the block list, not just a URL. To change this list, open the options page, and remove the desired item.
For any blocked domain, you can add a redirect URL in the options page. So instead of blocking a page, the website will be redirected to the desired URL. There is also an option to block desired iframes. To do so, please add the URL (for the iframe) in the designated area on the options page.
Note: to report bugs, please visit addon homepage and fill the bug report form.
Review on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z_lZVfd4N3I

firefox-addons:998681.name: Translator
firefox-addons:998681.summary: Easy-to-use and powerful translator for your browser.
firefox-addons:998681.description:
Translator is a simple, yet powerful addon for your browser that let you easily translate words or sentences to your desired language.
Before using the addon please make sure to visit addon's option page and adjust the destination language (preferred translation language). By default, destination language is set to English. You can also choose desired button types. For in-page translation, you can choose to have context-menu or activator button. Once changes are done, please click on the - save changes - button.
In order to work with this addon, please double click on any word within the page, then, click on the activator icon and wait for the translation popup to appear. Within the translation popup there is an speaker button. Please click on the speaker button if you want to hear the pronunciation. 
If you want to the save the word and definition to the phrasebook, please click on the start button on the right side. Moreover, you can see your phrasebook by clicking on the phrasebook button at the top.
Please read FAQ page for this addon to get more info on how to work with this addon.

 WHY PEOPLE USE RABBLE

You could write notes as long as you open new tab, without pressing buttons, selecting categories or tags. Let's come back to the only goal -- write notes.
Features:
* Easy-to-use: Just open new tab, and write down thoughts.
* Manage-less: There is only one note: your new tab.
* Auto-save: No worries about saving things when writing.
* Theme: Support light and dark theme.
* Lightweight and fast: Just try and enjoy it.
* Open-source: The source code of this add-on is at Github: https://github.com/wildskyf/tab-notes 
More information, just go to my blog: Tab Notes intro . (but this article is written in Chinese, I will translate it to English soon.)

firefox-addons:2980594.name: Theme Toggle
firefox-addons:2980594.summary: Tiny extension that toggles the browser's color scheme between Light and Dark mode with a single click on the icon in the toolbar. Any website that respects `prefers-color-scheme` or `light-dark()` will instantly switch its appearance.
firefox-addons:2980594.description:
Making the button visible on the toolbar
If your browser is set to "never remember history" (permanent private browsing), the extension won't appear in the toolbar by default. To fix this:
 Go to about:addons and find the entry for this extension.
 Set Run in Private Windows to Allow .
Then pin the button to your toolbar:
 Click the puzzle piece icon (Extensions menu) in the toolbar.
 Find this extension and click the gear icon next to it.
 Select Pin to Toolbar .

bluejetty:00182699:ios.description:
Dynamic 2D Roguelike with Action-RPG elements.
Raid endless dungeons, rebuild your Fortress, and develop your own heroes!
Pocket Rogues combines the classic feel of old-school Action RPGs with the challenge and replayability of the Roguelike genre. Fight through hordes of monsters, explore procedurally generated dungeons, upgrade your guild fortress, and develop powerful heroes as you uncover the secrets hidden deep underground.
=== FEATURES: ===
• REAL-TIME ACTION
Move, dodge, avoid traps, outmaneuver enemies, and fight in a combat system that rewards control, timing, and player skill.
• DIVERSE HERO CLASSES
Choose from a variety of heroes, each with unique skills, exclusive equipment, and their own progression paths.
• EVERY DUNGEON IS UNIQUE
Locations, monsters, loot, and encounters are procedurally generated, making every run different.
• UNIQUE LOCATIONS
Each location features its own visual style, enemies, traps, and interactive objects. Once unlocked, you can freely travel between them.
• BUILD YOUR GUILD FORTRESS
Construct and upgrade buildings to unlock new hero classes, strengthen existing ones, and gain access to new mechanics and features.
• REGULAR UPDATES
Pocket Rogues is actively supported and continuously expanded in close contact with its community.
Pocket Rogues features dozens of dungeons filled with unique loot, dangerous enemies, and powerful bosses. Traditional RPG elements such as character progression, equipment upgrades, and world exploration add even more depth to each adventure.
“For centuries, a dark dungeon has lured adventurers with its secrets and treasures. One after another, they vanished in its depths after facing the true evil hidden below. Yet the old legends continue to tempt new seekers of glory and fortune. Will you become one of them?”
ULTIMATE version of Pocket Rogues is already available:
https://itunes.apple.com/app/pocket-rogues-ultimate/id1316150324?mt=8
Discord (Eng): https://discord.gg/nkmyx6JyYZ
For any questions, contact the developer directly: ethergaminginc@gmail.com

bluejetty:00177783:ios.summary: Blast your way through Gordon Ramsay's new puzzle game! Tap matching cubes to blast them to smithereens and cook up a storm! Customize your kitchen as you progress through the game, earn game cash by completing levels and spend it to renova
bluejetty:00177783:ios.description:
Blast your way through Gordon Ramsay's new puzzle game! Tap matching cubes to blast them to smithereens and cook up a storm! Customize your kitchen as you progress through the game, earn game cash by completing levels and spend it to renovate your kitchen.
Master your cube-crushing skills to impress Gordon Ramsay and become a top chef through mouth-watering levels! Find the smartest way to solve puzzles, crack high scores, and earn three stars.
Blast fast using the Win Streak and climb the leaderboard to claim the title of Culinary Genius!
Turn a kitchen nightmare into your dream kitchen as you solve puzzles and progress through levels with Gordon!
Choose from 200+ upgrades across unique themes to customize all aspects of your kitchen. Complete a theme or mix and match upgrades as you design and decorate a unique in-app kitchen. Earn game cash for completing levels and spend it on kitchen upgrades and customizations.
Compete in new weekly events, including Baking Bingo, a fun free bingo game:
BAKING BINGO: Feeling lucky, Chef? Give Gordon’s Baking Bingo a spin and win big prizes. Bake cupcakes and match them to your customer’s order to unlock fantastic rewards in this fun, free bingo game.
HOT STOVE LEAGUE: Join Chef Ramsay on his new cooking show! Compete against other chefs by solving levels in as few attempts as possible and top the leaderboard to win tasty treats!
MARKET DAY: Blast blocks marked with Gordon’s seal of approval to collect stickers and exchange them at the market for amazing prizes.
Build up an amazing Recipe Book featuring exclusive Gordon Ramsay dishes, including an exclusive holiday recipe - available only in Chef Blast - along with some of Gordon’s personal all-time favorites.
Chop, slice, cook, and bake your way through the tastiest game around!
Features:
BECOME THE MASTER - Learn from Gordon Ramsay and become a master chef!
PLAY LUSCIOUS LEVELS - With more added every two weeks!
CUSTOMIZE YOUR KITCHEN - Personalize your kitchen as you progress through levels!
DISHES TO DELIGHT - Master those appetizing recipes in your quest to conquer the kitchen!
BEEFY BOOSTERS - Unlock those boosters and access more levels!
TEASE YOUR BRAIN - With challenging & strategic gameplay!
EXCLUSIVE RECIPES – Discover new, exclusive recipes by star chef Gordon Ramsay along with some of his all-time favorites!
TEAM UP - With friends and other players to send and receive lives!
TOP THE LEADERBOARDS - Compete with other players and teams to become the best in the Chef Blast world!
PICK UP AND PLAY - Anytime, anyplace, even offline!

Manage your Prospera Credit Union accounts easily and scurely from anywhere at anytime, using the Prospera CU Mobile Banking App. Whether you want to check your account balance, view your account info, or make and edit payments – you can do it all from your mobile device!
Dashboard – Review recent transactions, balances and personalized recommendations. Manage all of your Prospera Credit Union accounts in one easy to view dashboard. View available funds, the progress of savings goals, upcoming payments, how much you’ve deposited, and personal recommendations all in one simple and easy to read screen.
Accounts – View funds, deposits, current loans, and upcoming payments. View and manage all of your cash accounts digitally. Review recent transactions, see current balances, and search for specific payments or deposits.
Bill Pay - Set up automatic payments, schedule one-time payments, juggle payees, view your billing history, and more, from any device at any time. Schedule or manually make payments on your bills through our easy-to-use bill pay system.
Fund Transfers - Send funds to and from your connected accounts

bluejetty:00125895:ios.name: Railroad Ink Challenge
bluejetty:00125895:ios.summary: In Railroad Ink Challenge, you have 7 rounds to make as many points as possible. Roll the dice and draw the routes to connect the exits around your board. Expand your network with railways, highways, and stations to collect points, but you
bluejetty:00125895:ios.description:
In Railroad Ink Challenge, you have 7 rounds to make as many points as possible. Roll the dice and draw the routes to connect the exits around your board. Expand your network with railways, highways, and stations to collect points, but you will be penalized for any open connections, so plan carefully! Play solo to improve your best score, or challenge players from all over the world!
HOW TO PLAY
Each round you will have to roll the dice and use the available routes to build your transportation network and connect as many exits as possible. Expand your network to collect points. You’ll also score bonus points for your longest highway and railway, for building into the central spaces of your map, and for completing optional, time-dependent goals before they expire.
You can also connect special structures to your network to trigger their special effects, such as duplicating routes, unlocking powerful special routes, and more. But beware: Try to not leave any open connections, as each one will cost you points at the end of the game.
EXPANSIONS
Forest and Desert expansions add special dice and rules to create even more intricate landscapes for your highways and railways.
MODES
Play solo with random objectives and join the online rankings or challenge players from all over the world with custom game configurations! The online leaderboards (Daily, Monthly, and All-Time) are completely cross-platform!
• The wonderful art of the roll and write game by Marta Tranquilli, fleshed out and digitally enhanced
• Network planning gameplay: try to make the best use of the available routes each round to create the perfect transportation network
• Try to conquer the top of the online leaderboards (Daily, Monthly, and All-Time)!
• Cross-platform, asynchronous multiplayer challenges with your friends!
100% Asynchronous multiplayer challenges
Don’t like to wait while your opponents complete their turn? Fear not! With the 100% asynchronous multiplayer challenges, that is an issue of the past! Play a full game on your own, then post the challenge online! Players from all over the world will be able to play with the same dice and goals you had and try to beat your score! Who’s gonna get the best score?
Railroad Ink Challenge is the official adaptation of the critically acclaimed roll and write game created by award-winning designers Hjalmar Hach & Lorenzo Silva and illustrated by artist Marta Tranquilli.

Having an issue? Looking for support? Please contact us: https://www.horribleguild.com/customercare/

bluejetty:00119904:ios.name: AudioStretch
bluejetty:00119904:ios.summary: Before you buy AudioStretch, consider first downloading AudioStretch Lite for FREE. Apart from some feature limitations, it's the same as the full (paid) version. The Lite version is a great way to see whether AudioStretch works well for yo
bluejetty:00119904:ios.description:
Before you buy AudioStretch, consider first downloading AudioStretch Lite for FREE. Apart from some feature limitations, it's the same as the full (paid) version. The Lite version is a great way to see whether AudioStretch works well for you. 
As a musician one of the most helpful tools you can have is the ability to slow-down, loop or auto-transpose the notes for a piece of music you are trying to learn.
AudioStretch is the world’s first audio and video transcription tool. 
Now you can manipulate the pitch, speed and transcribe your tunes from both audio and video files; or by using your phone’s camera you can capture video directly into AudioStretch and transcribe it!
FEATURES INCLUDE:
• Import audio or video files
• Capture video with your phone camera for transcription
• Change the speed of files without changing the pitch
• Listen to the individual notes as you drag the waveform
• Play audio and video at zero speed
• Transpose any music
• Loop difficult to learn sections
With AudioStretch you get all of this in an incredibly responsive and easy-to-use app. Ideal for transcription, learning songs by ear, crazy sonic experimentation, or just listening to your music library in a new way.
DETAILED FEATURES:
• Load songs from your Music Library. (Note: songs from Apple Music have DRM and therefore cannot be loaded).
• Document Picker import/export option supports iCloud, OneDrive, and more
• Open Dropbox files and email attachments via "Open In"
• LiveScrub™ : listen as you drag/hold the waveform
• Speed range -10x to 10x, including zero speed!
• Instant freeze to zero speed by double-tapping on speed display
• Pitch shift range +/- 36 semitones
• Keyboard/spectrum feature for transcription
• Super-fine speed/pitch adjustment via drag left-right on speed/pitch display
• Flexible looping feature
• No ads or in-app purchases
If you run into any problems with AudioStretch or AudioStretch Lite, please contact support@audiostretch.com

King's Choice is an exciting RPG game simulating life at the European medieval royal court. Become a legendary king and recruit famous generals, meet stunning beauties, raise your heirs, suppress rebellions, and expand your empire with the ultimate goal of becoming the supreme emperor!
Game Features
1. Experience the splendor of the medieval royal court - resplendent garments, luxurious palaces, lavish banquets, loyal knights, gorgeous concubines, and so much more! Live the marvelous life of a medieval European king!
2. Build and rule your own kingdom - handle government affairs, confer titles of nobility, build alliances, defeat enemies, and develop trade!
3. Join the prom with peerless beauty - Peerless beauty invites you to join the dance party！ After dance, you may also fall in love and get marry!
4. Raise your heirs - Raise your sons and daughters, and marry them to other players' heirs to make your kingdom even stronger!
5. Collect legendary heroes - Summon heroes, and compete with other players!

bluejetty:00040564:ios.description:
画啦啦是一款用心设计的互联网美术教育产品，孩子的专属创意美术小画堂。
 画啦啦采用现代美术教学方法，致力于以寓教于乐的方式，鼓励孩子自由创作，培养孩子的创意思维、想象能力和艺术素养。
 画啦啦的教研团队借鉴国内外前沿美术教育理念，制定贴合孩子天性的课程大纲和教学方式。设计高效且富有趣味性的课程，让孩子更喜欢、更专注和更投入！ 
 【线上教学】打破时间和区域限制，手机、平板或电脑均可上课。家长可自由选择上课时间和地点，孩子在家就能享受专业老师教学。
 【教学前沿】采用先进的互动视频教室，实现数字化课堂教学。画啦啦采用互动白板讲解示范，支持精美动画和多种教学课件展示，营造轻松愉快的趣味互动式学习氛围。 
 【翻转课堂】课前参与，视频预习，激发孩子的创作；课后跟进，阶段学习反馈，为孩子的个性成长进行更好的规划。

- Enjoy a collection of the hottest songs from different genres, creatively transformed into duets featuring male and female vocalists.

bluejetty:00021855:ios.description:
KEEP ALL YOUR LOYALTY CARDS IN ONE APP! DITCH THE HEAVY WALLET!
VirtualCards lets you manage all your loyalty cards in one place and transfer them from other apps effortlessly, like stocard, retail apps or photo. Save time, clear your wallet, and unlock exclusive offers—your smarter loyalty companion is here!
TRANSFER YOUR LOYALTY CARDS SEAMLESSLY
Import your cards by scanning the barcode or entering the code manually.
NEW: Move your cards from other apps with a simple screenshot upload from your photo gallery.
Transfer your loyalty cards with just a few taps—quick, simple, and hassle-free!
GET NEW LOYALTY CARDS INSTANTLY
Don’t have a loyalty card yet for your favorite pharmacy, clothing store, or hypermarket? No problem!
Create a digital loyalty card in VirtualCards by filling out a few simple fields (First name, Last name).
Say goodbye to waiting in line, filling out paper forms, or carrying plastic cards that clutter your wallet.
Enjoy the convenience of going digital—fast, easy, and eco-friendly!
STAY UPDATED WITH LOYALTY OFFERS AND PROMOTIONS
Discover the latest deals, promotions, and exclusive catalogs from your favorite brands near you.
When you add a loyalty card from our partner stores, gain access to their special offers and digital catalogs—right in the app!
Receive notifications about discounts and rewards from your preferred stores, and stay in control by choosing who can send you messages.
SAVE BIG WITH GROCERY COUPONS
Save money effortlessly with digital coupons stored in your app.
Show the barcode at the register and enjoy instant discounts!
ORGANIZE YOUR SHOPPING LISTS EFFORTLESSLY
Create shopping lists by typing or using the voice option. See active offers for your chosen products instantly!
Share your list with friends or family and track progress together in real-time.
SHARE OFFERS WITH FRIENDS
Use social media, email, or messaging apps to share your favorite loyalty cards and the best offers.
SEND FEEDBACK DIRECTLY TO PARTNER MERCHANTS
Use the app’s feedback option to share your experience with partner stores.
Let merchants know what you loved, what could improve, and what promotions you’d like to see in the future.
Your voice matters—help your favorite stores deliver a better experience!
NEVER LOSE YOUR CARDS—EVEN WHEN YOU SWITCH PHONES
Create an account, and VirtualCards will securely save all your cards.
Log in on a new phone, and your cards will be there, ready for you.
GO GREEN—HELP THE PLANET
Switch to a digital wallet and reduce waste—no more plastic cards or paperwork!
Join us in making the world a greener, more sustainable place.
WE VALUE YOUR FEEDBACK
Let us know what you think! Use the app’s feedback option to share your shopping experiences, or email us with your suggestions.
Contact us at: contact@virtualcardsapp.com
Follow us on Facebook:
RO: https://www.facebook.com/VirtualCards.ro/
ENG: https://www.facebook.com/virtualcardsapp/

bluejetty:00127551:ios.description:
Ihre Bank in der Tasche – immer und überall für Sie da 
Banking und Bezahlen in einer App: Die VR Banking App ist die Bankfiliale in Ihrer Tasche, mit der Banking jederzeit von unterwegs aus einfach und sicher möglich ist. Dank der Integration der digitalen Karten wird sie auch zur Bezahl-App. Die App bietet Ihnen also rund um die Uhr Zugriff auf Ihre Finanzen und macht Banking und Bezahlen einfach, flexibel und komfortabel: 
- Konten überblicken und verwalten 
- Überweisen und bezahlen 
- Produkte abschließen und Services nutzen 
Konten überblicken und verwalten 
Dank der Kontoübersicht können Sie all Ihre Konten – auch die bei anderen Banken – bequem an einem Ort einsehen. Die Umsatzanzeige ermöglicht es Ihnen, Ihre Finanzen mit individualisierbaren Übersichten stets im Blick zu behalten. 
Zusätzlich informieren Sie Push-Nachrichten in Echtzeit über alle wichtigen Bewegungen, wie Umsätze ab oder bis zu einem bestimmten Betrag, regelmäßige Kontostandsinformationen oder Wero-Transaktionen – und das ganz nach Ihren persönlichen Einstellungen. 
In Ihrem Postfach stehen Ihnen außerdem jederzeit aktuelle Kontoauszüge und Nachrichten Ihrer Bank sowie deren Partner zur Verfügung. So haben Sie Ihre Finanzen immer im Griff – einfach und übersichtlich. 
Überweisen und bezahlen 
Sie können Überweisungen in Echtzeit tätigen oder bequem als Terminüberweisung planen – ganz nach Ihrem Bedarf. Für noch mehr Komfort ermöglicht Ihnen die Fotoüberweisung, Rechnungen, Überweisungsträger oder QR-Codes einfach hochzuladen, zu fotografieren oder zu scannen – prüfen, freigeben, fertig! Verwalten Sie Ihre Daueraufträge flexibel und behalten Sie Ihre regelmäßigen Zahlungen stets im Blick. 
Jetzt auch mit der girocard mobil bezahlen. Mit der VR Banking App wird Ihr Smartphone zum Portemonnaie und Sie bezahlen Ihre Einkäufe einfach durch zweimaliges Drücken der Seitentaste – kontaktlos und sicher wie mit Ihren physischen Karten. 
Mit Wero können Sie in Echtzeit Geld von Konto zu Konto senden, anfordern und gemeinsame Ausgaben teilen. Das geht bequem und schnell, denn Sie benötigen keine IBAN – die Handynummer oder die E-Mail-Adresse Ihres Kontaktes genügt. 
Mit AufrundenPlus wie von selbst sparen: An der Kasse mit der girocard bezahlen, auf den nächsten vollen Euro aufrunden und den Differenzbetrag automatisch sparen.
Produkte abschließen und Services nutzen 
Behalten Sie stets den Überblick über unsere Angebote und schließen Sie bequem neue Produkte direkt über die App ab. Laden Sie Ihr Handyguthaben in wenigen Schritten auf, erteilen Sie unkompliziert einen Freistellungsauftrag oder finden Sie schnell den nächstgelegenen Geldautomaten bzw. die nächste Filiale. 
Mit dem CO₂Check können Sie außerdem Ihren persönlichen CO₂-Fußabdruck analysieren und ein besseres Bewusstsein für Ihren eigenen Beitrag zum Klimaschutz entwickeln. So wird Ihre App zum vielseitigen Begleiter für Finanzen und Nachhaltigkeit. 
Unsere Banking App ist TÜV geprüft sicher (TÜV Saarland).

bluejetty:00087469:ios.description:
Experience tax-free shopping in the UAE like never before with the Planet Tax Free ME Mobile App – a fully digital, paperless shopping experience that simplifies the process. Shop smart, track and manage your refunds!
This application has following features:
- View all your refunds in one place
- View digital invoices for your tax free purchases
- Understand where you are in the process and what to do next
- Request a tax refund for successfully validated transactions
- Track refund status
- Access Local rules for your Planet Tax Free transactions
- Easily access list of Planet Tax Free validation locations
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Who we are?
- Planet Tax Free LLC is the exclusive Operator of the Tourist Refund Scheme, authorised by the Federal Tax Authority (FTA) of the UAE. The FTA launched the Tourist Refund Scheme in November 2018 following the introduction of 5% VAT in January 2018. Please visit www.planetpayment.ae for more details.
## What is Tax Free Shopping?
- While on your holiday in the UAE you can get a refund for the Value Added Tax (VAT) you paid on your retail shopping. To get your refund, you just need to show your purchases and get them validated when you leave the country. It's a way to save some money while enjoying your shopping experience in the UAE.
## Who is eligible?
- VAT refunds in the UAE are available to overseas tourists aged 18 and above. An 'overseas tourist' refers to anyone who isn't a resident of the UAE or any of the Implementing States, and isn't part of a flight or ship crew leaving the UAE. 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Please feel free to check out the FAQ and Local Rules section on our app or visit our website www.planetpayment.ae for more information.

bluejetty:00070275:ios.description:
Automotive News has been the global auto industry's most-trusted source of news and insights since 1925. With 24/7 breaking news coverage and in-depth analysis, the Automotive News app helps you easily keep up with what's most important for your business.
Save, share and search our coverage on your phone or tablet, and get alerts when the most important news breaks. The Automotive News app is free to download, with full access to our podcasts and videos and a limited number of articles. Subscribers get unlimited article access. 
Retail News: Covering dealers, online sales, service and parts, finance and insurance, advertising, monthly and annual sales reports and annual lists of top dealership groups, dealer census and certified used-vehicle guides.
Automaker and Supplier News: Coverage of the design and manufacture of vehicles, automaker and supplier mergers, spinoffs and acquisitions, earnings, executive changes and partnerships.
Cars & Concepts: Automotive design, future product, engineering, and powertrain coverage. When automakers unveil new models, you'll find it here.
Technology and Innovation: Autonomous vehicles, EVs, connected cars, and automotive software ... Where will the next generation of transportation technology take us?
Opinion: Columns and editorials from veteran automotive journalists and guest writers, along with thoughts from our readers.

bluejetty:00022384:ios.name: ASMR Tippy Toe
bluejetty:00022384:ios.summary: Prepare for the best shoe smashing game you’ve ever played ! Tippy Toe is a fun shoe smashing run game where you smash and step on a crazy variety of objects : hamburgers, food, Fidgets pop it, cakes … each object brings its own satisfactio
bluejetty:00022384:ios.description:
Prepare for the best shoe smashing game you’ve ever played ! Tippy Toe is a fun shoe smashing run game where you smash and step on a crazy variety of objects : hamburgers, food, Fidgets pop it, cakes … each object brings its own satisfaction and cool sounds ! Be aware of the traps along the way and avoid the dangerous objects scattered across your path such as bananas, poop, rakes … Hold to bring your foot forward and release to step it down and enjoy the satisfying ASMR sounds of squishing the objects. 
Pop the fidgets ! 
Enjoy the bonus prize objects scattered across the path and earn money and gold to customize your character and create your own style of fashion. 
Walk down the red carpet with your fancy style, cool looking shoes, dress, skirts, tattoos, hair style … We have all types of style for everyone in our shop, there’s even very popular shoes that you might wear everyday! 
And don’t forget to travel the world in the many destinations included in the game : walk down the streets of Los Angeles, smash street food between the buildings of New York City, journey across the dunes of Egypt, and in the neon skyline of Tokyo, in the cat populated metropolitan of Istanbul, the canals of Amsterdam … 
Each destination has its own set of items and objects, and satisfying ASMR sounds. It’s like you’re really there ! And you can also enjoy epic destruction levels : play as Godzilla or King Kong as you rampage through the city, destroy buildings and create explosions. We have everything for everyone ! 
So now get ready and come smash funny ASMR items in this fun run satisfying game !

Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.

Tippy Toe is a fun shoe smashing run game where you smash and step on a crazy variety of objects : hamburgers, food, Fidgets pop it, cakes … each object brings its own satisfaction and cool sounds ! Be aware of the traps along the way and avoid the dangerous objects scattered across your path such as bananas, poop, rakes … Hold to bring your foot forward and release to step it down and enjoy the satisfying ASMR sounds of squishing the objects. 
Pop the fidgets ! 
Enjoy the bonus prize objects scattered across the path and earn money and gold to customize your character and create your own style of fashion. 
Walk down the red carpet with your fancy style, cool looking shoes, dress, skirts, tattoos, hair style … We have all types of style for everyone in our shop, there’s even very popular shoes that you might wear everyday! 
And don’t forget to travel the world in the many destinations included in the game : walk down the streets of Los Angeles, smash street food between the buildings of New York City, journey across the dunes of Egypt, and in the neon skyline of Tokyo, in the cat populated metropolitan of Istanbul, the canals of Amsterdam …

Escolher alimentos industrializados nunca foi tão fácil
===============

1. Escaneie rótulos com facilidade

2. Compare produtos e descubra os melhores da categoria
Troque produtos com baixo valor nutricional por alternativas mais saudáveis e acessíveis.
3. Encontre o que combina com seu objetivo alimentar
Configure seu perfil (ex: emagrecimento, controle de pressão, etc) e veja recomendações alinhadas.

Sem glúten, sem lactose, vegetariano, sem aditivos e mais — você escolhe.
5. Crie listas e salve seus produtos favoritos
Monte sua lista de compras ideal com produtos que funcionam na sua rotina.
6. Receba dicas, conteúdos e listas de especialistas toda semana
Informações confiáveis, sempre atualizadas.
===============
Grátis para começar. Simples para usar.
===============
Na versão gratuita, você consulta produtos escaneando o código de barras.
Com o Premium, você destrava o acesso completo:
- Ver melhores alternativas ao produto pesquisado
- Buscar produtos por nome, marca ou categoria
- Filtrar resultados por nota
- E mais!
===============
O Desrotulando é para você se:
- Está tentando melhorar sua alimentação, sem abrir mão da praticidade
- Segue alguma dieta ou tem restrições alimentares
- Quer cuidar melhor da saúde da sua família
- Está cansado de ser enganado por embalagens “marketeiras” que não entregam o que prometem
===============
Não escolha no escuro. Leve o Desrotulando com você nas compras e descubra os produtos que realmente valem a pena.
Baixe agora o app, escolha melhor a conquiste uma alimentação mais saudável.
===============
- Mais de 60 mil produtos já avaliados
- Novos produtos adicionados todos os dias por nossa comunidade
- Disponível apenas para produtos vendidos no Brasil

bluejetty:00078047:ios.name: Card Match - Matching Puzzle
bluejetty:00078047:ios.summary:
Card Match is a challenging and original matching game! Don't get scared away. It's very easy to learn how to play for everyone!
So get ready for a new, original and challenging Card-match game is a combination of the world's most popular
bluejetty:00078047:ios.description:
Card Match is a challenging and original matching game! Don't get scared away. It's very easy to learn how to play for everyone!
So get ready for a new, original and challenging Card-match game is a combination of the world's most popular games - TriPeaks Solitaire and Mahjong! 
Fans and card game fans will love the games also known as Tri Towers, Triple Peaks, Solitaire Tri Peaks, Solitaire Blitz,Castle Solitaire-tripeaks, Solitaire Cube, Farm Adventure, Solitaire Cruise, Tiki Solitaire, harvest Solitaire or Three Peaks.Can you complete all 1000+ levels? Install Now!
Find the matching cards on the gameboard and connect the pair. Collect and remove all cards to complete the level. Use boosters and become a matching expert level by level. Plus, it's totally free to play!
Features:
- More than 500 challenging and fun levels to play game.
- Boosters and obstacles give lot of fun while sorting and matching hidden objects!
- No timer, no pressure
- Mahjong combi points
- You are able to pause whenever you want
- Classic matching puzzle is really relaxing and will certainly have a calming zen effect!
- Train your brain: concentration, observation and logic. Search and connect card to beat the level!
- Solve puzzles on every level. Claim your rewards in Daily Bonuses
- Turn sounds on or off
- Simple pick-up-and-play controls
Challenging levels:
Levels get more and more challenging as your Сard Match trip continues. Want to train your brain and improve your memorizing ability? In Сard Match, you will get your brain trained during beating levels! In the matching puzzle game, you need not only good eyesight but excellent memory. Dare to challenge?
Pause anytime:
Get interrupted during matching? No worries! Сard Match has a pause button for you when you need to shift your attention. But don't forget to come back to the unfinished tidying-up to complete the level!
Card Match - Mahjong Solitaire - collected the best games you love! Three peaks solitaire, mahjong, matching games, puzzles.
If you are a fan of matching puzzle games, Сard Match will improve your concentration, train your brain and vision, and relax your mind.
Come and download Сard Match now! Let's match and pair together!

bluejetty:00080993:ios.description:
Tool Evolution: Mine & Evolve lets you experience a unique journey through time as you take on the role of a tool that evolves with each era you visit. From the Jurassic era to the distant future, your tool will adapt and transform, allowing you to build world, mine, and evolve through different historical periods and beyond.
Start your adventure in the Jurassic era and help shape the earliest mini world. As you travel through time, your tool will evolve to meet the demands of each age—from medieval life to the Industrial Revolution and into futuristic landscapes. Each era presents new challenges and opportunities to harvest resources and craft essential items.
Tool Evolution: Mine & Evolve features:
- Time Travel: Journey from the Jurassic era through the Middle Ages, into the future, and beyond. Each period brings its own unique challenges and advancements in this mini world.
- Evolving Tools: Your tool evolves according to the age you time travel to, adapting from primitive designs to advanced futuristic technology.
- Idle Mining Game: Harvest resources and mine efficiently with your evolving tool. Manage your resources and automate processes as you advance.
- Crafting and Expansion: From my little universe to vast planet craft projects, use your tool to develop your little world and beyond.
- Historical and Futuristic Gameplay: Witness the transformation of your tool and world through different historical periods and futuristic scenarios.
As you explore and conquer each new age, Tool Evolution: Mine & Evolve challenges you to adapt your strategy and make the most of each era's unique resources and technologies. Evolve through time and create a world that reflects the innovations and achievements of every period you encounter.
Are you ready to take your tool on an incredible journey through history and the future? Join Tool Evolution: Mine & Evolve and start your evolution adventure!

bluejetty:00021068:ios.description:
Live the dream of every pet owner! See the world through the eyes of a cat! Are you prepared for all the surprises that come with being an adorable feline? Make difficult
choices and new friends along the way. Take care of your cat and make his life as perfect as you’d wish for yourself!
Cat Life allows you to experience life as a cat, with full control over your feline companion. You will have the opportunity to see the world through your cat's eyes, and enjoy all the perks and pitfalls of cat life.
As you start the game, you will create your own cat, choosing its appearance and personality. Once you've created your cat, you can start exploring the world around you. The game is set in a virtual world with realistic environments, including parks, neighborhoods, and homes.
Your cat will need affection to thrive, so you'll need to take care of your furry friend! The game offers a variety of challenges and opportunities for your cat to explore. Interact with other cats in the neighborhood and make friends, play with humans, and more. Take your cat on walks, play games with it, and buy new toys and accessories to keep it entertained.
As you progress through the game, you'll encounter different challenges and obstacles. You'll need to make difficult choices. You'll also encounter other cats and you'll need to navigate these interactions to ensure your cat's safety.
Whether you're a seasoned cat owner or just curious about what life is like as a feline, this game has something for everyone. Start your life as a cat now!

bluejetty:00160670:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00160670:ios.description:
Sometimes we don't know the hardware information of our cell phone.
Sometimes we don't know how much traffic we have used.
Sometimes we don't know the performance of our phone's camera or how long it's been on.
CPU Max can help you to solve this problem easily. With it, a small and light app, you can check the detailed parameters of your phone, and there are convenient widgets and widgets that you will love to use.
Main functions:
- Basic information: phone name, heat generation, sensors, interface, size, etc.
- Processor: name, model, number of crystals, cpu cores, architecture, real-time main frequency, downscaling ratio, etc.
- Memory: total memory, memory details usage, etc.
- Network: connection type, traffic, external IP, internal IP, upload and download speed, etc.
- Battery: capacity, estimated available time, power, low battery mode, etc.
- Storage: total capacity, used capacity, remaining capacity
- Screen: material, size, brightness, refresh rate, etc.
- Camera: aperture, HDR, anti-shake, exposure time, resolution, frame rate, etc.
- System: type, version, kernel, boot time, active time, supported versions, etc.
Tools:
- widget: negative screen notification bar widget, real-time refresh, graphic overview
- Traffic statistics: statistics of cell phone traffic, can set package traffic (Note: and operator data may have errors)
- Network speed test: test the latency, jitter, upload speed, download speed, etc. of your network
- Spin the wheel: Choose for yourself through the turntable, you can freely set the theme and style, fun and easy to use
- Flip clock: display the page flip clock in full screen, the phone becomes a beautiful flip clock, the effect can be customized
- Straight ruler: Turn your phone into a ruler with a millimeter scale, measure at any time, easy to use
- Password generator: support 8 to 64-bit complex passwords, support the function of saving passwords, only saved locally (Tip: different platforms using a unified account password is most likely to generate information leakage)
- Screen test: full-screen display of different types of Screen test pictures, so that problematic screens are visible at a glance
- Conversion: binary, octal, decimal, hexadecimal free conversion, you may use
There will be more in the future, we want to be the best mobile tool, if you have a gadget you want, feel free to tell us in the App feedback.
Note: If you select the Health widget, the app will need to read the step, distance and calorie data from your Health app to display the data on the widget.
Member subscription:
- You can subscribe for unlimited access to all features of CPU Max
- Subscriptions are charged on a weekly basis, depending on the subscription plan chosen
By using CPU Max, you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
https://kuangbaoat.github.io/cpumax/privacy.html
https://kuangbaoat.github.io/cpumax/terms.html

bluejetty:00174785:ios.description:
The Johns Hopkins Menopause Guide highlights caring for the Woman experiencing Menopause. Developed by experts at Johns Hopkins Medicine, the Guide helps healthcare providers of all disciplines practice menopause medicine as well as support the health and wellness of aging women. 
The Menopause Guide organizes details of symptoms, treatment, special topics, and management tools into easily accessible, quick-read entries. Content is updated regularly and is designed to help residents and practitioners make decisions at the point of care.
Editor-in-Chief: Wen Shen, M.D., M.P.H.
Pharmacology Editors: Lauren Lakdawala, PharmD., BCACP

bluejetty:00041960:ios.description:
Block Crush is a classic block puzzle game designed around clear boards, simple rules, and structured logic. It offers a focused block puzzle experience where gameplay is easy to understand from the first move and remains consistent throughout each session.
In this block puzzle game, players place blocks of different shapes onto the board to complete full rows or columns. Clearing lines creates space and allows the block puzzle to continue. Each move requires planning and spatial awareness to keep the board playable for as long as possible.
Classic Block Puzzle Gameplay
Block Crush follows familiar classic block puzzle mechanics. Blocks appear in various shapes and must be placed carefully to avoid filling the board. Completing rows or columns clears space and keeps the block puzzle gameplay flowing without interruption.
The board layout remains clean and consistent, allowing players to focus entirely on block placement logic without time limits, pressure, or unnecessary visual distractions.
How to Play
• Place blocks onto the board
• Complete rows or columns to clear space
• Plan moves to manage available areas
• Continue playing as long as space remains
• Try a new daily block puzzle challenge
• Play offline anytime
Features
• Classic Block Puzzle Game — clear rules and simple logic
• Clean Board Design — easy to read and visually structured
• Daily Block Puzzle Mode — refreshed puzzle layouts each day
• Smooth Controls — intuitive drag-and-drop placement
• Offline Puzzle Play — no internet connection required
• No Ads Mode — uninterrupted block puzzle sessions
A Focused Block Puzzle Experience
Block Crush is a logic-based block puzzle built for players who enjoy structured gameplay and thoughtful decision-making. With consistent mechanics and readable boards, it delivers a reliable block puzzle experience suited for repeated play.
Download Block Crush and enjoy a classic block puzzle game with clean design, offline support, and straightforward gameplay—free to play and designed for focus.

Pillars is an app built by Muslims with a long-term vision to elevate our Ummah – starting with Prayer (salah). We have so much more planned! Join us on this journey.
Features:
No Ads – adverts don’t belong on a Prayer app. Period. That’s why our app includes no ads straight out of the box.
Privacy-Focussed – Muslims are entitled to their privacy. That's why at Pillars we take your data very seriously. Not only do we promise not to collect it for malicious intent, we avoid collecting it in the first place!
Muslim-Built – prayer apps should be built by Muslims. Why? Because we have your interests at heart and know the importance of Salah. We also best understand the issues Muslims face.
Smart Qibla - find the correct direction to pray with our Qibla and integrated smart calibration feature
Early & Late Asr Time – choose your Madhab (School of Thought) and tailor your prayer times to the earlier or later Asr time.
Multiple Calculation Methods – choose the perfect Prayer calculation method for you depending on your location and preferences.
Prayer Notifications – get notified for each prayer time throughout the day. Option to disable notifications available.
Beautiful Design – we want to beautify the act of Prayer, a key ibadah (act of worship) in Islam. Therefore, what better place to start than with an elegant prayer app.
Widget Included – a beautifully designed widget for your home screen for quick access to prayer times
Prayer Tracker – a great way to stay on top of your salah and the first step to developing your relationship with Allah. Perfect for new converts or those trying to improve their praying habits!
Fasting Tracker - log your missed fasts with the reason and then tick them off when you make them up!
Menstruation (pause) button - pause tracking and never miss out on a streak!
Lock Screen Widget - get key information like the current and next prayer time with a quick glance of your lock screen!
Coming Soon:

More Widgets – more beautifully designed widgets in all shapes & sizes.

Download the app and join us on this journey inshaAllah.
