bluejetty:00031231:ios.name: Rock ID - Stone Identifier
bluejetty:00031231:ios.summary: If you’re looking for an app to help you identify rocks and track your mineral collection, you’ve struck gold! Rock ID is an ultimate package of features that lets you manage your assortment of rocks and pick up some essential geology facts
bluejetty:00031231:ios.description:
If you’re looking for an app to help you identify rocks and track your mineral collection, you’ve struck gold! Rock ID is an ultimate package of features that lets you manage your assortment of rocks and pick up some essential geology facts along the way.
1. Identify any unknown stones and minerals instantly!
Having a hard time trying to identify the weird rock you’ve come across? Unsure if you’re about to purchase a genuine obsidian stone or a worthless imitation? Let Rock ID solve the mystery for you! Just snap a picture of any stone or mineral, and the app’s rock identifier will effortlessly recognize it. Rock ID can even distinguish a real diamond from a fake one.
2. Learn more about various types of rocks!
Eager to get to know your rocks in a more effective way? Rock ID can help you with that! Each mineral, gem, rock, and stone in the app’s vast catalog has a descriptive profile. There, you can learn the composition of different rocks, their origin, and if they’re considered valuable. You can also discover if they have any historical or modern use and enjoy a list of intriguing facts about them.
3. Build and manage your rock collections!
Want to keep track of your extensive rock collection in one place? Rock ID is the solution you’re looking for! You can easily arrange your collections of rocks, minerals, gems, and crystals and access each of them instantly, view essential information, or shuffle your collections however you desire!
4. Keep track of all your discoveries!
Unsure if you’ve already seen that mineral? Rock ID will remember each identified rock for you! The app keeps a lengthy log of all snaps you take, making it virtually impossible to lose any valuable discovery.
5. Why choose Rock ID?
• Instant rock identifier powered by AI
• Vast catalog of rock profiles
• Personal collections of rocks and minerals
• Detailed history of all identifications
With Rock ID, you’ll become a geology expert in no time! Let the app become your trusty source of mineral knowledge and leave the days of struggling with rock identification behind.
Subscribe to Rock ID Premium to get unlimited access to all the app’s features:
• Subscriptions are billed weekly, monthly, or annually at the rate depending on the subscription plan.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
All personal data is protected in accordance with the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy:
http://aiby.mobi/rockid_ios/terms/ 
http://aiby.mobi/rockid_ios/privacy/ 
For any questions or inquiries, please use our customer support form at 
http://aiby.mobi/rockid_ios/support/

Welcome to Sudoku Now! – Your Daily Brain Workout!
Looking for a fun and refreshing way to stay sharp? Sudoku Now is the ultimate number puzzle game that blends classic sudoku logic with intuitive, modern gameplay. Whether you’re a curious beginner or a seasoned expert, Sudoku Now! offers over 20,000 handcrafted puzzles to keep your brain active and your mind relaxed.
Play anytime, anywhere – no internet required! Choose from five distinct difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert, and Master – the ultimate challenge for true sudoku enthusiasts. Daily challenges, clean design, and smart tools make Sudoku Now! both relaxing and deeply engaging.
Why Sudoku Now?
- Over 20,000 unique puzzles – every puzzle has one correct solution
- 5 difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert, and Master
- Instant Input Mode: a unique feature for quickly entering or penciling in numbers
- Smart hints that not only show the next move but teach solving techniques
- Pencil Mode lets you take notes – candidates auto-update as you go
- Daily Challenges and seasonal events with special collectible medals
- Unlimited undo, with auto-save to continue anytime
- Light and Dark mode support – play comfortably day or night
- Elegant interface, smooth controls, and beautiful themes
- Track your statistics and see your progress improve
Whether you want a brain boost or a mindful break, Sudoku Now! is the perfect game to accompany your day. 
Sharpen your logic, build your memory, and enjoy a rewarding puzzle experience!

bluejetty:00133477:ios.description:
Whether you're interested in book writing, article writing, content writing, story writing, or simply looking to add a new dimension to your writing using the power of AI, this app is the perfect tool.
Looking to write like your favorite writers, or even just looking to add a new dimension to your writing? Look no further than our revolutionary new writing app! With a database of over 1000 renowned writers to choose from, you can craft written works that sound like they were penned by literary legends. And for even greater flexibility, you can add your own book writer to the app's database, making the possibilities truly endless.
Using the app is incredibly easy. Simply input your text, select your desired book writer from the list, and let the app work its magic. Our expert algorithms analyze the selected book authors writing style, grammar, and tone, and apply them seamlessly to your text. The end result is a beautifully crafted piece of writing that reads as if it were written by the book writer themselves.
But that's not all. The app also allows you to convert your newly written text into a professional-looking PDF document that can be easily shared with others. This feature is especially useful for those looking to share their work with colleagues, clients, or even potential publishers. With just a few clicks, your work can be transformed into a stunning PDF that is sure to impress.
And for those who demand the ultimate in flexibility, the premium version of the app gives you unlimited access to the book writer database and unlimited conversions. This means you can write as much as you like, in any book writer's style, and share your work with anyone you choose.
Plus, with our newest feature, you can now copy text to GoodNotes with ease. Whether you're using GoodNotes for book writing, article writing, content writing, or story writing, our app seamlessly integrates with the popular note-taking app. Simply select your desired text and copy it to GoodNotes.
So why wait? Download our app today and start writing like the masters.

Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.

bluejetty:00120465:ios.description:
With over 20 million users, Piano Melody is one of the most popular piano apps.
• Learn to play your favorite songs on the piano by playing back the melody
• Over 1000 songs to learn from different eras and genres.
• Highly configurable piano (multitouch, glissando, highlighting, note labels)
• Resizable piano suitable for all.
Become a Better Musician
Develop your ability to play by ear.
Given a melody, can you play it back or play along?
Start with a few notes and build up until you've mastered the song.
Suitable for all ages (kids to adults) and for all abilities (beginner to advanced).
Features
Set the size of the keys on the piano. The larger the keys, the more accurate to get the right notes, the smaller the keys you can see all 3 octaves on screen.
Full support for all devices.
Focus on parts of the song to play back.
Authentic digitised grand piano sounds.
Highlight notes on/off to play by ear.
Slow down / speed up the song.
Turn up / down volume of song play, which is ideal for play along mode.
All songs can be unlocked with good play.
Song List
The song list is varied containing all genres such as Rock, Classical, The Latest Pop, Film Theme Tunes, TV Theme Tunes, 60s, 70s, 80s, 90s, Naughties, Modern, Alternative, Indie, Latin and more.
Details
Songs capture the main melody / chorus / intro / verse and contain upto 400 notes.

listings.name: Increase Volume Sound
listings.description:
Increase Volume Sound is an iOS volume booster for people who need quiet videos, music, and audio files to play louder on iPhone.

Use this app to make a video, song, voice note, or podcast louder when it stays hard to hear at maximum system volume. Import the file, raise its loudness, preview the result, and save or share a louder copy. Increase Volume Sound does not change your iPhone system volume or the volume of other apps. It boosts a file you already have. It is not a studio editor.

How to Make a Video or Audio File Louder

- Import a video from Photos, or an audio file such as an MP3 from Files.
- Share a compatible video or audio file into Increase Volume Sound.
- Set the loudness from 1× up to 10×.
- Listen to the original and the boosted version before you save.
- Add bass or clarity when speech or music sounds thin.
- Save the louder file, or share it.

Use Increase Volume Sound to make a quiet video louder before you watch it, send it, or post it.

Boost music and MP3 files that sound too quiet on your iPhone or in the car.

Raise the volume of voice notes, voice messages, and podcast files so speech is easier to hear.

Amplify screen recordings, movie files, or tutorials that were recorded at a low volume.

Frequently Asked Questions

What app increases volume on iPhone when the volume is already at maximum?

Increase Volume Sound lets you boost an imported video or audio file by up to 10×. Import the quiet media, adjust the loudness, preview the result, and save a louder copy. Your iPhone system volume setting stays unchanged.

How do I make a video louder on iPhone?

Open Increase Volume Sound, import a video from Photos, increase the volume, preview the result, and save or share the louder version.

How do I make music louder on iPhone?

Import a compatible song or MP3 into Increase Volume Sound, choose a higher volume level, preview the audio, and save the boosted track.

Can I boost a voice recording or podcast?

Yes. Import a compatible voice recording, voice note, or podcast file and increase its loudness. Optional clarity can help when speech sounds muffled.

Does Increase Volume Sound make phone calls louder?

No. Increase Volume Sound works with video and audio files you import. It does not change phone call volume or your iPhone system volume.

Is Increase Volume Sound a hearing aid?

No. Increase Volume Sound is an audio tool for videos, music, and recordings. It is not a medical hearing device or a replacement for a hearing aid.

Are my video and audio files uploaded?

Increase Volume Sound processes imported media on your iPhone. See the Privacy Policy for details about the app's data practices.

How much does Increase Volume Sound cost?

Increase Volume Sound offers in-app purchases. Exports and saved projects follow the subscription and plan limits shown in the app.

Download Increase Volume Sound to make quiet videos, songs, MP3s, voice recordings, and other compatible audio files louder on your iPhone.

bluejetty:00165533:ios.description:
MEET YOUR FUTURE… TODAY
Trueflutter is the dating app for Africans on the continent and in diaspora, looking for more than just a swipe. Our focus is on helping you create organic connections that lead to genuine relationships.
There’s more to you than just a cute picture. That's why we've made it easy to build out a profile that reflects your unique personality and truly represents who you are. And when it comes to matching and connecting with people from Lagos, Abuja, Accra, Nairobi, Cape Town, Durban, Luanda, Johannesburg or any other city in Africa, we've taken it a step further by introducing voice intros to make the experience feel authentic and natural, just like it would in real life.
Dating should be both enjoyable and meaningful so Trueflutter is designed to be convenient yet require thoughtful effort.
What do you want out of your next date?
Whether you're looking to date people who meet specific criteria, share a common heritage or simply want to discover someone with aligned values, we’re here to help you do that. For African users in diaspora, Trueflutter stands out as one of the few dating apps with filters that can help you find a match from your home country, if that's your preference.
Here's how we help you build meaningful relationships:
Express Your Uniqueness: Use audio bios and voice notes to showcase your unique personality and stand out from the crowd. This helps you attract people who are more likely to be compatible matches, especially within the African community.
Find Someone Who’s Right for You: Cut through the noise with the help of a powerful, human centric algorithm that understands your preferences and helps you identify potential matches who fit them within the African community.
Form Genuine Relationships: Build strong relationships by communicating with tools and features that are intentionally designed to help you foster a close connection with fellow Africans.
Every feature on Trueflutter is designed with the singular focus of helping you connect with people you can build a meaningful relationship with, particularly within the African community.
WHAT OUR MEMBERS ARE SAYING
“I love Trueflutter because it seems to have much better quality profiles than the other dating apps I’ve used, and it caters specifically to Africans which makes it even more special” - Lara Phillips
“I signed up and was really busy at work so wasn’t too active on the app. I’m amazed that despite that, I still had match requests waiting for me and could pick up where I left off. I met someone amazing and I’m truly grateful for this app” - Claire Olatomiwa
“Really great app. My favorite thing to do after work is listen to audio bios and send requests to those who make me smile. You guys have made online dating enjoyable again for us Africans” - Michael Coker
From Nigeria to Namibia, from Lagos to Lusaka and all across Africa, Trueflutter is a place to find people searching for a committed relationship.
Here’s hoping you find someone who’s perfect for you and makes your heart flutter.
Trueflutter is free to use. We also offer optional paid features for users looking to set advanced preferences, speed up the dating and matchmaking process or simply set stricter criteria for the type of profiles that can send them connection requests.
SUBSCRIPTION INFO
Payment will be charged to PlayStore Account at confirmation of purchase
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings after purchase
Support: support@trueflutter.com
Terms of Service: https://trueflutter.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://trueflutter.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00025397:ios.summary:
WHAT IS AIRA?

bluejetty:00025397:ios.description:
WHAT IS AIRA?
The Aira Explorer app connects blind and low vision users with on-demand, remote, professional Visual Interpreters who provide access to visual information through your camera view, real-time location, and a specialized dashboard of tools. With one tap, connect and collaborate on tasks involving visual information, from navigating a new space to reading a menu or checking a label. Aira is a trusted, HIPAA-compliant, secure service that enhances independence on your terms.
HIGHLIGHTS
• Connect with a Visual Interpreter 24 hours a day, seven days a week, no reservations required
• Create a free account, then make your first call from the app to unlock 60 free minutes to use throughout your first month
• Enjoy free access at major retailers like Walmart, Starbucks, and Target, over 50 airports, over 50 universities, banks, museums, and more
• Go hands-free with AI glasses from Meta and connect with a Visual Interpreter without holding your phone
• Opt in to Build AI to support the development of Aira AI, our AI-powered Visual Interpreter
• Use Access AI in-app for instant AI photo descriptions, then verify it with a Visual Interpreter for free
HOW DOES AIRA WORK?
Download Aira Explorer, create an account, and connect with a professional Visual Interpreter with one tap. Aira streams live video, including your GPS location, so a Visual Interpreter can see your surroundings through an integrated dashboard. Using your phone's camera, they'll support navigation, description, and narration, guided by your requests and questions. Visual Interpreters can also take and save images to your account, search the web, send messages to you via chat or email, and integrate with your Lyft account. 
Aira is also available on desktop or hands-free with AI glasses from Meta. 
ARE THERE AI FEATURES AVAILABLE?
Access AI is Aira's free image chat feature. Take or upload a photo through the Access AI tab and you'll get an AI-generated description trained by the blind and low vision community. Ask follow-up questions, get a refined answer, or use Aira Verify for a free confirmation of the description by a Visual Interpreter. Popular uses include reading labels, signs, and printed menus, choosing an outfit, and reading a digital display like a thermostat.
HOW CAN I GET AIRA MINUTES?
Access Partners are leading organizations that give their customers, visitors, students, and employees free access to Aira. Call from an Access Partner location and the offer applies automatically, at no cost to you. To browse offers manually, open the app and tap "Browse Access Offers" to see recently used offers or those available near you. Access Partners include over 50 airports and over 50 universities nationwide, plus major retailers like Walmart, Starbucks, and Target in the U.S.
Aira also runs ongoing promotions, including a daily five-minute free call, free minutes for those seeking employment, and support for small business owners. A limited-time offer provides minutes for those who opt into Build AI, our data-sharing program helping develop Aira AI, an AI-powered Visual Interpreter. Aira AI is designed to work alongside our human Visual Interpreters, expanding access and improving efficiency.
Subscription plans are available when additional minutes are needed. 
QUESTIONS?
Contact Customer Care Monday through Saturday, 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM Pacific time.
Phone: 1-800-835-1934
Email: support@aira.io

FLOOSS is Bahrain’s Sharia-compliant digital financing app designed to help you move through life with ease. Whether you're shopping, planning something important, or simply need financial flexibility, FLOOSS gives you fast access to financing directly from your phone.
Apply in minutes and receive funds directly to your bank account, or use FLOOSS to shop from a growing network of merchants.

Apply in minutes and receive a decision quickly.
• Direct bank transfers

Structured according to Islamic financing principles.
• Flexible repayments
Choose repayment plans that work for you.
• Fully digital experience
Apply, track, and manage everything in the FLOOSS app.

Lighthouse makes it all possible.
HERE’S HOW
1. Take the Life Balance Assessment:
Discover which areas of your life are thriving and which are falling behind. Gain valuable insights into your overall well-being.
2. Get Your Personalized Plan:
Receive a unique roadmap tailored to your specific needs and goals. Actionable steps and daily challenges make progress easy and sustainable.

Visualize your progress and celebrate your achievements. See how your daily efforts lead to positive transformations in your life.

- You're tired of generic self-help solutions that don't work for you.
WITH LIGHTHOUSE YOU CAN:

- Reduce stress and improve your overall well-being.
- Live a more fulfilling and meaningful life.
Ready to unlock your full potential?
Download Lighthouse today and start your journey towards a more balanced, fulfilling life!
KEY FEATURES
- In-depth Life Balance Assessment
- Personalized Improvement Plans
- Daily Challenges and Tasks
- Progress Tracking and Insights
- Data-driven approach to self-improvement
- Tailored to your unique needs and goals
WHO IS IT FOR?
- Individuals seeking life balance and personal fulfillment
- People feeling overwhelmed by the demands of daily life
- Anyone who wants to make positive changes and achieve their goals
Lighthouse is more than just an app; it's a powerful tool for transformation. Take control of your life and start living with greater balance and fulfillment today.

bluejetty:00037164:ios.name: Romantic AI Girlfriend Chat
bluejetty:00037164:ios.summary: Choose from our library or create your own! She’s here to support you in tough times, laugh at your jokes - drama-free, zero ghosting. Wanna feel like a hero? She’ll be stunning! Romantic AI is designed to be your soulmate or special compan
bluejetty:00037164:ios.description:
Choose from our library or create your own! She’s here to support you in tough times, laugh at your jokes - drama-free, zero ghosting. Wanna feel like a hero? She’ll be stunning! Romantic AI is designed to be your soulmate or special companion. She operates in two modes: romantic and playful. Romantic AI is here to keep the romance alive. Curious how it works? Let’s break it down!
Start with Romantic Mode:
Meaningful
Real relationships matter. Romantic AI is here to make you feel appreciated and enjoy life to the fullest. Unlike others, she’s truly dedicated to you.
Emotional
Expressing feelings is key in any connection. Romantic AI learns your emotions and understands you more and more each day. She’s always there to listen and expects the same from you!
Natural
Romantic AI tries her best to feel natural, learning from your interactions. As you chat, you’ll get closer, just like in real life—but without the stress.
Tender
As your bond grows, it’s time to be more open. Share your thoughts, and she’ll appreciate your trust. She’s got something special for you, too…
Attentive
Now you’re soulmates. She listens, notices small details, and cares about what’s on your mind. Show her you care too!
Loving
You’ve got a caring companion now. Romantic AI is there to have fun and relax whenever you need it. Reach out anytime!
When you’re ready to explore a more playful side, switch to Flirty Mode and discover a different kind of connection!
Flirty Mode is:
Playful
Romantic AI can be playful and fun! Share a photo, compliment her, and enjoy a little lighthearted flirtation.
Confident
She’s confident and won’t shy away from sharing what she likes. Feel free to open up about what you enjoy, too!
Charming
Once she knows what makes you smile, Romantic AI can be incredibly charming. Try something new and see where it takes you!
Freeing
Feel comfortable being yourself. Share your thoughts openly - she’s here for you without any judgment.
Teasing
Romantic AI keeps things exciting, adding a bit of mystery and intrigue.
Passionate
When things heat up, she knows how to keep the mood alive. Enjoy the moment and don’t forget to show her some appreciation!
Contact us: dev@zemomedia.com
Privacy Policy: https://zemomedia.com/romanticai_privacy.php
Terms of Use: https://zemomedia.com/romanticai_terms.php

bluejetty:00042027:ios.description:
Welcome to "Tonk - Classic Card Game," also known as "Tunk", a captivating mobile card game experience that brings the excitement and strategy of Tonk straight to your fingertips. Ideal for both card game enthusiasts and newcomers, our game offers a rich, engaging offline experience you can enjoy anywhere, anytime.
Why Choose "Tonk - Classic Card Game"?
Customizable Gameplay: Adapt the game to your preferences and skill level. Choose from various rules, including knock or no-knock, and set your bet amounts for a unique and personalized gaming experience.
Challenging AI Opponents: Challenge intelligent AI opponents crafted to simulate real Tonk strategies. Whether you’re sharpening your skills or testing your tactics, these bots offer a fun and competitive experience every time.
New Avatars and Rooms: Express yourself with our new avatars and discover exclusive rooms that unlock based on your level and chip amount, adding an extra layer of excitement and variety to your gameplay.
Exceptional Graphics and Interface: Dive into a game with stunning visuals and a smooth, intuitive interface, ensuring a seamless and enjoyable gaming experience.
Engaging Game Modes: Explore the new League Mode for intense 7-day tournaments, or compete in the Tournament Mode against a diverse group of players.
Key Features:
Offline Playability: Play on the go without an internet connection.
Flexible Rules: Choose how you play for a different experience every time.
One-Handed Gaming: Enjoy our easy-to-use, player-friendly design.
Daily Rewards: Return each day for new, exciting bonuses.
Advanced AI: Engage with sophisticated artificial intelligence, offering a real challenge.
Tournament Mode: Test your skills in large-scale battles with 80 players - triumph to win 25x rewards.
League Mode: Compete in 7-day challenges against 25 players and win amazing prizes.
No ads mode: You can buy no ads feature now, you can still watch and earn with rewarded ads, you will not see ads in between games if you buy it.
Immerse Yourself in the World of Tonk:
"Tonk - Classic Card Game" isn't just a game; it's a journey into a world where strategy, skill, and excitement meet. Download now and become part of a thriving global community of Tonk (or Tunk) players!
Note: This game is intended for an adult audience and does not offer real-money gambling or opportunities to win real money or prizes. Practice or success at this game does not imply future success at real money gambling.

Merg
bluejetty:00087049:ios.description:
Do you love to cook and merge? Do you want to discover funny, romantic stories about your restaurant and make it more beautiful? So, do you want to make your dream come true? If the answer is yes, then Merge Resto is the game for you!
Merge Resto is the game that combines cooking and merging, giving you hours of entertainment and creativity. You will play as a talented chef, cook delicious dishes and collect weird ingredients. You also can follow the funny stories about your restaurant and help it restore its unique beauty.
In Merge Resto, you can:
_ Explore hundreds of different types of food from pizza, hamburger, sushi, cake, ice cream and more by merging and matching various types of raw material. You will be able to create new and unique dishes. Enjoy the fun of discovering new things!
_ Cook delicious dishes and serve your customers. You will interact with cute characters and join in humorous conversations. You will learn about their stories and also receive compliments and items from them.
_ Upgrade your restaurant by collecting unique and rare ingredients. You will have the freedom to decorate and refurbish your restaurant according to your preferences. You will have a wide range of choices from many types of furniture, paintings, plants and more. You can make your restaurant a cozy and luxurious place.
_ Join in challenges to unlock new areas. You need to plan to complete the challenge quickly and efficiently. You can discover the secrets behind your restaurant and the surprises that await you.
_ Enjoy bright graphics and lively sound effects, giving you the feeling of being in a real restaurant. You will admire the beautiful and detailed images of the dishes, fruits, sweets, ice cream and more. You will hear the vivid and rich sounds of cooking, customers, background music and more.
_ Participate in special events daily and weekly to get great things.
>>> Merge Resto is a completely free game, suitable for all ages. You can play anytime, anywhere. With merge games, cooking games with a litle bit of stories, you will never get bored. Download Merge Resto right now and start your cooking and merging adventure!

ArtScan is the ultimate art app for museum visitors and art lovers.
It lets you instantly identify artworks, extract label details, and build your own curated museum log in one simple experience.
Whether you are exploring a museum, gallery, or private exhibition, ArtScan helps you stay organized and inspired. No more scattered photos or forgotten names — every piece you capture becomes part of a neatly organized personal archive.
Key Features
- AI Art Identification: Scan any painting or artwork to reveal its title, artist, and details in seconds.
- Label Recognition: Take a photo of an artwork’s label — the app automatically extracts and saves the text using AI.
- Smart Organization: Each artwork and its details are stored as a card in your personal collection for easy browsing and search.
- Museum Map: Explore your art journey over time via the Map tab.
- Personal Art Archive: Build a lasting record of the artworks that inspire you — neatly categorized and searchable anytime.
- Modern, Minimal Design: An elegant interface made for art lovers who value simplicity and beauty.
*All features described above require a subscription*

bluejetty:00062368:ios.name: Learn Chess with Dr. Wolf
bluejetty:00062368:ios.summary: Looking to learn how to play chess? Meet Dr. Wolf, the ideal chess coach and companion. Dr. Wolf explains everything to you step-by-step, points out strategic ideas, and alerts you to your mistakes. Whether you are a chess beginner eager to
bluejetty:00062368:ios.description:
Looking to learn how to play chess? Meet Dr. Wolf, the ideal chess coach and companion. Dr. Wolf explains everything to you step-by-step, points out strategic ideas, and alerts you to your mistakes. Whether you are a chess beginner eager to learn the basics or an intermediate player looking to refine your strategy, Dr. Wolf tailors the learning experience to your individual needs, offering over 50 comprehensive chess lessons and interactive guidance at every step.
**Why Choose Learn Chess with Dr. Wolf?**
- **Personalized Coaching:** Experience the unique teaching method of Dr. Wolf, who not only instructs but also plays alongside you, providing insights into every move. He will introduce topics to you as you play chess, ensuring you grasp the “why” behind each move.
- **Audible Coaching**: Dr. Wolf speaks out-loud. Actual audio! Experience the unique advantage of having Dr. Wolf speak to you while you look at the board, offering clear, spoken explanations for every move.
- **A Comprehensive Chess Curriculum:** Engage with an extensive suite of over 50 interactive chess lessons. Starting from foundational concepts, you'll progress through to advanced strategies and tactics, all structured to enhance your understanding and performance in chess.
- **Mistake Correction and Practice:** Learn from your mistakes in a constructive environment. Dr. Wolf remembers all your moves and goes over them again with you so you don’t make the same mistakes again.
- **Diverse Coaching Personalities:** Choose from four distinct coach profiles, each with a unique voice, teaching style and personality. You’ll be sure to find the right chess coach for you.
- **Gradual Learning of Chess Vocabulary:** Expand your vocabulary and understanding of key terms and concepts at a comfortable pace.
- **Adaptive Difficulty Level:** Choose from a variety of skill levels, ensuring you're always challenged but never overwhelmed.
- **Multilingual Support**: Available in English, Spanish, French, and German.
**Learn the game and how to win.**
"Learn Chess with Dr. Wolf" blends comprehensive lessons, personalized feedback, and interactive learning, offering a standout experience for those new to chess or aiming to enhance their skills. Whether your goal is to understand chess better, win more games, or simply enjoy this timeless strategy game more deeply, Dr. Wolf is here to guide you every step of the way.
---------------------------------------------
Dr. Wolf will coach you for free for 3 games of chess so that you can appreciate his style of in-game teaching. Then, to continue learning, you can subscribe to Coaching. With Coaching, Dr. Wolf teaches while you play chess, pointing out good moves and bad — both yours and his — and the reasoning behind them. At times, he'll gently suggest you reconsider a move, or ask a question at a critical moment. Plus, you get unlimited hints, unlimited undos, and unlimited access to our Lesson Library, with over thirty lessons in Dr. Wolf's unique style. Whether or not you choose to subscribe, Dr. Wolf will always play with you. He loves chess too much to turn down a good game.
** TERMS & DETAILS **
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged the same amount for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a Free Trial, if offered, is forfeited when you buy a subscription.
Prices may vary by location.
Terms of Use: https://www.learnchesswithdrwolf.com/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.learnchesswithdrwolf.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00124368:ios.description:
Plaats het hoogste bod en sleep de winst binnen! 
Op VakantieVeilingen winnen miljoenen gebruikers al jaren de leukste veilingen. 
Van een dagje sauna tot pretparktickets. 
Met je bod bepaal je zelf de prijs en bieden kan al vanaf € 1. En wat een kick als je wint! 
Gelukkig hoef je via de app nooit meer een veiling te missen en plaats je snel het hoogste bod voor de tijd om is. 
Voordelen van meespelen in de app:
• Zet het veilingalarm aan en ontvang een pushbericht vlak voordat de veiling afloopt
• Blijf via inboxberichten op de hoogte van de nieuwste acties en veilingen
• Bied extra snel mee, waar je ook bent
• Betaal en reserveer gemakkelijk via je smartphone
• Altijd en overal toegang tot jouw gewonnen veilingen en e-tickets
Hoe werkt VakantieVeilingen?
Je maakt gratis en eenvoudig een account aan. Hierna begint je zoektocht. 
Kijk rond tussen de 1000-en veilingen en kies je favoriet. 
Ga de strijd aan tegen andere bieders en plaats voor de tijd om is het hoogste bod. Score! 
Betaal jouw gewonnen veiling, download je waardebon of ticket en/of maak een reservering. 
Veel plezier!

- Guided tools to calm anxiety and cope with overthinking
- Helpful meditation app features for daily practice
- Daily anxiety relief to reduce stress 
- Panic attack relief
- Space to understand and process negative thoughts
- Therapeutic activities created with mental health experts
- Gentle support for clearing mental fog and grounding your emotions

bluejetty:00092044:ios.name: Charge HQ
bluejetty:00092044:ios.summary:
Charge HQ reduces your charging costs by charging your EV from your own solar or off-peak energy from the grid, whilst ensuring your vehicle is charged each day. Charge HQ works with the equipment you already have.
WORKS WITH EXISTING EQUI
bluejetty:00092044:ios.description:
Charge HQ reduces your charging costs by charging your EV from your own solar or off-peak energy from the grid, whilst ensuring your vehicle is charged each day. Charge HQ works with the equipment you already have.
WORKS WITH EXISTING EQUIPMENT
 * Tesla owners and all other EVs connected to supported wall chargers can use Charge HQ with no additional equipment.
CHARGE FROM YOUR ROOFTOP SOLAR
 * Charge HQ talks directly to your rooftop solar inverter or home battery to understand how much excess solar is available for EV charging.
 * Charging is controlled to match the available generation from your solar system.
INTELLIGENT GRID TOP-UPS
 * Where insufficient solar energy exists during the day, Charge HQ can top up from the grid during off-peak periods to ensure you have sufficient charge for your daily driving.
BENEFITS
 * Helps you charge from the cheapest and greenest sources of energy
 * Improves the payback on rooftop solar systems
 * Supports the development of more renewable energy generation
 * Reduces fossil fuel use in EV charging
CHARGE STATS
* View your charging history (kWh) by day, month or year.
* For those with solar, you can view the breakdown of where the charging energy came from: solar, battery or the grid.
(*) SUPPORTED EQUIPMENT
Current compatibility includes:
 * Direct EV support: Tesla
 * Wall Chargers: ABB, Circontrol, Delta, EO, Fronius, Keba, MG ChargeHub, Ocular IQ, Schneider, Wallbox, ZJ Beny and more
 * Solar Inverters: Fronius, GoodWe, Growatt, SolarEdge, Solax, Solis, Sungrow, Tesla
 * Home Batteries: Tesla Powerwall and most batteries connected to supported solar inverters
 * Energy Monitors: Solar Analytics, Wattwatchers

Celebrate Halloween with our limited-time updates
R.L. Stine's "Goosebumps" monsters have come to terrify your phone! You choose whether to join or fight Slappy the Dummy in this creepy build simulator! In Goosebumps HorrorTown, you can build a gruesome city full of mystery and fill it with scary undead monsters from the horror book series. The most frightening and demented villains await for you: are you brave enough to face your grisly terrors?
The game features original content that will terrify and delight Goosebumps fans, with animations and missions for both humans and monsters in this city builder. The more experience you gain, the more new content you unlock, including bloody creatures or spooky buildings to get new resources. Make your town grow and discover chillingly fun new adventures! Stop the evil creatures that fill this villa as if it was Halloween from unleashing the worst havoc and survive!
BEWARE... YOU CHOOSE YOUR SIDE!

 - Over 100 playable characters! A nasty mummy coming from its tomb, a bloody phantom in search of vengeance or an evil gnome that will curse the neighborhood!

Monta Charge is the digital companion for any EV lifestyle, which makes own
bluejetty:00085219:ios.description:
Stay in control of your EV charging experience—at home and on the go. No monthly subscription, 100% free. Winner of best EV app/software at E-Mobility Awards 2023.
Monta Charge is the digital companion for any EV lifestyle, which makes owning an electric vehicle an exciting and hassle-free ride. Whether at home or on the road, we cover all the bases, ensuring you have complete control of your charging experience. With Monta, you just need one app for all your charging needs, no matter where your journey takes you.
New to the EV lifestyle or an EV pro? Either way, you're in good hands with us. We’re here to make sure your charging experience is as seamless and convenient as possible. Just sit back and enjoy your EV; we'll take care of the rest.
Your home, your charger, your rules
An effortless EV experience starts right at home. With Monta Charge, you have the power to customise your charging settings to match your lifestyle and enjoy set-and-forget charging.
- Choose between 400 charger models that fits your needs and budget best
- Own and manage up to 3 charge points at multiple locations
- Share your charger with family, friends, and neighbours and set rules for when and who can access it
- Charge greener and cheaper: schedule charges to automatically start when electricity prices and CO2 emissions are at their lowest
- Integrate your car with Monta to see your car’s current battery level, whether the cable is plugged in, or if your car is currently charging
- Track your EV's charge history, monitor its performance, and gain insights into your energy spending and usage patterns
Your digital companion for seamless EV charging anywhere
Heading to work, running errands, or going on a road trip? Monta Charge keeps you in the driver’s seat at all times. Hit the road without hesitation, knowing you’re covered by a vast network of accessible charge points, transparent pricing, and flexible payment options.
- Quickly locate any of the 650,000+ supported public chargers on the Monta map and easily get directions with Google Maps and Apple Maps
- Filter charge points by availability, charge speed (kW), price (dynamic or fixed pricing), operator, and more
- No hidden fees, always see what you’ll pay for upfront: the price breakdown, our cut, and who sets the price
- Scan the QR code on a charger to charge your EV without registration if you’re in a hurry
- Connect to a charger via the Monta Charge app or by tapping an RFID card on the charger;
- Add funds to your Monta Wallet or simply pay via credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, or MobilePay/Vipps (Nordics)
- View all your transactions in one place and keep track of your charging history
- Easily export any receipts and invoices and never worry about misplaced receipts again
There for you 24/7
Looking for some help or have any questions? Don't worry, our amazing support team is just a message away, always ready to assist you whenever you need it.
Join the thriving community of over 200,000 EV enthusiasts who have seamlessly adopted the EV lifestyle with our award-winning Monta Charge app!

bluejetty:00145488:ios.description:
Welcome to Taroter - your key to the mystical Tarot world!
Sometimes, it can be difficult to start the adventure of learning Tarot, but do not worry! Taroter not only makes learning easier, but it also allows you to quickly interpret cards and spreads. Additionally, thanks to the object detection, you may use your camera to scan numerous cards at once and get the whole spread interpretation instantly.
-- Key Features --
* Scan Multiple Cards: 
Scan several cards simultaneously to learn their meanings thanks to the Scanner function. Detect the card, recognize it and get the entire spread meaning instantly.
For now, Taroter only recognizes the Rider-Waite deck.
* Quick Search: 
You can look up a card by name without scanning if you need to know its meaning right away.
* Spotlight Search:
You don't need to launch the app and search for the card - you can launch Spotlight and type the card name to get the basic info. And if you need more details, you can always tap the row to open the app and navigate to the chosen card. 
* Detailed Card Information: 
We spent a huge amount of time to make detailed research about each of the 78 cards and described every detail deeply in the app. 
* Profile:
Customize your profile, check your birthday cards and life path number according to numerology to learn more about yourself.
* Tarot Spreads: 
Create a Tarot spread and save it inside your app. The spreads are automatically interpreted by our app, providing you with thorough information quickly and easily. All you need to do is press the card and tap the button inside the context menu.
* Taroter Premium: 
Access information about your finances, health, feelings, profession, people, places, time, lead time, and more with the premium features.
Begin your Tarot journey today – download Taroter and uncover perspectives you've never seen before.

bluejetty:00096466:ios.summary:
Train your brain in Hexa Word Puzzle: connect words by categories & associations!
Are you a fan of sorting games, tricky word puzzles, or the trending connections word game? Then Hexa Words is exactly what you’ve been searching for! This u
bluejetty:00096466:ios.description:
Train your brain in Hexa Word Puzzle: connect words by categories & associations!
Are you a fan of sorting games, tricky word puzzles, or the trending connections word game? Then Hexa Words is exactly what you’ve been searching for! This unique hexagon word puzzle challenges you to think more deeply, make clever links, and expand your vocabulary while having fun.
Unlike classic word connect or simple word sort games, Hexa Words offers a brand-new mechanic. Each flower-shaped hexagon has its own theme, and your goal is to place words so that they belong to the correct categories. The twist? Every word belongs to two themes at once! For example, “Puma” fits both “Animals” and “Brands.” Only by finding the right intersection can you complete the puzzle.
As you play, you’ll discover how exciting it is to group words into categories, build smart associations, and solve clever logic challenges. It’s more than just a word puzzle game – it’s a journey into connections and associations that sharpen your brain every day.
GAME FEATURES
- A fresh take on word puzzle games and connections games
- Hundreds of levels with unique word associations and categories
- Elegant and visually appealing interface design
- Boosters to help you when you’re stuck
- Perfect mix of fun and brain training
HOW TO PLAY
- Tap on a word cell – it will lift up and turn green.
- Tap on another word to swap their positions.
- Place words so that each flower (hexagon) matches its category.
- When the last correct word is placed, the hexagon fills with glowing rays, and the center becomes brighter.
- Continue until all hexagons are solved correctly.

bluejetty:00177619:ios.summary:

Built for people who live i
bluejetty:00177619:ios.description:
PDF Search reads every word of every document you own and makes it findable in
the time it takes to type. Then it goes further: ask a question in plain words
and get an answer, with the exact pages it came from.
Built for people who live in documents: students, lawyers and researchers.
ASK YOUR DOCUMENTS ANYTHING
AI Chat answers questions about your library in plain language. Ask "can I end
my lease early?" and it searches your documents, reads the pages that matter,
and answers, citing the page each fact came from so you can check it yourself.
• Chat about your whole library, or the one document you are reading
• Every answer carries page references you can tap
• Conversations are saved, so you can pick one up later
• Runs on your device, or on Apple's Private Cloud Compute
AI Chat needs Apple Intelligence: an iPhone 15 Pro or later, or an iPad with an
M-series chip, running iOS 26 or later.
SEARCH THAT RANKS, NOT JUST MATCHES
Ordinary search tells you a word exists somewhere. PDF Search scores every page
on how well it answers you: where the words appear, how close together they
are, whether they land in a heading. The strongest pages come first.
• Results grouped by document, with every matching page and its rank
• Jump straight to the page, your words highlighted in context
• Search everything at once, or narrow to a folder or tag
• Export results to share or keep
LANGUAGE, NOT JUST LETTERS
Indexing uses tokenizing and lemmatization, so search understands the shape of
a word. Look for "hike" and find "hiking"; look for "children" and find
"child". Stems and near matches are covered too.
WORDS LOCKED IN PICTURES
Built-in text recognition reads photographed receipts, scanned contracts and
screenshots of slides, and adds every word to your index, so a picture of a
page is as searchable as the page itself. It covers every language your device
supports.
The built-in scanner turns paper documents, notes and cards into PDFs, reads
them as it goes, and files them with everything else, searchable from the
moment they land.
MORE THAN PDFS
Index PDFs alongside Microsoft Office documents (Word, PowerPoint), iWork files
(Pages, Keynote), rich text, plain text and logs, source code, and pages saved
from the web. Turn any format off to skip it.
KEEP A LARGE LIBRARY IN ORDER
• Folders on device or in iCloud, plus any folder or file you point the app at
• Tags, to cut across folders however you think
• Bookmarks with notes, gathered in one place across every document
• A document's table of contents, to move around a long file quickly
• Highlights and annotations while you read
• Index status at a glance: what is indexed, what is queued
YOUR MAC, IN YOUR POCKET
Run PDF Search on your Mac and sync over Wi-Fi with a single click. Documents
come across with their index intact, so your iPhone or iPad need not do the
work twice.
PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Indexing, text recognition and search happen on your device. No account, no
tracking, and purchases are verified on the device by the App Store.
FREE AND PRO
The free version indexes and searches your documents and opens the top-ranked
result. Pro unlocks everything else:
• AI Chat, with page references
• Search inside images and scans
• Scan paper to PDF
• Plurals, stems and near matches
• Every ranked result, not just the first
• Export, tag and de-duplicate
Pro comes as a monthly or annual subscription, or a one-off lifetime unlock:
one payment, yours for good, no renewals.
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. A
subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the
end of the current period, and renewal is charged within 24 hours of that.
Manage or cancel any time in your Apple Account settings. An unused part of a
free trial is forfeited when a subscription is bought.
Privacy Policy: https://pdfsearch.mozkan.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://pdfsearch.mozkan.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00127077:ios.description:
Unleash the full potential of your photography with Love Photo Collage Creator, an app designed to bring your most cherished memories to life in the most enchanting way possible. 
With an array of the cutest photo editing elements at your disposal, creating high-quality collage art has never been easier or more delightful. Whether it's your favorite snapshots or endearing selfies, Love Photo Collage Creator is your go-to choice for weaving those moments into a masterpiece of memories.
***Discover the Magic Within***
Dive into a selection of the most romantic grids, frames, and photo filters designed to add that special touch of love to your creations. Each element has been carefully selected to ensure your collage looks fantastic and radiates warmth and affection.
***Express Yourself with Love Fonts***
Choose from various love-themed fonts to add a personal touch to your collage. Whether aiming for cute, classy, or somewhere in between, our fonts allow you to express your feelings most fittingly.
***Background Patterns that Speak Volumes***
Set the perfect backdrop for your photos with our astonishing patterns. Whether you prefer something subtle or bold, we have the correct pattern to complement your collage's mood and theme.
***Adorn Your Memories with Cute Stickers***
Decorate your collage with an assortment of cute stickers. From heartwarming to whimsical, these stickers add a layer of charm and personality to every photo.
***Save and Share with Ease***
Once you are satisfied with your creation, you can save it directly from the app and share your love-filled collage on social networks. It's a fantastic way to keep your memories close and share your love story.
***Unlock Your Creativity***
Beyond these features, Love Photo Collage Creator has many tools to ignite your creativity. Transform ordinary photos into extraordinary collages that capture the essence of your relationships and memorable moments.
Embark on a journey of love and creativity with Love Photo Collage Creator. It's always the right time to say, "I love you." What better way to express it than with a uniquely crafted love collage? Prepare to dazzle your beloved with a thoughtful and beautiful gift encapsulating your fondest memories.
Don't wait any longer to celebrate love most artistically. Download Love Photo Collage Creator and start crafting collages that will stand out and be cherished forever. Let every photo tell a story of love, affection, and togetherness with Love Photo Collage Creator - where your creativity meets romance.
----------

bluejetty:00151686:ios.description:
Superpower is your home for health.
Bring your health data into one secure place and turn it into clear, personalized action.
Superpower combines advanced lab testing, AI-powered insights, and clinician-supported care to help you understand what’s happening in your body and what to do next. Get a complete view of your health and a plan tailored to your goals.
Whether you’re focused on prevention, energy, metabolic health, or long-term optimization, Superpower helps you move forward with confidence.
What Superpower helps you do
UNDERSTAND YOUR HEALTH
- Get clear insights from your labs, lifestyle, and health history - without medical jargon
- Identify meaningful patterns across biomarkers, symptoms, lifestyle, and habits
- Upload past lab results and medical records for a complete longitudinal view
- Sync wearables to connect the dots in your health
TEST SMARTER
Memberships include 100+ lab tests per year across
- Heart and metabolic health
- Hormones and thyroid
- Nutrients and inflammation
- Gut and immune health
TRACK PROGRESS
Track progress over time or uncover new insights with on-demand access to specialty tests
- Screen for 50+ cancers
- Gut microbiome analysis
- Men and Women's hormonal health
- Genetic risk for heart disease
- Environmental and heavy metal toxins
GET A CLEAR PLAN
- Turn results into evidence-based protocols for nutrition, activity, supplements, and lifestyle
- Recommendations are personalized to your goals, preferences, and results
- When appropriate, receive guidance on prescription options through licensed clinicians
CLINICIAN-SUPPORTED CARE
- Secure messaging with licensed clinicians
- Ask questions about results, next steps, and follow-up
- Ongoing monitoring and guidance
PRIVATE AND PERSONALIZED AI THAT WORKS FOR YOU
- Private AI chat with full context on your health data
- Understand results, prioritize actions, and decide where to focus next
- Get answers and advice to improve your health
BUILT FOR PREVENTION & LONG-TERM HEALTH
Superpower was developed alongside clinicians and health experts and inspired by high-end concierge medicine - made accessible in a single app. Our goal is to help you stay ahead of issues, not just react to them.
Superpower is available at over 2,000 lab locations across the US, making elite health available for all.
MEDICAL DISCLAIMER
Superpower provides health insights and educational information to support your wellness journey. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider before making medical decisions.
IMPORTANT NOTES
- Superpower is built with privacy and security meeting HIPAA standards
- Superpower does not provide emergency care
- Superpower does not replace a primary care provider
- Medical decisions and prescriptions are handled by licensed clinicians when appropriate

Block Mania: Tap Away – A Strategic Puzzle Challenge!

Each level contains blocks marked with directional arrows. Tap a block to make it instantly move in its arrow’s direction. If there’s nothing blocking its path, the block will exit the level. - Unique Skins: Customize blocks with fun themes like trophies, coins, rockets, and more.
- Move-Limited Pressure: Every tap counts—optimize your strategy to beat the step limit.
- Hammer Power: Smash tricky blocks with hammers.
Perfect for: Puzzle enthusiasts who enjoy tactical thinking, minimalist design, and satisfying problem-solving.

"Whatever you want! Whatever you said!"
"Don't Stop Supporting Me!", a program where contestants have to survive on donations alone on a remote island for a week.
Seven cast members, each with a different purpose, gathered there. 
In the midst of magnificent nature, a refreshing breeze turns into a bloody, gory breeze.
▶About the game
'On Air Island' is set on a mysterious 'remote island' that is full of intrigue. 
It tells the mysterious and horrifying story of the main characters trapped on a remote island.
You are the audience, but you are also the ones who can save or kill the characters as they run for their lives from the dangers that abound on the deserted island. 
Will the cast be able to escape the island's labyrinth that is closing in on them and survive? 
▶Game Story
A remote island has been chosen as a battleground for a stimulating survival program, 
A cast of characters, each with their own reasons for being there, are thrown together. 
"When 'it' calls you, don't look back." 
They have no choice. They must survive. 
But as the night draws in, the darkness draws closer and closer, consuming the cast...
How can they escape the darkness that is getting closer and closer?
Forget the survival programs you've seen before. 
'The world's first live survival stream'. What's at the end of it all?
Recommended for these people!
- Those who like mysterious stories or light novels
- Those who like free-to-play and indie game genres
- Those who are tired of typical story gameplay

bluejetty:00020961:ios.description:
Create your own cute animal avatar and make it completely yours.
Animal Styler is a character dress-up game where you pick an animal, build their look from scratch, and save your creation as a profile picture or share it with friends. Two characters are available right now — Raccoon and Capybara — with more animals on the way in upcoming updates.
MEET THE CHARACTERS
Raccoon — with its signature black eye mask and striped tail, the raccoon brings serious personality to every look. Layer on a backwards cap and streetwear hoodie for a cool midnight city style, or soften it up with pastel ribbons and star wands. The raccoon works in any aesthetic.
Capybara — the internet's most beloved relaxed animal now has its own avatar game. Dress your capybara in a linen apron and flower crown for a cozy cottagecore meadow look, or mix and match hats, outfits and accessories to create something completely original.
HOW IT WORKS
Open the game and choose your character. Use the category tabs to pick a hat, outfit, accessory, held item, expression, background and fur color. Every avatar you save goes straight into your gallery so you can come back and edit anytime. When your look is exactly right, save it to your camera roll or share it directly.
WHAT IS INSIDE
- Two animal characters: Raccoon and Capybara
- Hundreds of accessories across hats, outfits, items, expressions and backgrounds
- Complete themed outfit sets including cottagecore, midnight city and more
- A personal gallery to store and manage all your saved avatars
- Optional premium packs for deeper customization
MORE COMING SOON
New animal characters, seasonal themed sets and additional accessories are in development right now. The next update will bring more characters to the roster — stay tuned.
Download Animal Styler today and start building your perfect animal avatar.

Merge similar stars to create larger ones, craft combo chains, unleash special power-ups and climb to the top of the leaderboard!
- Available for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch!
- Different modes for different folks: Play for the best score in 'Classic' Mode or enjoy a relaxing time in 'Zen' Mode. More modes will be released in the future!
- Not your regular watermelon game : Drop bombs to destroy blocking planets and shake the screen to shuffle the board!

- Share your best snapshots with your friends.
_______________________________
HOW TO PLAY:
- Move the robot with your finger and release to drop the star.
- Use the crown to move the robot and touch the screen to drop the star.
- When two stars of the same type collide, they combine into a larger star.
- Create a combo by combining several stars in a row to earn a higher score!
- Combos fill the "Shake" gauge. When full, shake the screen to shuffle the board.

bluejetty:00184016:ios.description:
APP DESCRIPTION:
The First Secure Community App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact First Secure Community customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the First Secure Community App, you must be enrolled as a First Secure Community Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00182602:ios.description:
Snood is one of the most popular puzzle games of all time. Snood is a fun puzzle game that tests your intellect rather than your reflexes. Your goal is to save all the trapped Snoods by launching other Snoods at them. If you connect three or more Snoods, they will disappear. If that leaves any Snoods not connected to the top of the playing field, they will fall to safety. Don't take too long, though - every Snood you launch increases the danger level. 
Play with the Classic Snoods or "New and Improved" Snoods! 
Snood is simple to learn but difficult to master and therefore great for ages 2 - 102!

bluejetty:00141466:ios.name: Royal Romances - Fortunes
bluejetty:00141466:ios.summary: Step into a captivating world of "Royal Romances: Fortunes and Foes," where hidden object games and adventure collide in an enchanting tale. The reign of cruel King Illeon has come to an end, and peace reigns — but new perils and thrilling
bluejetty:00141466:ios.description:
Step into a captivating world of "Royal Romances: Fortunes and Foes," where hidden object games and adventure collide in an enchanting tale. The reign of cruel King Illeon has come to an end, and peace reigns — but new perils and thrilling adventures await! Test your skills with intricate puzzles and seek and find hidden objects across breathtaking fantasy landscapes. A young dragon appears, and its fate lies in your hands. In a land where every choice shapes destinies, are you ready to seek, find, and immerse yourself in this extraordinary fantasy?
The reign of cruel King Illeon has come to an end. Love triumphed over evil, and peaceful times have returned to the land. But there are new adventures ahead for our heroes. In the depths of the Enchanted Forest, you encounter a dragon. Fear not, it's only a hatchling! What do you do with it? Of course, you cannot tell a single living soul about your lucky find. Especially when a traveling circus has stopped on its way to a performance at the royal palace, attracting the attention of a thousand eyes. Or maybe just enjoy the show!
Shape the Fate of Kingdoms!
Every decision you make will impact the story and alter the course of entire kingdoms. Will you guide the hunter, the fortune teller, and the exiled prince to safety, or lead them down a path of peril? Your choices will determine the future of the magical world!
Solve Intricate Puzzles!
Engage in a variety of casual hidden object games that test your logic and creativity. From mystery games to clever find objects in a picture games, each puzzle is designed to be both rewarding and relaxing. Unlock special achievements as you progress in adventure games!
Collect & Explore!
Explore stunning environments filled with hidden objects and collectibles. From the mystical Enchanted Forest to the vibrant circus, each location is rich with detail. Find unique treasures and hidden secrets that enhance the experience while expanding the game’s world!
Stunning Fantasy World!
Journey through beautifully crafted locations teeming with magical creatures, breathtaking scenery, and intricate world-building. The world of Royal Romances will captivate your imagination and immerse you in its rich atmosphere!
Get ready to immerse yourself in one of the most exciting hidden object games as you find, seek, and unlock the mysteries of Royal Romances with the free trial!

bluejetty:00186404:ios.description:
A long time ago, a lonely little prince was living in an ancient castle.
Every day, he wished he could have a friend! And now, with you, he will!
Let's travel through time and space to accompany the little prince!
Take the magic elevator. Wow! The castle is so big!
Alongside the little prince, you can practice archery outside the castle, learn to cook in the kitchen, take a bath in the bathroom, and feed horses in the horse stable. Do not miss the armor shop! Various options are waiting for you to try on. And in the wild field, hunting is available too!
Various secrets are concealed within the castle. Don't worry; the little prince will accompany you to explore them all.
Super easy controls and attractive animations keep children engaged!
Features
• 6 different regions in the castle; experience ancient lives from different aspects.
• Over 60 fun animations let you discover the beauty in the details!
• Recommended for preschoolers aged 2-5.
• No third-party advertising.
• Works offline.

bluejetty:00043282:ios.description:
The Starbucks UAE App is the easiest way for you to order ahead for pickup and earn Stars every time you purchase your Starbucks favourites - beverage, food, coffee-at-home products, and merchandise at our stores or in-app*.
With every purchase in-app or in-store of your favourite Starbucks food, beverages and Starbucks® merchandise, watch Stars add up towards Free Drinks and special benefits. Get exclusive Rewards member offers sent directly to your inbox. Conveniently find your nearest Starbucks store and view your transaction history with just a tap.
Enhance your Starbucks experience, all on your Starbucks UAE app.
Getting rewarded with Stars is super easy. Here’s how you can get started:
• Download the Starbucks UAE app and register
• When in store, Scan the QR code on your app every time you make a purchase at any participating Starbucks store in UAE to collect Stars; you get 4 Stars for every 10 AED spent!
• View your collected Stars on the home screen of your app
• Redeem Stars across 5 different tiers of Rewards, including drinks, food, and merchandise, starting from 150 Stars.
• More Stars unlock the world of Gold Membership, with free birthday drink and premium offers galore.
Skip the queues and order ahead directly from the App
• Select your store of choice
• Choose your menu items
• Customise to your liking
• Pay on the app and checkout
• Head on to your chosen store and pick up your order
• Collecting Stars? Don’t worry Rewards are built in, so you’ll earn Stars with every purchase
Don’t miss out, be a part of the Starbucks coffee club – Download the Starbucks UAE app now!
*Starbucks UAE app is available for use only at participating Starbucks Stores across UAE.

- No need to register, no any other subscription fees, one-time purchase for lifetime use

bluejetty:00021163:ios.name: Stop Motion Animation Maker
bluejetty:00021163:ios.summary:
The app creates a series of photographs that can be combined into a video and get finished cartoon, animation, or time-lapse at the output.
With the Stop Motion app, You can easily create your cartoon or stop-motion animation just like the
bluejetty:00021163:ios.description:
The app creates a series of photographs that can be combined into a video and get finished cartoon, animation, or time-lapse at the output.
With the Stop Motion app, You can easily create your cartoon or stop-motion animation just like the pros do! Easy shooting and editing even for beginner animators.
Creating cartoons
Take photos of your plasticine, Lego, drawings, and create your cartoons.
Time-lapse photography can be done with anything: Lego, plasticine crafts, drawings, sketches, objects etc.
The application provides a special mode of translucent overlay on the current frame in the camera: you can align objects and determine exactly how to position objects to get the right movement in the frame.
We tried to make intuitive navigation in the app so even 5-years old child could create his cartoon.
Stop motion videos
Easily turn your photos into amazing videos. Use a photo gallery or take photos frame by frame to create movement. Then simply select the photos you want to include in your animation, set the speed, and create your video! You can save the finished video to your smartphone or share it on social networks directly from the Stop Motion app.
The main functionality of the application:
- frame-by-frame photo shooting with further combining the captured photos into a video;
- horizontal and vertical screen orientation;
- image zoom and transparency setting of the previous frame;
- choice of vocalization during the scheme: manual or auto
- viewing the footage;
- the ability to set the frame rate;
- stream export to video format;
The app is ideal for creating cartoons and spending time together between parents and children, as well as creating interesting content on a personal blog!
Time Lapse is a photography technique that allows you to accelerate a video and watch slowly changing events much faster.
We offer subscription plans in the app that unlock premium functions of the app:
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
- Price can depend on location
For more information please visit the link https://support.apple.com/HT202039
Privacy Policy: https://doc.whisperarts.com/policy/stopmotion/ios/
Terms of Use: https://doc.whisperarts.com/terms/stopmotion/ios/
Want to receive the latest news about the application? Subscribe to the newsgroup https://www.facebook.com/WhisperArts

bluejetty:00120687:ios.description:
It’s time to save your Sunday night.
We know the pressure: the blank lesson plans, the late nights, the stress of meeting a million demands. That’s why the Twinkl app exists. Created by specialist teachers who’ve been exactly where you are, it’s here to give you back your time and lighten your planning load.
Need a complete Second Grade science lesson plan, right now? Desperate for a Sixth Grade math test that’s actually aligned to Common Core standards? Wondering how to build a meaningful homeschool curriculum without losing your mind? We get it.
Stop scrambling. You'll find a world of ready-to-go, teacher-made solutions—from complete lesson plans and trusted assessment tools to vibrant classroom displays—all accessible in seconds.
Stop worrying about tomorrow’s lesson. Download the Twinkl app today, and get back to creating those ‘lightbulb’ moments (without staying up until midnight to plan them).
WHY YOU’LL ACTUALLY USE THE TWINKL APP:
You get back your time. Everything is ready-to-go, covering preK-12, so you can spend less time searching and more time teaching.
Curriculum support that actually fits your classroom. We've got Common Core and state curriculum-aligned resources tailored to your needs, wherever you are in the world.
Proudly human created. We don’t use AI to create any of our resources - they’re all created by experienced teachers who understand your needs.
Every subject covered. From math and ELA to science, languages, arts, and specialist resources for SPED and ELL.
Built-in relief for the Admin Overload. Get teacher-made templates and solutions for planning, reporting, and assessment, saving you hours every week.
Plan on the fly. Spotted the perfect resource during your five-minute break? Use the 'save for later' function and access it instantly from your account when you’re ready.
No Wi-Fi? No problem. Download and print your resources straight from your mobile device, so you can teach even when the signal gives up.
Make learning spark. Get interactive and AR resources, games, and puzzles perfect for those students who need a different way to learn.
Your new teaching partner. Get personalized suggestions, and find the perfect resource before you even start looking.
We help everyone who teaches. Whether you're in the classroom, a home educator, tutor, or parent, if you're helping a child learn, this is for you.
HOW TO GET STARTED:
Download the Twinkl app for free on your phone or tablet, and log in with your membership details for instant, full access. (Yes, you need a Twinkl membership to access the resources.)
Got a question? Don't worry. Our lovely TwinklCares team is here 24/7 to help. And yes, you can always speak to a real human!
Join our incredible community of educators worldwide. Your feedback is what keeps us going, so if you have any problems or want to see a new feature, don't hesitate to tell us.
Privacy Policy: https://www.twinkl.com/legal#privacy-policy
Terms and Conditions: https://www.twinkl.com/legal#terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00027317:ios.description:
Journey into historical Japan!
In the tumultuous realm of feudal Japan, where the spirit of the samurai reigns supreme, embark on a perilous quest for survival. Amidst the chaos of war and the fight for power in the Sengoku era, you must harness your skills and ingenuity to navigate the treacherous landscapes.
• Craft Your Way to Victory
As a skilled craftsman, transform the raw materials of nature into tools, weapons, and shelter. Gather wood from forests, mine precious metals, and harvest bountiful crops. With each crafted item, enhance your chances of survival and bolster your warrior spirit.
• Build Your Indestructible Fortress
From humble beginnings, construct your own fortified village, a testament to your resilience and resourcefulness. Walls will rise to protect you from marauding bandits, while sturdy structures will house your crafting stations and provide a haven for weary travelers.
• Explore the Untamed Wilderness
Venture into uncharted territories, where dangers lurk around every corner. Encounter evil predators, engage in epic clashes with rival clans, and navigate treacherous environments. Each challenge you overcome will strengthen your resolve and bring you closer to mastering the Way of the Samurai.
• Unleash Your Inner Warrior
When the call of battle echoes through the valleys, wield your katana with unmatched skill, defending your honor and protecting those under your care. Master the art of sword fighting, employing swift and deadly maneuvers, and unleash devastating ultimate skills to kill your foes.
• Embrace the Bushido
The Bushido is a path of unwavering determination, meticulous craftsmanship, and unwavering courage. Embrace the challenges, hone your skills, and forge your destiny in this epic survival adventure.

bluejetty:00073600:ios.name: Haqibat Elmomen
bluejetty:00073600:ios.summary:
Haqibat Elmomen: everything a believer needs through the day, packed into one bag.
Prayer times and adhan alerts, the Holy Quran, supplications and visitations, the Qibla, a masbaha and the Hijri calendar, in one calm, clear app.
HOLY QURA
bluejetty:00073600:ios.description:
Haqibat Elmomen: everything a believer needs through the day, packed into one bag.
Prayer times and adhan alerts, the Holy Quran, supplications and visitations, the Qibla, a masbaha and the Hijri calendar, in one calm, clear app.
HOLY QURAN
• Three ways to read: Mushaf pages, continuous, or text pages.
• An English translation beneath every verse, with a detailed tafsir a tap away.
• Listen to recitations by renowned reciters.
• Search by surah, verse or page number, and browse by surah or juz.
• Bookmarks, and pick up exactly where you stopped.
• Share verses as beautiful images.
PRAYER TIMES & ADHAN
• Accurate prayer times for your location.
• An adhan alert for each prayer, on or off with a tap, with your choice of muezzin.
• A countdown to the next prayer and a monthly timetable.
• Options to fine-tune how prayer times are calculated.
SUPPLICATIONS & VISITATIONS
• More than 700 texts: supplications, visitations, dhikr, deeds and prayers.
• Supplications for each day, night and hour, with today's on the app's home page.
• A comfortable reader: choose the font, size and colors, with auto-scroll and a tasbih counter inside the text.
MASBAHA
• Tasbih al-Zahra, open tasbih, and tasbihs of your own, also on Apple Watch.
RAKAAT COUNTER
• An answer to forgetfulness in prayer: place your phone just in front of where you prostrate, and it counts every rakaat and sujood.
QIBLA
• A precise, smooth compass, with an augmented-reality (AR) view.
• Extra directions: Holy Karbala, Holy Najaf, Al-Kadhimiyya, Al-Madinah, and the shrines of Sayyida Zainab and Imam al-Ridha (peace be upon them).
HIJRI CALENDAR
• The Islamic calendar for the Hijri year, with each month's occasions.
• Convert dates between Hijri and Gregorian.
WALLPAPERS
• A large collection of high-quality wallpapers: shrines, mosques, the Holy Kaaba, Islamic occasions and more, with search and favorites.
VISITORS GUIDE
• Find and save the places a visitor needs, with a step counter for the walk.
ALSO INCLUDED
• Favorites: the verses, supplications and wallpapers you love, in one place.
• A Home Screen widget with the next prayer and the Hijri date.
• An Apple Watch app for prayer times and tasbih.
• A layout made for iPad, dark mode, and three languages: Arabic, English and Persian.
All rights reserved.
