bluejetty:00062335:ios.description:
LEARN GUITAR – LESSONS WITH 4,5M+ HAPPY STUDENTS
Learn guitar easily with Justin Guitar, the ultimate guitar learning app, created by the world’s best guitar teacher - JUSTIN SANDERCOE.
Trusted by millions of learners, Justin’s proven method guides you from your first chord to your favorite songs – with real results that users love!
Designed for complete beginners, this app leverages on Justin’s 20+ years of teaching experience and makes learning guitar simple and fun.
WHY YOU’LL LOVE JUSTIN GUITAR 
1. Learn with a Proven Method
- Structured learning path that guides you step-by-step 
- Keeps you practicing consistently from absolute beginner to confident player
- Course level covers beginner Grades 1, 2 & 3!
2. Engaging, Bite-Size Lessons
- 210 video lessons (36+ hours total) designed for all beginners
- Short, easy-to-follow modules that fit any schedule
- Learn what to practice, how long, and when to progress
- Daily Practice Routine combines all key exercises into a simple 10-minute plan
3. Interactive Tools for Real Progress
- Interactive exercises to strengthen your skills
- One-Minute-Chord Change exercises for speed and accuracy
- Color-chord system for faster chord learning
- Easy-to-use guitar tuner
- Progress tracking to keep your learning journey on track
4. Play Songs You Love
- Over 1,500 hit songs 
- New songs added regularly
- Module songs matched to your skill level
- Songbook with chords filter
- Create playlists, auto-play, and share
NEW SONG PLAYER UI
- Enhanced visuals and smoother navigation
- See the next chord with diagram or the strumming pattern 
- Display lyrics for easier sing-along
- Play with a full band sound and optional vocals for a “real stage” experience
- Adjustable tempo – slow down or speed up songs to practice at your own pace
- Strumming pattern exercises – practice and adjust strumming along with the song
YOUR PERSONAL GUITAR TEACHER
Justin’s friendly, engaging style makes learning fun and structured. Even tricky skills like chord changes and strumming feel easy to master — like having a personal guitar trainer.
EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO LEARN GUITAR IN ONE APP
All your guitar tools in one place: lessons, practice routines, songbook with chord filter, tuner, and a beginner-friendly song player. Learn, practice, and play your favorite songs while tracking your progress and building confidence every day.
Millions of learners worldwide love how Justin Guitar makes guitar simple and effective — start your journey today and see how far you can go!
We’d love to hear your feedback - email us at justin.ios.feedback@musopia.net
*Not optimized for Apple Mac*
*Minimum requirements for this app:
- iPhone 6S or later (2015+)
- iPad 5th generation or later (2017+)
- iPad mini 4th generation or later (2015+)
- iPad Air 2nd generation or later (2014+)
- iPad Pro (2015+)
- iOS 15.0 or later
Important subscription information
Justin Guitar offers several FULL ACCESS subscription packages that unlock unlimited access to the entire song collection of Playground and all the stages of the Guitar Learning Path. New song releases are also included.
Subscription purchases are charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of the purchase. All subscriptions will AUTOMATICALLY be renewed unless the auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Your iTunes account will be charged a renewal price equal to that of the original subscription within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renew by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. Subscriptions are non-refundable and may not be cancelled during an active subscription period.
Our privacy policy can be found at http://musopia.net/justin-privacypolicy
Terms of use: https://musopia.net/terms

bluejetty:00131683:ios.description:
Buy and sell new or used airsoft gear on the largest airsoft-only marketplace. HopUp is the best way to buy, sell, and explore the airsoft community, with Purchase Protection included free on everything you buy through HopUp Payments.
FOR BUYERS
PURCHASE PROTECTION GUARANTEE
Receive your item as described or your money back. It is included free on every item you buy through HopUp Payments, and the seller is not paid until 3 days after delivery or you write a review, whichever comes first.
FIND THE GEAR YOU WANT
Search new and used gear from players across the country. Filter by distance and condition, sort by price, browse by category, and switch between used listings and brand-new retail items. Favorite items to keep an eye on them and set keyword alerts so you know the moment what you want gets listed.
BUY NOW, MAKE AN OFFER, OR BID
Check out in seconds with a card or Apple Pay. Make an offer on most items and the seller can accept it right in your messages, or bid in live auctions.
KNOW YOUR SELLER
Every seller profile shows their star rating, reviews, vouchers from other players, and how long they have been on HopUp.
FOR SELLERS
LIST FOR FREE, PAY ONLY WHEN IT SELLS
Add up to 10 photos and a short demo video, set your price, and publish in minutes. There is no listing fee. A selling fee applies only when your item sells. Alternatively, pay a small fee upfront for the listing and accept payment outside of HopUp on your own terms. 
LISTING COACH
Get live tips while you write your listing: what to include, what buyers look for, and data-backed nudges like adding more photos so your item sells faster.
OFFERS THAT WORK FOR YOU
Accept offers of 50% or more of your asking price, and let HopUp automatically send a discount to buyers who favorited your item if it has not sold yet.
DISCOUNTED, INSURED SHIPPING LABELS
Buy a USPS, UPS, or FedEx label right from the sale at heavily discounted rates, insured for the full value of your item, with tracking added automatically. Prefer your own label? Add the tracking number or snap a photo of your receipt.
SELLER PROTECTION AND FAST PAYOUTS
You are protected from chargebacks and fraudulent buyers. Payouts are sent 3 days after delivery or as soon as the buyer leaves a review, and instant transfers are available.
SELLER TOOLS
Track how your listings perform with seller analytics, list multiple quantities of the same item, share your seller profile, and build your reputation with ratings & reviews.
PRIVACY - BUILT IN MESSAGING
Built-in messaging with photos and video, so there is no need to share personal contact info to discuss a deal.
A SAFER PLACE TO TRADE GEAR
Listings are reviewed by our team, every in-app report goes straight to us, and our support team is a message away, typically replying within 24 hours.
WE WANT YOUR FEEDBACK
Feedback is what drives us to improve HopUp. To suggest a feature or report a bug, use Send Feedback under Settings or email us at support@hopupairsoft.com.
*HopUp is for airsoft only and we do not tolerate the sale of firearms, ammunition, knives or ballistic-rated body armor.

HopUp Premium is only $9.99/month: priority listing bumps, instant approval for your listings, and more. Try HopUp Premium free for 1 month as an introductory offer.
HopUp uses AI to assist with the Listing Coach, Reviewing items listed for sale and more. 
Terms of service: hopupairsoft.com/terms

• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase

bluejetty:00093993:ios.name: B3 Share
bluejetty:00093993:ios.summary: With the B3 Share app, you can easily share your way to success with tools that create word-of-mouth buzz and complement belly-to-belly efforts! Connect with new contacts and interact with your team by sharing exclusive, corporate-approved
bluejetty:00093993:ios.description:
With the B3 Share app, you can easily share your way to success with tools that create word-of-mouth buzz and complement belly-to-belly efforts! Connect with new contacts and interact with your team by sharing exclusive, corporate-approved tools. You’ll have a vast array of marketing materials like videos, images, and more—all right at your fingertips! The powerful, yet beautifully simple design, along with compelling tools, makes growing your business simpler than ever.
Contacts: Choose how to sync and manage your contacts. Swipe to sort them by interest level. You can make connections, add notes, or check out the Contact Feed to see the tools you’ve shared and contact actions.
Tools: It has never been easier to share information about your products and opportunity via SMS text, email, or social media. Simply choose tools specifically designed to promote your business and share them with a contact. You’ll receive a notification when contacts view a tool, so you know exactly when to follow up! You can even add your own tools. Record or upload short videos to share with prospects. You can even add actions to your videos so prospects can interact directly in the video. These smarter interactive tools are called a Brightool, and they provide more data for follow-up with ActionAlert notifications in the Feed. No data connection? No problem! Simply download tools such as videos in the app beforehand for offline playback.
Business: Access helpful links to build your business.
Settings: Our simple Share Setup will help you upload a profile picture, define your ‘why’ in your bio, and add other info that will help contacts connect with you and learn more about your business and products. You can also configure notification preferences, watch QuickTips to learn about the app, and more.
Learn: Empowering users by providing simple
 and effective training courses, lessons, quizzes, awards, and more.
With videos, images, PDFs, quotes, and more built into the lessons, you can learn more than ever and have fun while doing it.

bluejetty:00170030:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00170030:ios.description:
MDLA is a new kind of fashion magazine, designed for how we consume fashion online today.
Many of us born in an online generation can only sigh in nostalgia at the glamour and wonder of print fashion magazines from the early 2000s. As the world moved online, the once iconic fashion media companies failed to evolve - they gave us lazy pdfs to browse on slow and buggy e-readers as Inst*gr*m took over to give us the fast immersive content we wanted. Their disinterest in the preservation of beauty online is clear and it’s time we had a new medium to explore and appreciate fashion for fashion’s sake. MDLA is an experiment to revive the glory of early fashion media re-imagined through powerful online media technology from present day.
MDLA Runway brings you a variety of powerful features you’d expect from a modern fashion runway viewer:
* Intuitive Interface - Flip through runway looks with a simple swipe or drag. Jump through to your favorite designer’s early years with just a tap and slide. No endless scroll, no ads, no interruptions
* Powerful Search - Search for your favorite collections down to their specific year and season. Find archive collections by your favorite designers from their early years and from labels they previously worked at. Don’t worry about typos or using shorthands - we know what you mean :)
* Lightning Fast - Browse high resolution look images from the runway loaded in a flash of a second
* Smart Boards - Generate moodboards based on any style, color or vibe even if its super descriptive. Automatically filter your favorite designer or label to collect powerful references in an instant.
* 3D Showcase - Play around with high resolution 3D captures of rare archive “grail” pieces complete with added context from its rich fashion history and references from its original collection for you to explore and learn
* Immersive Editorials - Explore our selection of hand-curated stories of iconic archive pieces, profiles of in vogue runway designers, lost fashion techniques and striking editorial campaigns
Our catalog features thousands of collections dating back to the early 90s from the most iconic names in fashion
Browse the archives from your favorite labels: Dior - Gucci - Louis Vuitton - Prada - Balenciaga - Saint Laurent - Margiela
As well as your favorite designers: Raf Simons - Rick Owens - Tom Ford - Alexander McQueen - Hedi Slimane - Virgil Abloh - Issey Miyake
MDLA is for high fashion followers, meticulous moodboard makers, archive fashion collectors, y2k fashion magazine enjoyers, small town gossip girl lovers, vintage fashion shoppers, aesthetics respecters, ‘it’ girls, clout guys, connoisseurs, hobbyists, tasteful amateurs and most importantly, you :)

bluejetty:00088300:ios.description:
Authenticator App enhances your online security with a simple yet powerful tool for protecting your accounts. Designed for iPhone users, our Authenticator App ensures protection for your accounts across all major platforms, making it a reliable Authenticator App.
Our Authenticator App delivers robust Two Factor Authentication (2FA) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) solutions to safeguard your data. Whether you're logging into social media, managing sensitive work accounts, or accessing personal services, this Authenticator ensures your accounts remain protected from unauthorized access.
Advanced Security with Two Factor Authentication
Enhance your security with Two Factor Authentication (2FA). With our 2FA Authenticator, you get a second layer of security by requiring a unique code generated by the Authenticator App in addition to your password.
Features That Set Our Authenticator Apart
1. Universal Compatibility: Whether you’re using Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, or any other 2FA Authenticator, our app is designed to integrate seamlessly.
3. Time-Based One-Time Passwords (TOTP): The app generates time-sensitive codes for maximum security.
4. Multiple Device Syncing: Back up and sync your codes across devices to ensure access anytime, anywhere.
5. Offline Functionality: Generate codes without wifi, making it a true standalone Authenticator App.
6. Multi-Account Management: Manage all your 2FA-enabled accounts in one place, from Google and Microsoft to smaller, independent services.
As a Authenticator App, we understand the importance of supporting both individuals and businesses. With support for MFA Authenticators, this app is ideal for securing corporate tools like Salesforce, Azure, and GitHub, as well as personal services like Facebook, Spotify, and Netflix.
Perfect Replacement for Other Authenticators
Looking for an alternative to Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, or Authy? Our Authenticator App is designed to provide the same high-quality security features while adding enhanced functionality and ease of use. Its intuitive interface makes it the perfect choice for anyone, from tech enthusiasts to those new to Two Factor Authentication.
Why Two Factor Authentication Is Essential
In today’s digital landscape, cyber threats are more prevalent than ever. Passwords alone are no longer sufficient to protect sensitive information. That’s where Two Factor Authentication (2FA) and MFA come in. By using a trusted 2FA Authenticator like ours, you can ensure the highest level of security for your online accounts.
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) is the next level of security, combining passwords, device authentication, and Authenticator App codes to create an impenetrable barrier against hackers. Whether you’re using MFA Authenticator for work or personal accounts, our app offers the flexibility and reliability you need.
The Authenticator App seamlessly integrates with Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Salesforce Authenticator, Authy, and more. It works perfectly with widely used services such as:
* Facebook
* Spotify
* Instagram
* Amazon
* Dropbox
* Twitter
* LinkedIn
* PayPal
* Slack
* More
Wherever Two Factor Authentication is supported, this Authenticator App will work flawlessly.
Download the Authenticator App today and experience the future of Two Factor Authentication and MFA Authenticators. With compatibility across major companies like Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Facebook, for keeping your accounts safe.

- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account once you confirm the purchase.
- Your subscription will automatically renew unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage subscriptions in your iPhone settings.

I AM GROOT

DAILY, WEEKLY, & MONTHLY UPDATES
MARVEL SNAP stays fresh and exciting with new cards, new locations, new cosmetics, new season passes, new ranked seasons, new challenges, new missions, and new events regularly. You don't have to wait months for updates! 
What are you waiting for? This strategy CCG game only takes a few minutes to learn and 3-minutes to play. Earn the most power in your location and use a winning strategy to dominate the battle. Download today to see why MARVEL SNAP has won multiple 'Mobile Game of the Year' awards!

Build your deck and harness the power of different abilities from MARVEL Super Heroes or Villains, and outsmart your opponent in 3 minutes or less with a winning strategy. This fast-paced CCG has weekly updates and cross-platform play, making the card game easy to pick up but hard to put down, whether you play on PC or mobile. 

The innovative "SNAP" is a unique mechanic in the game that lets you raise the stakes during a match and apply pressure on your opponent. If you think you have a winning hand, use the 'SNAP' mechanic to double down and potentially double your rewards.

Quickly become the master of the multiverse when you download the fast–paced MARVEL SNAP card game! 

MARVEL SNAP APP FEATURES:

PLAY 3-MINUTE GAMES & WIN IN MARVEL SNAP
- Every game lasts 3 minutes. We cut the fluff to focus on quick games and pure strategy!
- Each player begins with a FREE starter deck that helps you get started on your journey. There are no energy barriers, no ads, and no limits to your play!
- Play card games at your own pace, unlock your favorite MARVEL characters, and discover hundreds of new ones as you earn new cards.
- “SNAP” mechanic strategy - Apply pressure to your opponents using this innovative feature, and potentially double your rewards.

MARVEL CCG WITH VARIETY
- This MARVEL-themed card game is designed so that every match feels different. 
- Play with cards at 50+ different locations from across the MARVEL Universe, each with iconic game-changing abilities. 
- From Asgard to Wakanda, new locations are introduced regularly to put your creative problem-solving skills to the test.
- Weekly updates: Access new cards, new locations, new cosmetics, new season passes, new ranked seasons, new challenges, new missions, and new events regularly.

CROSS-PLATFORM PLAY 
- Available on both mobile AND Desktop PC. 
- Play anywhere, at any time, when you register your account.
- Your progress stays with you across different platforms. 

BUILD YOUR DECK & COLLECT CARDS
- Each card in your deck is a unique character from the MARVEL Multiverse. 
- Collect, mix, and match hundreds of MARVEL hero and villain art variants from the entire MARVEL Universe—and beyond. You might have a classic comic-inspired Iron Man card, but do you also have the Chibi, 8-bit, and Cartoon variants?

I AM GROOT
I am Groot. I AM Groot. I am GROOT. I am Groot? I am Groot. I AM GROOT! I am GROOT. I am Groot? 

DAILY, WEEKLY, & MONTHLY UPDATES
MARVEL SNAP stays fresh and exciting with new cards, new locations, new cosmetics, new season passes, new ranked seasons, new challenges, new missions, and new events regularly. You don't have to wait months for updates! 

What are you waiting for? This strategy CCG game only takes a few minutes to learn and 3-minutes to play. Earn the most power in your location and use a winning strategy to dominate the battle. Download today to see why MARVEL SNAP has won multiple 'Mobile Game of the Year' awards!

bluejetty:00068298:ios.description:
Numbr is a private phone number app specifically designed for iPhone to protect the user's privacy. It is a simple and inexpensive way for those who need a disposable number to make international and domestic calls, send text messages or to have an anonymous backup number for everyday situations. No contracts, transparent fees, absolute privacy.
NO HASSLES
Our numbers come without a contract. You don’t need a cell phone plan or another device to use your second phone number.
SIMPLE INSTRUCTIONS
Using your second phone number with Numbr is super-simple. Purchase a number, recharge credits and start calling or texting immediately.
TRANSPARENT FEES
Number calling and texting fees are as transparent as possible. By using the in-app Tariff calculator, you can check the cost per minute for outgoing and incoming calls or messages based on a specific country.
UNRESTRICTED OWNERSHIP
Purchase and keep your number for as long as you need or dispose of them anytime.
Use Numbr in everyday situations:
• Buying or selling things on Craigslist, eBay, or other e-commerce platforms
• Dating
• Hosting apartments on Airbnb
• Using Uber
• Applying for a job
• Working (e.g. as a second work number)
Phone numbers available in: USA, Canada, Sweden. 
PRICING
Numbr is free to download and comes with 20 free credits. Phone numbers and additional credits are available through subscriptions and in-app purchases.
Subscriptions for phone numbers:
• Weekly subscription
• Monthly subscription
• Yearly subscription
Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will not be able to cancel the subscription once activated. Manage your subscriptions in Account Settings after purchase.
IMPORTANT: Phone calls and text messages use prepaid credits. Area code availability varies. May not work with SMS shortcode services. Not for 911 or other emergency services.
Text messaging to UK and US numbers is unavailable (UK, US, PR, VI, Guam, and American Samoa). Numbr now supports texting to VoIP numbers in the United States.
Text messaging is not available in Africa (Algeria, Angola, Benin, Botswana, Burkina Faso, Burundi, Cameroon, Cape Verde, Central African Republic, Chad, Comoros, Congo, The Democratic Republic Of The Congo, Cote D’Ivoire, Djibouti, Egypt, Equatorial Guinea, Eritrea, Ethiopia, Gabon, Gambia, Ghana, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Kenya, Lesotho, Liberia, Libyan Arab Jamahiriya, Madagascar, Malawi, Mali, Mauritania, Mauritius, Mayotte, Morocco, Mozambique, Namibia, Niger, Nigeria, Reunion Island, Rwanda, Sao Tome And Principe, Senegal, Seychelles, Sierra Leone, Somalia, South Africa, South Sudan, Sudan, Swaziland, United Republic Of Tanzania, Togo, Tunisia, Uganda, Western Sahara, Zambia, Zimbabwe) and Dominican Republic.
We would appreciate it if you could review our App in the App Store. Thanks!
Privacy Policy: https://legal.apptoro.support/hc/en-us/articles/4417735019665
Terms of Use: https://legal.apptoro.support/hc/en-us/articles/4417335917201

bluejetty:00144306:ios.description:
Now, who are you? A striker unstoppable, a defense like a wall, a goalie of impossible saves?! Just follow the call and climb up the career ladders, GOKA Street challenges you!
Be the next big player!
Imagine becoming a powerful horse with awesome kicks, or choosing to be a cool cyborg with amazing skills or even a forest fairy who creates watermelon rains. Create your character however you want. 
Different game modes will unite you with your friends and players around the globe. Up to 6 player matches in career path & custom rooms await to test your skills. There are trophies to be won, goals to be scored, skills to be displayed, and minds to be blown! Prepare yourself for the most extraordinary football game controls on mobile, with moves you can unlock along the journey. Curved shots, bicycle kicks, spectacular dribbles...

In ONE BAR mode, dominate your opponents by scoring goals and show them who the ultimate striker is.
Those who like goalkeeping are in luck. In KING OF THE BARS, scoring alone isn't enough to win; you must defend the goal as the goalkeeper you've captured with all your might. In this mode, goals are scored in the goal!...

▶ Universal Remote ◀ allows you easily to control your Smart TV using your iPhone / iPad. The operation is the same as the real TV remote. You can freely switch channels, adjust volume and enjoy your favorite TV shows.

To use this remote control, you must have your iPhone / iPad on the same wifi network as your smart TV and you have to accept the message that appears on your TV screen.

▶ Key Features ◀
● Power ON / OFF
● Mute / Unmute
● Volume Up / Down
● Channel Up / Down
● Menu Button with up / down and left / right 
● Video control (Play/Pause/Stop...)
● Touch bar for easy navigation
● Automatic connection to a device
● No wires and no additional hardware needed!

SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS:
- ▶ Universal Remote ◀ App is free to download. It contains preferable auto-renewing subscription options for Unlimited Use.
- Once you subscribe to any of your preferable options, you can enjoy all the features of the app.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.

bluejetty:00131424:ios.description:
The official Ikon Pass app is your tool to maximize fun at over 70 Ikon Pass destinations worldwide. Whether you're an Ikon Pass holder or using a local pass or day ticket, the Ikon Pass app helps you make the most of your mountain experience – all in one place.
New Features for 25/26: 
- Find dining, retail, and rentals with interactive maps
- Pay for food and drinks in-app
- Track your mountain credits
- Manage your family’s pass profile
- Check parking availability in real time
- Browse live events at participating destinations
All Features:
Manage your Pass
- See your days remaining and blackout dates 
- Choose favorite destinations and set preferences 
- Keep track of exclusive deals and vouchers
- Track your mountain credits
- Manage your family’s pass profile, pass photos, and more 
Amplify Your Adventure 
- Track stats like vertical, run difficulty, and current altitude 
- Track activity on Apple Watch 
- View weather and condition reports before you go
- Find dining, retail, and rentals with interactive maps
- Pay for food and drinks in-app 
- Map you and your crew on the mountain
- Check parking availability in real time
- Browse live events at participating destinations
Connect With Your Crew 
- Create daily friend groups to message, compare stats, and track each other's locations 
- Challenge the Ikon Pass community on the Leaderboard
- Map you and your crew on the mountain
Ikon Pass helps you navigate at 60+ destinations worldwide. In the 25/26 season, it will replace the local apps at the following mountain destinations: Arapahoe Basin, Big Bear Mountain Resort, Blue Mountain, Crystal Mountain, Deer Valley Resort, June Mountain, Mammoth Mountain, Palisades Tahoe, Schweitzer, Snow Valley, Snowshoe, Solitude, Steamboat, Stratton, Sugarbush, Tremblant, Winter Park Resort.

bluejetty:00083983:ios.description:
A relaxing life starting on the farm!
•“Create your own farm filled with cute, loveable animals!”
A farm full of small, cute animals
•Collect and raise cute animals, such as sheep, pigs, and rabbits.
•Collect rare and legendary animals and show them off to your friends!
Grow crops and expand the farm
•Plant and harvest a variety of crops to develop your farm.
•Sell your crops and purchase an animal license to invite more animals to your farm.
New events and special missions
•Join in events to earn special limited animals and rare decorative buildings.
•Complete special missions to easily obtain rare animals.
A coop farm to enjoy with your friends!
•Develop your farm with your friends and exchange gifts!
•See rare animals on other farms, and cooperate to achieve bigger goals!
Decorate your own unique farm
•Freely decorate your farm with a variety of decorations!
•Now you can customize the background and weather in your own farm!
Download now and create a cute, warm, relaxing farm!
[Subscription Product Description]
1. Subscription Price and Subscription Period
Click on Remove Ads at the top right of the menu to subscribe to the "Remove Ads Subscription".
The subscription price is $4.99 each and the subscription period is one month.
2. Subscription Content Description
There is one type of "Remove Ads Subscription".
1) After subscribing, the subscription is automatically renewed every month. If you cancel the subscription within the subscription period, you will not be able to enjoy the monthly privileges after the subscription period ends.
2) The Ad Removal Subscription removes all ads during the subscription period and pays for the products paid by watching ads immediately.
3) The Ad Removal Subscription pays subscription reward items on the 1st of every month.
4) The Ad Removal Subscription pays items as the total number of cumulative subscription months increases.
3. Subscription Automatic Renewal Description
Apple Subscription is a subscription system that automatically renews and is automatically paid from your iTunes Account. To cancel the subscription service, you can cancel the automatic subscription function on the iTunes/Apple ID settings management page of your mobile device. Automatic subscription renewal will be charged within 24 hours after the end of the subscription period, and the payment will be confirmed directly to your iTunes account. If you do not cancel the automatic renewal subscription at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period, the subscription period will be automatically renewed.
After confirming the purchase, the subscription fee will be charged to your iTunes Account.
Check the subscription period renewal and subscription period renewal cost within 24 hours before the end of the subscription.
4. Subscription Cancellation Instructions
To cancel the subscription, select "Settings" on your iOS device ---> Select "iTunes Store & App Store" ---> Click "Apple ID" and click "View Apple ID" to enter the "Account Settings" screen, then click "Subscriptions"-->"Manage" to select the subscription of "Dragon Village Collection" and cancel the subscription.

This game is perhaps the world's most complex tic-tac-toe style puzzle game. You play the game alone and try to connect three rings of the same colo
bluejetty:00018997:ios.description:
Would you like to play a game where it is possible to earn real money? Now is your chance!
This game is perhaps the world's most complex tic-tac-toe style puzzle game. You play the game alone and try to connect three rings of the same color vertically, horizontally, or diagonally!
A ring row is destroyed every time you add a third ring to it. Three rings of different sizes and the same color can form a complete ring line.
Your goal is to form as many rows of three rings as possible and destroy them simultaneously in one move.
EXTRA POINTS
• You can collect extra points depending on how many lines you can destroy at the same time.
• Also, destroying ring lines with consecutive moves earns you extra points.
SPECIAL FUNCTIONS
• The warehouse is a place where you can collect three rings of different sizes and move them to a place on the grid at the same time!
• With a bomb you can destroy tires from one grid if you get stuck!
• You can drop into the black hole, no unwanted rings!
MULTIPLAYER FEATURES
• Train your skills with virtual cash (z) (totally free)
• You play the same game with your opponent on the same rings and the player who collects more points wins!
• Play against friends and color rings around the world!
• Connect the tires as fast as possible! You have 3 minutes to defeat your opponent.
• Win and show your results on the leaderboard!
PLAYING
• Just by playing you will see how relaxing, addictive, and challenging the game is. You probably haven't played anything like this before!

Your goal is to form as many rows of three rings as possible and destroy them simultaneously in one move.

Book flights & hotels with ease:
Adani OneApp is your all-in-one travel companion. Book cheap flights and find top hotels at the best prices with just a few taps.
Pay bills anytime, anywhere

See you on board!

bluejetty:00148696:ios.description:
Viva experiências incríveis!
O ElevenTickets Wallet reúne seus ingressos para viver as melhores experiências, adquiridos exclusivamente através da Plataforma ElevenTickets.
Utilize o App para transferir facilmente todos os ingressos adquiridos pela ElevenTickets para o smartphone.
Nosso Wallet conta com a avançada tecnologia de QR Code dinâmico digital, onde o QR Code para acessos é constantemente atualizado, para garantir a maior segurança.
Além de favorecer a sustentabilidade dispensando as impressões de ingressos em papel, os ingressos digitais são protegidos por criptografia, utilizam token e diversas tecnologias antifraude. Dessa forma, você pode ter a tranquilidade de saber que seus ingressos estão seguros em seu smartphone.
Veja como é fácil usar:
1. Adquira seu ingresso em eleventickets.com
2. Baixe o App ElevenTickets Wallet.
3. Após concluir o pagamento do ingresso em eleventickets.com:
- No celular: Clique no botão de download e seus ingressos serão adicionados automaticamente ao app.
- No computador: Abra o app, escaneie o QR Code e seus ingressos serão adicionados automaticamente ao app.
1. Visualize facilmente as informações do ingresso através do App, incluindo quando o ingresso será disponibilizado.
2. Entrada rápida e segura: Quando o ingresso estiver disponível, utilize-o para acessar o evento ou atração no dia e horário previstos. O QR Code será validado e seu acesso liberado instantaneamente, sem a necessidade de troca por ingresso físico.
A simplicidade e praticidade que você precisa para aproveitar ao máximo cada momento!

bluejetty:00047693:ios.summary:

Use your fast refl
bluejetty:00047693:ios.description:
Are you ready to flip into action? Jump and land into action but don’t miss the target! Travel through exciting 3D stages, show off your skills, and score a perfect 10! Come experience the number one flipping simulation.
Use your fast reflexes and amazing hand eye coordination in this unique flipping action game. You will need dexterity and laser focus to complete all the unique jumping levels and land in the target! Travel to new worlds. jump off various objects like cliffs, mountains, schools, houses, and many more. Start your adventure now! The one thing you have to ask yourself is: can you get gold on every level?
Game Features:
1. Hardcore Parkour
Gymnasts and acrobats are jealous - they only wish they had the skills of the Flip Trickster. Jump off from the highest mountains and hit your target! Avoid Dangerous objects that interrupt your flips. Make sure you land on your feet otherwise it will be a crash landing!
2. Jump Tuck and Roll
Jump into action! So many ledges to take off from for you to have perfect landings - each level brings their own unique twist! Coordinate your jumping power and then roll as many times as you can to get the highest score possible. The better than landing, the higher the score will be!
3. Amazing Realistic Flipping Physics
No other game will give you the same realistic flipping sensation. Whether its a front flip or back flip, time your jump right to get the right distance and angle. Hold onto that tuck velocity as long as you can and release at the perfect time to stick that landing!
4. Impossible Challenges to complete
More than just levels to beat. Only true flipping legends can complete all of the side quests. And for the insane, the full level challenge! This crazy impossible mode is only for the elite to master.
5. New Skins to enjoy
New colors! New clothing items! Crazy heads and hats. Choose your items and get ready to jump.
6. Endless Worlds
We are constantly adding new levels for you to test your jumping skills. You will NOT want to miss out on the action.
Whether you're a jumper or a flipper, Flip Trickster is a challenge ready for you. This is the best physics flipping game there is. Never miss a dull moment with this easy to learn and easy to play game that is almost IMPOSSIBLE to master. Jump off cliffs. Become a hardcore parkour legend. Start your mission and never stop flipping! Bullseye!
Visit https://lionstudios.cc/contact-us/ if have any feedback, need help on beating a level or have any awesome ideas you would like to see in the game!
From the Studio that brought you Happy Glass, Flip Trickster and Love Balls!

bluejetty:00168205:ios.description:
After a valiant deed leads to the end of your earthly journey, you find yourself in a realm of fantasy!
Amidst dragons, slimes, demons, and other diverse races, embark on a leisurely and captivating journey in Isekai Fantasy: Restart & Relax, where the simplicity of pastoral life meets the magic of another world.
[Hatch and Evolve Magical Monsters]
Experience the joy of hatching and raising magical monsters, then combine them to create entirely new species! These loyal monsters will work tirelessly, contributing to your village's growth at no cost!
[Meet Capable Companions]
A nekomimi baker ("Nya~nya~"), a slime maid ("Master..."), a dragon NEET ("Me? NEET? How dare you!")... Join hands with companions from all walks of life and various races to build your village for a better life!
[Embrace Destiny's Encounters]
An oni shrine maiden ("Thank you, my lord..."), a red-skin Demon ("You won't be bored with me~"), a furry fox girl ("Let's go picnic!")... Relax with delightful partners by your side and immerse yourself in the serene joys of sweet pastoral life!
[Till the Land with Slimes and Construct a Diverse Array of Shops!]
Clear lands, plant seeds, and watch your village flourish with the help of slimes! Inn, Restaurant, Smithy, Alchemy Lab… A shop for every need! Ensure every patron's desire is met!
[Create or Join the Guild with Like-Minded Adventurers]
Unite with fellow adventurers to tackle challenging quests, reap the rewards, and revel in the glory of Isekai life.
[Diverse Events and Mini-Games, Rich Gameplay Awaits]
A variety of exciting events and mini-games! Each promises a unique and colorful gaming experience and great rewards!
Come and join Isekai Fantasy: Restart & Relax now and bask in the tranquility of pastoral life!
"Me? I'm just an ordinary farmer, nothing special."
"Oh, sure! Who would believe that?"
If you have any feedback or suggestions, feel free to send an email to:
service@isekai-farminglife.com

WIC is a federally funded program that provides healthy supplemental foods and nutrition counseling for pregnant women, new m
bluejetty:00062700:ios.description:
The South Carolina WIC Program is a supplemental nutrition program for women, infants and children under age 5. 
WIC is a federally funded program that provides healthy supplemental foods and nutrition counseling for pregnant women, new mothers, infants and children under age five. The program has an extraordinary 35-year record of preventing children's health problems and improving their long-term health, growth and development. WIC serves over 9.1 million women, infants and children through over 10,000 clinics nationwide. 
The South Carolina WIC Mobile App will give WIC participants the opportunity to view upcoming appointments, view food benefits that have been issued to them in the clinic, scan UPCs while shopping at the store to see if the UPC is a WIC Approved item or not, and provide information on locations of WIC Stores and WIC Clinics across the State of South Carolina. 
The goal of the South Carolina WIC Mobile App is to give participants all the information they need at their fingertips to make their shopping experience fun and easy.

bluejetty:00144831:ios.description:
HealthHub SG is a national digital healthcare platform that allows you to conveniently manage you and your loved ones' health in one place.
Access your health records as well as perform various transactions across public healthcare institutions* such as appointment booking, bill payment and medication refill with the HealthHub app.
Login via Biometrics:
Conveniently access selected e-Services and health records through a simple biometric scan.
Customisable Dashboard:
Personalise your home screen and find your go-to health services in a tap
Health Profile and Caregiver Access:
Add and enable caregiver access to view health records and perform digital healthcare transaction for yourself as well as your child, dependents or loved ones.
Appointment and Mobile Registration:
Access your favourite polyclinic and service type for faster appointment booking, as well as pre-register 30-90mins before your appointment to obtain a queue number.
Payment:
Retrieve past invoices and make payments for outstanding medical bills digitally.
Medication: 
View your prescription and manage your medication refill in a single, streamlined way.
*Participating restructured hospitals, polyclinics and specialist outpatient clinics within the public healthcare sector.

bluejetty:00072636:ios.description:
2FA: Two-Factor Authentication – Maximum security for your online accounts.
Protect your accounts with the power of two-factor authentication (2FA). Store all your 2FA tokens securely in one app, and add an extra layer of defense to your online presence. Set up in seconds by scanning a QR code or entering your key manually – perfect for securing email, social media, banking, and more.
Key Features:
– Instantly add accounts by scanning QR codes
– Easily enter secret keys manually when needed
– Securely store and organize all your 2FA tokens in one place
– Generate time-based one-time passcodes (TOTP) with ease
– Fast, intuitive, and seamless user experience
Protect what matters most. Secure your online world with 2FA today.

- You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to iTunes Account Settings.
- Subscriptions can be canceled at any time in your Apple ID settings. All prices include applicable local sales taxes.
- The unused portion of the free trial, if offered, will be canceled when you purchase a subscription.
- At the end of the 3-day trial period, if offered, the subscription will automatically renew according to the rate unless canceled before the end of the 3-day trial period.

bluejetty:00062220:ios.description:
Real-life 3D fish, seahorses, whales, dolphins, sharks, starfish, jellyfish and turtles on your device!
Fish Farm 3 is the latest advance in the popular Fish Farm series — buy, breed, cross-breed, sell, and enjoy plenty of freshwater and saltwater fish, including seahorses, whales, dolphins, sharks, starfish, and jellyfish.
Reach higher levels to access more fish, decoration, and aquarium inventory. Breeding and selling your fish wisely earns coins to further advance and refine your aquariums.
Don't forget to feed your fish and to change the water, either by hand or by automation. 
Do you want to try out different lights or enjoy the fluorescent inhabitants by switching off the light? Just do it!
Not only that our 3D graphics got even more lifelike to take the most out of your device, but also heaps of other advances are available now:
• Big fish, seahorses, starfish
• Recolor your fish
• Decoration in 3D
• New game to earn coins: Catch Fish
• Sell your aquariums
• Automate chores to focus on enjoying aquariums
• Win daily prices
• Clean your aquariums
• Equip different lights
• Night Mode
• Put unused items into Storage instead of selling them
• More fish
• Baby fish are not just smaller adults, they change their shape when growing
• More realistic fish, such as moving gills and growing bellies
Features:
• 400 species of brilliantly colored, realistic 3D fish
• Customize up to 20 aquariums with lots of decorative items and corals
• Saltwater, freshwater, jellyfish, and open ocean aquariums
• Cross-breed your fish for unlimited variations 
• Most realistic fish movements ever
• Send and receive gifts

bluejetty:00061170:ios.description:
Trusted by families and teachers. Loved by kids!
Bookbot is the award-winning reading app that helps children learn to read with confidence. Using built-for-kids speech recognition, Bookbot listens as your child reads aloud and gives instant, gentle feedback to improve pronunciation, fluency, and reading comprehension.
Why parents and teachers love Bookbot
* #1 direct reading intervention — 33.5% improvement in reading skills in just 6 weeks!
* AI reading tutor — Uses speech recognition made for children’s voices.
* Phonics-based learning — Decodable books and storybooks matched to your child’s reading level.
* Interactive feedback — Helps improve pronunciation, fluency, and confidence in young readers.
* Hundreds of engaging stories — A growing library of fun, educational storybooks for early learning.
* Fun rewards — Keeps motivation high with achievements that make reading practice exciting and rewarding.
* Storytime mode — Let Bookbot’s friendly AI voice read aloud when you need a break, perfect for bedtime stories.
Bookbot makes daily reading practice easy, fun, and scientifically proven to work. It’s ideal for early readers, reluctant learners, and children with dyslexia or those learning English as a second language.
With Bookbot, every child can enjoy stories that grow their confidence, improve comprehension, and inspire a lifelong love of reading.
** Bookbot Subscription **
• Subscription period is monthly and annual from when the subscription is confirmed.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period and is charged at the subscription you have selected.
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of service can be found here: https://www.bookbotkids.com/terms-conditions

Whether you’re a casual gamer, a hardcore collector, or just tired of forgetting
bluejetty:00077483:ios.description:
Gamery is the all-in-one game tracker, collection manager, and gaming companion that helps you organize, explore, and stay on top of your video game universe.
Whether you’re a casual gamer, a hardcore collector, or just tired of forgetting what’s in your backlog, Gamery gives you the tools to bring order and joy to your gaming life.
Track your entire game collection
Add digital and physical games to your library. Create custom collections, sort and filter by platform, genre, or play status, and always know what’s in your library.
Import your games automatically
Connect with Steam, PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo, GOG, Epic Games Store, and RetroAchievements. Gamery pulls your games, artwork, metadata, achievements, and progress — all in one place.
Barcode scanning with ScanDex
Have physical games? Use ScanDex, the most advanced video game barcode database, to scan and add them in seconds.
Stay on top of your gaming goals
Track your progress with statuses like “Playing,” “Completed,” or “Ongoing.” Add your own ratings, reviews, and notes. Know what you’ve played — and what’s next.
Manage your backlog like a pro
Gamery helps you see how many games you haven’t finished, which genres dominate your collection, and how long your “pile of shame” really is.
Discover deep stats about your habits
See which platforms you use most, which genres you prefer, how many games you finished this year, and more with beautiful visual stats.
View personalized Yearly Replays
Get a summary of your gaming activity year by year. See what you’ve played, how often, and how your collection has evolved.
Get smart suggestions & reminders
Not sure what to play? Let Gamery pick a random game from your backlog. Get notified about new releases, livestreams, and gaming events so you never miss out.
Wishlist & event calendar
Add upcoming titles to your wishlist and browse all upcoming releases. Gamery keeps track of announcements, release dates, and post-event summaries.
Customize everything
Choose from multiple home screen icons, app themes, and custom game page designs. Make Gamery feel like your own.
Widgets for your Home Screen
Display your current games, your wishlist, or collections, right on your Home Screen.
Clean, beautiful design
Gamery puts presentation first. Each game page features animated 3D artwork, layered headers, and a screenshot stack that lets you explore your games in style.
Fully synced with iCloud
Your entire library, settings, and data stay updated across all your Apple devices.
No ads. Ever.
Gamery is built for gamers, not advertisers. You won’t see pop-ups, banners, or tracking scripts.
Gamery+ Features
Gamery is free to download and use, but you can unlock the full experience with Gamery+.
Premier gives you access to every feature, customization option, and premium update — with no limitations.
Choose what works for you:
 • One-time purchase
 • Monthly subscription
 • Yearly subscription
All purchases help support indie development and continued updates.
Gamery was designed by gamers, for gamers — with care, attention to detail, and a focus on real-world use.
It’s your backlog tracker, gaming journal, collection manager, wishlist, and companion — all in one clean, customizable, powerful app.
Download Gamery today and take control of your gaming universe.

bluejetty:00022424:ios.description:
Are you looking for an amazing car driving school simulator game that will test your driving and parking skills? 
Welcome to the ultimate car parking simulator game! Experience real car parking and learn all road signs as you progress in the game. Put your driving skills to test as you drive through crowded parking lots and tight corners to find the perfect parking spot. So start your engine and get ready to park like a pro driver!
Modern Car Parking Game Features:
- High quality visual graphics
- Realistic sound effects
- Stunning 3D environments of car driving school simulator
- Variety of vehicles for parking - SUV, sedan, hatchback & sports cars
- Different car customizations - Paint, Decals & Rims
- Realistic car damage
- Smooth & stable gameplay controls
- Compete against others in Multiplayer mode
- Daily missions and rewards
- Offline & free game to play
Join a community of millions of car game players and master the art of car parking. Drive and park amazing vehicles; from classic vintage cars to modern SUVs and sports cars. Park the vehicle in the designated spot without crashing or exceeding the time limit and get bonus rewards. There are several game modes that you can play and enjoy!
- Classic Mode: In this classic mode, start your car parking games career and enhance your car driving skills. Follow traffic rules to park a car perfectly in this driving simulator.
- Modern Mode: In modern mode, complete advanced level parking missions with high performance cars and tight parking lots. Become a pro car driver and rule the parking arcade.
- Time Attack Mode: Race against time and complete the car parking challenges as quickly as possible in time attack mode. Reach the finish line in a given time.
- Snow Mode: Navigate through slippery roads and avoid obstacles in snowy environments. Watch out for traffic signals and all road signs. 
- Quick Mode: This mode features a series of quick parking challenges that can be completed in a short amount of time.
- Multiplayer Mode: Compete against highly skilled car drivers around the world and play various parking and driving challenges in real time. Win against them and climb up the leaderboard in this car driving simulator game.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
This car simulator game offers an auto-renewing weekly subscription to provide unlimited access and other premium features.
- Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase.
- Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified.
You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.

bluejetty:00128737:ios.summary:
When the entire world is at war, bold generals rise to the challenge by bringing out the big guns. Take action in the most exciting MMO real-time strategy game!
Build your own custom base to form the backbone of your defense and to survive
bluejetty:00128737:ios.description:
When the entire world is at war, bold generals rise to the challenge by bringing out the big guns. Take action in the most exciting MMO real-time strategy game!
Build your own custom base to form the backbone of your defense and to survive your enemies’ assault. Then stockpile troops, tanks, helicopters, and other weapons of modern warfare and march your army across a real-world map unlike any other multiplayer military game you’ve seen.
Form an alliance with other players to expand your battle capabilities, and launch a global assault using intricate, real-time strategy to command and conquer. Take over key cities like New York, Paris, Tokyo and more to gain influence over your region, and eventually become a superpower that can issue orders that affect the entire world. But the stronger you become, the more of a target you become, so prepare for battle after battle in this nonstop game of war!
**GAME FEATURES**
AN EXPANSIVE WORLD
► War Planet Online is the only MMO military game to pit players against each other on a massive real-world map.
► Play with thousands of RTS players from around the world that can become members of your alliance, or the next target of your guns.
► Talk with friends and foes alike in the Global Chat as you plot your real-time strategy.
► Discover key cities across the map that grant unique bonuses to their controlling alliance. 
CUSTOM DESTRUCTION
► Order the construction of base buildings for defense and production. 
► Amass a fully battle-ready army by combining your troops, tanks, artillery guns and air support for your own style of modern warfare.
► Recruit the best Commanders you can find to lead your army on each assault, and maximize your power to command and conquer.
► Commander Add-Ons even let you customize your Commanders with powerful new skills and bonuses.
► Conduct research to unlock new technology. Each discovery powers up your battle game plan, be it more powerful tanks, stronger defense, an accelerated economy, or your own custom mix.
► Craft a variety of gear and upgrades for your guns and other tools of modern warfare.
RTS ACTION
► Order your army to battle anywhere around the massive real-world map.
► Coordinate with your alliance to call for backup during battle and maximize the destruction of each assault.
► Survive the constant action of a never-ending, real-time, multiplayer strategy game!
RULE THE WORLD
► The World HQ is the heart of the conflict! All players will work together to construct it... while simultaneously vying to control it.
► Vote for a World President or Dictator! Each gets to issue orders that reshape the overall nature of the game's strategy.
► Launch your own Orbital Command, a space station from which alliance leaders can unleash powerful effects across large sections of the global map.
► Cross-World Conflicts pit your world against enemies from different worlds!
THE EVOLUTION OF WAR GAMES 
► War is always evolving, and new units and gear for your Commanders are added with every update!
► As your World HQ grows, the world itself changes with it, unlocking new features for all players, and new strategies to learn and master.
► Seasonal events bring fresh new Renegades into the battle for you to march against. 
There’s no time to lose, General! Download War Planet Online and join the ultimate MMO strategy game experience!

bluejetty:00129465:ios.name: BT Basketball Controller
bluejetty:00129465:ios.summary: The BT Controller is a complimentary app meant to remotely control supported BT basketball scoreboards, shotclocks, and score camera devices. The app synchronizes the time and score on all these supported devices. The interface is extreme
bluejetty:00129465:ios.description:
The BT Controller is a complimentary app meant to remotely control supported BT basketball scoreboards, shotclocks, and score camera devices. The app synchronizes the time and score on all these supported devices. The interface is extremely clean and intuitive, everything is directly touch or swipe based. Clearly labeled controller buttons are also added for those that prefer a button interface. Thoroughly tested in our basketball leagues, the BT Controller app is easy to learn and new users can be running the time and score for a basketball game in no time.
Tutorial video: https://vimeo.com/1136274939
For a full list of our other tutorials please visit: https://vimeo.com/channels/btstatsco
BT Controller App Features:
- Clean design, no ads
- Intuitive direct tap and swipe controls
- Remotely control scoreboards, shotclocks, and other devices with WiFi or Bluetooth
- Convenient Presets (International, 3x3, US Pro, College, High School, and more...)
- Convenient timers: pregame timer, period timer, rest timer, timeout timer, overtime, etc.
- Fully customizable game in the settings
- Practice modes configured in settings is great for running practices
- Audio buzzers for shotclock violation, end of period, substitutions, etc.
- Warning beep near end of pregame, timeout, or rest times (customizable)
- Quick Start Documentation below
The BT Controller app was created by The Basketball Temple Company. The Basketball Temple Company focuses on high quality basketball academies, basketball leagues, and technologies that are used to support those academies and leagues. We open our technology to the public so everyone in the basketball community can experience the same technologies that we use within our institutions.
# Quick Start Documentation:
All the actions below have corresponding controller buttons that may be used instead.
Score Controls:
- Tap directly on the score to increase quickly
- Swipe up/down score to increase/decrease
- Hold down on team names to adjust name and color of teams
Time Controls:
- Tap period timer to start/pause 
- Tap pregame, timeout, rest timers to early transition to next stage
Shotclock Controls:
- Tap shotclock to reset/go
- Swipe shotclock up/down to reset/go to short shotclock
Timeout Controls:
- Tap timeout number to call timeout
- Swipe up/down timeouts to adjust numbers
- Red indicates violation when calling timeout with no timeouts left
Fouls Controls
- Swipe up/down fouls to adjust numbers
- Red indicates bonus situation (customizable in settings)
- Purple indicates double bonus situation (customizable in settings)
Connect and Remote Control Settings:
- Tap on top-left icon (or swipe left-to-right on the left edge) to open connect menu
- Hit "Refresh" to find devices
- Tap on WiFi or Bluetooth icon to connect, green icon indicates connected
- If unable to connect or having connection errors try one of the following:
 1) please ensure all devices are on the same WiFi network
 2) please ensure bluetooth is turned ON on all devices
 3) lastly, try to restart the app on all devices
Time and Game Settings:
- Tap on top-right icon (or swipe right-to-left on the right edge) to open settings menu
- Edit and save the many settings available
Exit Game and Reset Times and Scores:
- Scroll down and hit "Exit Game" button
Audio Buzzer:
- There are two faint colored bell icons next to the period number
- Tap to play buzzer or energy horn

bluejetty:00164213:ios.description:
手机管家是一款全方位适用于苹果手机的手机管理软件，应用不仅可以对手机存储空间进行优化，更有丰富的工具在您的生活中提供帮助，真正做到您的手机好管家
手机管家功能详情介绍：
【云存储】
安全快速的云存储功能，能够存储手机中过多的图片
云存储容量：一周（10GB），1个月（80GB）
【图片】
模糊图片：扫描手机存储空间中较为模糊的图片，此类图片一般是由于拍摄不清晰或接收的为非高清原图导致的模糊，不仅占用存储空间，而且也因为模糊不清在使用时造成不便，建议全部删除；
超大图片：扫描手机存储空间中单张图片容量过大的图片，此类图片一般是由于经过多次修图导致图片单体容量变大，不仅占用存储空间，通常发布后很少会再次使用到，建议选择性删除；
屏幕截图：扫描手机存储空间中图片属性为截图的图片，此类图片一般是在当时需要时会截取屏幕中的一部分内容，不仅占用存储空间，通常事后也比较少用到，建议删除部分较早的内容；
重复图片：扫描手机存储空间中内容几乎相同的图片，此类图片一般为重复下载或连续拍摄时产生，不仅占用存储空间，通常也只需要用到一张同样的图片，建议删除多余的内容；
【视频】
模糊视频：扫描手机存储空间中较为模糊的视频，此类视频一般是由于拍摄不清晰或接收的为非高清视频导致的模糊，不仅占用存储空间，而且也因为模糊不清在使用时造成不便，建议全部删除；

2 – Navegue pelo cardápio e selecione os itens que irão compor sua cesta de compras.
3 – Ao clicar na cesta, escolha a forma de pagamento, onde será feita a entrega do seu pedido, ou até mesmo se você irá busca-lo.
4 – Revise se todas as informações do que deseja pedir está na tela e confirme o envio.
5 – Acompanhe se o seu pedido foi aceito, se está na cozinha ou se saiu para entrega.

bluejetty:00148767:ios.name: Feel Great - Fasting Coach
bluejetty:00148767:ios.summary:
Unlock your potential with Feel Great! Embrace Unimate, Balance, and the power of fasting for a transformative wellness journey. 
Discover the wellness approach that works for real people with real jobs and real schedules. Feel Great is an
bluejetty:00148767:ios.description:
Unlock your potential with Feel Great! Embrace Unimate, Balance, and the power of fasting for a transformative wellness journey. 
Discover the wellness approach that works for real people with real jobs and real schedules. Feel Great is an approach to adopting a healthier lifestyle without restrictive dieting. It combines two products with an intermittent fasting practice.
Designed by Unicity, Feel Great helps people across the world embrace a healthier lifestyle through intermittent fasting and insulin awareness. 
Whether you’re already following the Feel Great approach or are interested in seeing what it’s like, the Feel Great app is free and available to anyone interested in trying a healthier lifestyle.
Why use Feel Great? 
People who follow Feel Great approach with the app report higher success rates for the following reasons: 
Tracking works -- when you track your habits, you are more aware of your actions and MUCH more likely to succeed. Multiple studies on habit creation highlight the importance of tracking and awareness. 
Instant feedback and direction -- get instant feedback on how you’re doing everyday with the program and know what you need to do to improve. 
Designed for motivation -- we all know that it can be difficult to stay motivated to make healthy decisions, especially late at night when Oreos are calling your name. Feel Great’s logging approach is designed to help you stay motivated. Get on a logging streak and stay on a logging streak!
Reminders -- get push notifications to remember to continue the program, take Balance, and log each day. 
Progress starts with tracking. 
With Feel Great, it’s not about instantaneous results -- it’s about embarking on a journey of learning and growth. Be patient with yourself and just keep logging your fasts and meal, regardless of whether you followed the program “perfectly” or not at all. In time, daily logging and the awareness it brings of your daily decisions will help you build strong habits. 
Region support
The content in the Feel Great app is adapted to a US-audience. 
Privacy Policy: https://www.unicity.com/usa/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.unicity.com/usa/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00016833:ios.description:
Destroy your enemies and become a powerful Capo - the leader of your own cartel in the official game of NARCOS!
Power. Loyalty. Warfare. Product.
Step into the dangerous and thrilling role of cartel kingpin in the official game of the hit television show NARCOS. Decide between leading through raw power or gathering respect through loyalty. Sometimes bad people do good things… In the end you must decide, will it be “Plata o Plomo”?
NARCOS – Learn the ropes of running an operation from El Patron himself and manage your “relationship” with the authorities through agents Murphy and Pena. Enter the world of Narcos with exciting events and updates of content from the show.
Recruit and build – Choose Plata and hire sicarios and build your defenses. Collect different sicarios, level them up and have them defend your base and add bonuses to production.
Wage War – Choose Plomo and send Sicario-led death squads to take over high value resources from other player cartels.
Profit – Develop your operation by building out your jungle finca with processing plants and labs. Select smuggling lines and plans to maximize revenue.
Alliances – Team up with other players to form cartels, lay siege to enemy cartel compounds in multi-day campaigns for domination.
There is money and power to be made. From now on, nowhere is safe.
About NARCOS:
Narcos is an inside look at the men who would stop at nothing to take down the cocaine drug lords. From the Colombian government to the DEA agents, from the policemen who would risk their lives to the US officials who would spin the story. Narcos is an unfiltered look into the war that would change the drug trade forever.

bluejetty:00170336:ios.description:
A lot of money apps tell you what you should do. Female Invest helps you actually do it.
Get your Financial Health Score, a single number from 0 to 100 that shows exactly where you stand today and where you have the most room to grow. Then follow a personalised plan built to get you from where you are to where you want to be.
YOUR PLAN, BUILT AROUND YOU
• Start with your score
 Answer a few simple questions and see where your finances stand today. Your score is not about how much you earn. A student with good habits can score higher than a millionaire without them.
• Learn in a way that sticks
 Short, interactive lessons that make money genuinely exciting, with no jargon and no overwhelm.
• Take real action
 Step-by-step guides walk you through the things that actually grow your money, from building your savings to making your first investment. Every action you complete lifts your score.
• You are never alone
 Join live Q&A sessions with our team and experts, and a community of women on the same journey.
ABOUT FEMALE INVEST
 Female Invest is the world's largest financial education platform for women. We are here to close the financial gender gap, one woman at a time.

We'll send you a reminder before your membership renews, so there are no surprises.
You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple ID account settings.
Not the right fit? We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee, no questions asked.

 Find us on socials @femaleinvest

bluejetty:00174967:ios.description:
TRX TRAINING - STRENGTH & HOME WORKOUTS
The official TRX Training app delivers TRX workouts, suspension training, and bodyweight workouts designed to build real strength at home, in the gym, or on the go.
Train smarter with trainer-led strength workouts, HIIT, core training, mobility, yoga, and low-impact options. Stream LIVE and On-Demand workouts anytime and experience the full power of TRX’s science-backed training system.
EFFECTIVE WORKOUT PROGRAMS
Build strength, burn fat, and move better with 50+ multi-week programs. Lose weight with 30 Day Weight Loss Kickstart, sculpt your core with Core Crusher, or strengthen glutes with Peach Perfect. Programs are designed for all fitness levels using TRX suspension training and bodyweight workouts.
DAILY LIVE CLASSES
Train live with expert TRX coaches and join a global fitness community. Get real-time cues, motivation, and coaching or catch the replay on your schedule and customize the music to match your energy.
ON-DEMAND WORKOUTS
Explore a growing library of TRX workouts, updated weekly. Filter by workout length, intensity, target area, equipment, and fitness level to find the perfect home strength workout in minutes.
SCIENCE-BACKED TRAINING
Unleash the full potential of TRX Suspension Training, YBell, resistance training, and bodyweight exercises. Every workout is adaptable, low-impact friendly, and built to improve strength, mobility, balance, and core stability so you can progress safely at any level.
Memberships are available monthly or annually. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase and renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. bluejetty:00171202:ios.description:
Wrestling game fans looking for the best pro wrestling GM mode or pro wrestling booking sim on mobile will love Modern Mania Wrestling GM!
Modern Mania Wrestling GM is a pro wrestling general manager game presented as a collectible card game. MMWGM allows you to be the booker in control of your own wrestling empire! 
As head promoter of your own fantasy wrestling league, it's up to you to book the best shows against competing companies. Can you bring your promotion to the very top and become a pro wrestling tycoon? 
You'll collect cards for wrestlers, tag teams, venues, sponsors, special matches and more. Hundreds of amazing characters flesh out this wrestling universe. Each character is totally original while also inspired by today's wrestling scene and pop culture trends! It’s piledriving parody at its finest!
MMWGM allows you to customize your pro wrestlers stats and gimmicks, create your own factions, set up feuds and so much more! Do you have what it takes to be an elite GM?
Stat tracking for all of your wrestlers, detailed title histories, top contender rankings, year end awards and more help to make this the best wrestling simulator of any mobile wrestling game out there!
Our awesome community of players share personal results as well as ideas and feedback that help to shape and improve MMWGM for future updates!
We strongly feel that Modern Mania Wrestling GM might just be the best wrestling game in the business!

bluejetty:00017314:ios.description:
You want to play the most fun and classic Italian card game? Download Tressette now, free. Tressette is a trick-taking card game. Easy to play, relaxing and yet challenging.
You can play Easy, Medium or Hard against the computer or go for an online game (multiplayer) to beat your friends and thousands of other Tressette players around the world.
Also, LEARN THE RULES and how to play with our simple “Help”, in the game menu. You also have your playable cards suggested and in the right order, for a more relaxing game and perfect if you’re a beginner.
Tressette’s features:
- Invite a friend to play online (multiplayer) or find an opponent with the auto-match
- Choose your level: 3 difficulty modes against the computer (A.I. artificial intelligence)
- Choose your deck: Tressette got all the original Italian regional decks (Napoletane, Siciliane, Piacentine, Piemontesi, Triestine and more), in high resolution that will look astonishing on your iPhone and iPad. Or you can play with the classic Poker cards
- Play with Accuse (also called “cucite” or declarations): you got the most classic Napola and Bongioco or Super Bongioco
- Play up to 21 points or 31 or 41 and choose among many other options
- Be part of the Global High-Score (Leaderboard): there’s one for each difficulty level
- Enjoy the fun challenges and badges to collect on Game Center
And do not miss on our La Scopa and La Briscola to have a complete classic card game suit on your iPhone and iPad!

bluejetty:00032015:ios.name: New York Travel & Audio Guide
bluejetty:00032015:ios.summary:
Tickets and tours: Empire State Building, 9/11 Memorial and more. Hear the story of every sight with the audio guide and walk an itinerary planned on the time you have. In English and 10 other languages.
TICKETS AND TOURS IN NEW YORK
Entry
bluejetty:00032015:ios.description:
Tickets and tours: Empire State Building, 9/11 Memorial and more. Hear the story of every sight with the audio guide and walk an itinerary planned on the time you have. In English and 10 other languages.
TICKETS AND TOURS IN NEW YORK
Entry tickets and guided tours: Empire State Building, 9/11 Memorial, Museum of Modern Art, American Museum of Natural History and Rockefeller Center, booked through GetYourGuide from the page of each place.
Boat cruises.
NEW YORK AUDIO GUIDE
Tap "Listen" on any place of the guide and the app reads its story aloud, sentence by sentence, while you stand in front of it: Empire State Building, 9/11 Memorial, Museum of Modern Art. Pause, go back a sentence, change the speed. The audio guide speaks the language you read the guide in.
NEW YORK ITINERARY BY THE TIME YOU HAVE
Tell the app how much time you have and where you start, and it plans a walking itinerary through the sights of New York: the stops in order, the walk between them in minutes, the route on the map. Follow it step by step, stop by stop. Or save the places you like and turn them into your own walk.
MAP OF NEW YORK
All the sights of New York on one map: the photos of the most famous ones, the others by name as you zoom in. Tap a place for its page, its tickets and the walking directions from where you are.
THINGS TO DO IN NEW YORK
131 places to see, each with its story, photos and the tours that visit it: Empire State Building, 9/11 Memorial, Museum of Modern Art, American Museum of Natural History, Wall Street, Metropolitan Museum of Art, Times Square, Central Park and many more.
TRAVEL TIPS FOR NEW YORK
193 answers to the questions travellers ask before and during a trip to New York, for example:
• Best ways to skip lines at the Statue of Liberty
• What to expect when visiting Rockefeller Center at Christmas
• Must-see museums for first-time visitors to NYC
MORE IN THE GUIDE
• Weather for the next 7 days
• Practical information: emergency numbers, holidays, getting around, safety
• Hotels in New York on Booking.com, for tonight, the weekend or your dates
• My guide: save places with a tap and find them on the map
FREE, OR PREMIUM
The New York guide, the audio guide, the map, the travel tips and a one-hour itinerary are free, with ads. Premium, a single purchase, removes the ads and adds longer itineraries, your own lists of places ("Day 1", "Day 2"), unlimited walking directions and the offline guide: the whole guide of New York downloaded to your phone, to read without a connection.

• Cook french fries, savory hot dog & clam soup!

• Login to Facebook and play with your real life friends!
• Send and receive free gifts to your friends and unlock new levels together!
• Invite friends, play together, and win fabulous prizes!

bluejetty:00119273:ios.description:
Jugnoo helps bring affordable rides to its residents. 
Rides- 
Affordable, quick and convenient doorstep commute in 24 cities. ETA as low as 1 min. There is no need to wait for public transport or look for a parking place, just book a Jugnoo ride anywhere, anytime. 
- Convenience At Your Door 
- Anywhere, Anytime 
- Fast and affordable 
How it works - 
1. GPS detects your current location. 
2. Tap the rides button at the center and we ping the nearby Jugnoo rides. 
3. One of the Jugnoo accepts your request and moves towards your pickup location. 
4. Instant confirmation along with the driver's details are displayed. 
5. Call the driver directly to give specific details if required. 
5. Track the Jugnoo auto coming your way on the map. 
6. Pay the fare shown at the completion of the ride based on distance traveled and time taken using cash, Freecharge, Mobikwik, Paytm. 
7. Refer your friends for free rides. 
Download Jugnoo to experience seamless services. 
Connect with us over social media for exciting deals. 
Follow us on Twitter at https://twitter.com/jugnoose 
Like us on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/jugnoose 
Have a question? Write to us at support@jugnoo.in

bluejetty:00119056:ios.description:
Woman Bible or Bible for women with daily devotion as well as daily prayers to help you as a child of God. This lovely Bible is created for women and has the design to make your reading adorable. The Holy Bible for women can be used offline for most parts but if you want the audio Bible then you should download it for later use. Praise be to God for making His Word available in a digital form.
The KJV Bible for women is the most common and highly popular version of the Holy Bible dating back to 1611 and has a number of factors which make it a good choice for study, memorization or a period of personal devotion. 
We thank God for women. Everyone here on this earth excluding Adam had to go through a woman for 9 months before being born. That is the beauty of God’s creation. This Bible has been specifically created for women with colors that are bright and catchy. Women’s Bible is easy to download for every woman out there. This Bible for women comes with a few features such as audio that can be downloaded for offline use.
A helpful feature that comes with the women bible app is the bookmark. Reading the Bible offline is a positive way to uplift your spirit and to keep your mind fixed on spiritual matters. When you only have a few minutes to read, you don't want to spend time trying to find the location where you last read. Placing a bookmark at the end of each reading session, helps to keep your reading sessions organized. 
History
The woman bible app keeps track of your history so you know the verses you read in the past. This makes it easy for you to locate verses quickly by looking at the history screen. It is good to take all your worries away.
Highlight feature
Highlighting any verse is possible in this women Bible app. There are several colors to choose from and you can also have an extensive color list if you so desire. By highlighting, you keep track of verses that made an impact in your life.
Share verse on image
This Bible for women gives you the possibility to share your verses on a chosen image. You can also take your personal image and share Bible verses on it. This makes sharing very easy and creative. Your friends will be asking you how you made it. The secret is because it comes from your Bible.
This is one of the best offline women Bible for your phone today. You don’t need to carry your hard copy Bible around. All you need is your smartphone and your ear phone and you can enjoy the beauty of God’s women. Women are a blessing to us all. We love you all. 
Let this women Bible be a blessing to you. Enjoy reading the Bible because it is the word of God. Women Bible makes it easier to listen to the word of God and to takes notes while listening to it. You can share the daily verses on your favorite image and also on Facebook, Twitter and other social media.
Let this Bible for women inspire you to read the Word of God daily. Faith comes by hearing and hearing by the word of God. Listen to the audio 24/7 and after downloading it, you can use it offline as well.
Enjoy this Bible for women. There is more in you than you can think of.
