bluejetty:00087334:ios.description:
SecureSafe – highly secure cloud storage solution with built-in password manager from DSwiss AG
Description 
SecureSafe is a multiple award winning online storage solution with an integrated password manager. The service is unique because of its strong double encryption, triple data storage and zero knowledge architecture, which ensures you the very highest level of privacy protection. 
Manage all your important data in your digital safe:
• Passwords
• PINs
• Credit card details
• E-banking codes
• A copy of your passport 
• Images
• Videos
• Contracts 
• Application documents 
• ...
Security 
• Highly secure AES-256 and RSA-2048 encryption 
• No one but you can decrypt and access your data – not even our employees (including programmers). 
• All data transferred between your device and SecureSafe is sent via HTTPS. 
• Passwords are encrypted additionally for maximum security. 
• 2-factor authentication (with SMS token) for PRO, SILVER and GOLD customers 
• Multiple layers of data security in Swiss high security data centres, one of which is located in a former military bunker. 
• 24/7 monitoring of all systems
Feature overview
• Password manager: With the free version of SecureSafe, you can store up to 10 unique passwords. Simply use the integrated password generator to help you create strong passwords. Also enjoy offline access to your PINs, PUK etc. when saved in the password manager. 
• File safe: Store and edit all of your important files in your digital safe and access them anywhere, anytime. 
• Data Inheritance: With the help of data inheritance, you ensure that family members or business partners can access important data such as passwords, PINs or insurance policies should you be involved in an emergency or pass away unexpectedly (this feature must be activated via our web application). 
• SecureViewer: With the integrated SecureViewer feature, you can open and read PDF files without leaving a digital trace on the device used. This feature is helpful if you need to view sensitive information while using a public WLAN (for example at the airport or in a hotel). 
• Mail-In: Mail-In is an email inbox, which is integrated directly in your SecureSafe. When you send emails to your unique SecureSafe address, all attached files will be saved directly in your safe. Email with no attachments are saved as text documents. 
• SecureSend: Thanks to SecureSend, you can encrypt and send up to 2 GB large files to any recipient of your choice (recipient does not need SecureSafe to download file). 
• SecureCapture: The integrated upload function allows you to use your phone to take a photo and save it directly to your safe. 
SecureSafe is winning thousands of new customers every week.
SecureSafe extensions
SecureSafe possesses 2 app extensions: “Camera Roll” and “Autofill”. Thanks to the two extensions, you can upload pictures directly into SecureSafe using the app “Photos”, and automatically copy passwords/user names into the appropriate login fields.

bluejetty:00140286:ios.description:
Do you need help with a quick task? Are you looking for a thoughtful conversation? Or perhaps you need assistance with complex projects? Our app is here for you! Make your life easier and your work more efficient with an advanced AI chatbot. The app can handle everything from casual chats to professional assistance in work, study, or personal projects.
Key Features
- Open-ended conversations with AI
- Quick Tasks
- Assistants
- Saved Chat History
- Image Generator
AI Helper and Companion
With our app, you can chat freely with AI for fun, learning, or assistance. Looking for advice, a new idea, need some help with coding or just want to talk? The bot is always ready. Plus, the quick tasks feature allows you to swiftly solve specific problems — get detailed explanations, solve math equations, write poems, or edit your texts in just a few taps.
Your Personal Assistants
Need expert help? The AI-assistants feature is your go-to for personalized support — from writing CVs and creating meeting plans to helping with social media management or studying. They can help with professional tasks, write essays or scripts, create meal plans, or even craft a unique recipe. Whatever you need, there’s an assistant ready to help you.
Conversation Archive
Worried about losing important information? With the saved chat history feature, you can easily keep track of your conversations and revisit them anytime. Review instructions, revisit work ideas, or go over study notes. Everything will be saved and accessible when you need it.
Image Generator
Turn your ideas into unique pictures right in the app! Describe what you want, and our chatbot will generate stunning photos in just a few seconds.
This is more than just a chatbot. It’s your personal assistant and guide in everything. From handling daily tasks to tackling more in-depth projects, this app empowers you to get more done — quickly, easily, and creatively. Experience the convenience and flexibility of our chatbot and let AI boost your productivity.
SUBSCRIPTION
Subscribe and get right now:
1. Unlimited messages
2. The most powerful AI-models
3. Complete chat history
4. Unique AI assistants
5. Voice chatting with AI
Make your life easier with premium access:
- Paid subscription is divided into 3 types: weekly, monthly and annual.
- The cost of a weekly paid subscription is $11.99. Monthly - $16.99. Annual - $59.99.
- The amount will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
- You can cancel a subscription or trial period at any time, but no later than 24 hours before the end of the current period. OTHERWISE it will be automatically renewed.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- After payment, you can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your account settings.
- Any unused portion of the free period will be forfeited upon purchase of the subscription.
- Read our privacy policy and terms of use:
https://appenvisions.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00159719:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00159719:ios.description:
Reach your money goals and earn rewards.
Debbie is the first money app that rewards you for paying off credit card balances, building savings, reducing debt, and improving your financial habits. Track your money, stay on budget, and earn rewards as you make progress toward financial freedom.
At the core of Debbie is a psychology-based money program designed to help you understand your relationship with money, build better habits, track your financial progress, and earn rewards for reaching important milestones. Whether you’re focused on paying off debt, growing savings, improving your credit score, or managing bills, Debbie helps keep you motivated every step of the way.
FEATURES
Earn Cash Rewards
Get rewarded for completing money challenges, paying down debt, building savings, and reaching financial goals.
Track Your Money Progress
Connect your accounts to track savings, debt balances, credit card payments, and financial milestones in one place.
Stay on Top of Bills
Build healthy habits around paying bills on time, managing debt, and staying consistent with your financial goals.
Personalized Money Goals
Set and complete personalized savings, debt payoff, and budgeting goals based on your unique financial situation.
Quick Wins
Complete simple money challenges, like checking your account balance, reviewing your budget, or monitoring your credit score.
Pathway
Take short personal finance courses designed to help you understand your money mindset, spending habits, and long-term financial behavior.
The app is 100% free and sponsored by our partner financial institutions, primarily community-based credit unions committed to helping people improve their financial lives.
HOW IT WORKS
Download Debbie and complete your onboarding quiz
We’ll learn about your financial goals, money habits, debt, savings, and spending patterns to personalize your experience.
Accept your sponsor partner
Debbie is free thanks to our sponsor partners. You’ll have the option to open a free checking or savings account, though you can begin using Debbie without opening a new account.
Connect your accounts
Securely connect your credit cards, loans, savings accounts, and other financial accounts to track progress toward your money goals. All data is encrypted and never sold.
Start your personalized money program
Learn practical personal finance skills, improve your money mindset, and build habits that support long-term financial success.
Reach your goals and earn rewards
Complete savings goals, debt payoff goals, budgeting challenges, and educational activities to earn points and celebrate your financial progress.
Unlock lower rates and refinancing opportunities*
As you progress through Debbie, gain access to tools that may help you reduce interest costs and save money on debt.
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
How much does Debbie cost?
Debbie is completely free.
How does Debbie make money?
Our financial institution partners sponsor the platform and may compensate us when users choose products that fit their financial needs.
How can Debbie help me save money?
Debbie helps you build better financial habits, stay on budget, pay bills on time, reduce debt, increase savings, and avoid costly financial mistakes.
Does Debbie really work?
Debbie users pay off debt faster, save more money, and stay more engaged with their financial goals compared to typical consumers.
Do you have a referral program?
Yes. Eligible users can earn rewards for referring friends. Terms and conditions apply.
DISCLOSURES
Not a guarantee of approval. Debbie does not directly extend credit. Credit checks will not impact your credit score. Terms and conditions apply.

Descreva o imóvel que você imagina em uma conversa, como se estivesse falando com um amigo, e deixe a Inteligência Artificial encontrar opções que combinam com o que você procura. Você também pode usar filtros tradicionais, como bairro, preço, número de quartos, tipo de imóvel e muito mais.

bluejetty:00179865:ios.description:
Want to become a better plant parent for your green babies?
Meet Plant Parent – the app that offers solid plant care guides. With Plant Parent, you can become an instant green thumb and keep your plants not just happy, but thriving!
What you'll love about Plant Parent:
- Smart Care Reminders
Not sure when to water your indoor and outdoor plants or how to fertilize them properly? Just add your plants to Plant Parent and get notified when it's time to water, fertilize, prune, propagate, repot, and more! 
- Light Meter
With the in-app Light Meter tool, you can calculate the light level your plant is getting and help you make potential repositioning decisions. Just click the Light Meter button and put your phone near the plant. The app will automatically scan the environment and measure the amount of light. 
- Plant identifier
Have had a plant for a while but not sure what it is? See a plant you like but the plant's name card is gone? No worries, just take a picture of it and Plant Parent will identify it for you right away! 
- Care Plans
Don't know what to do with your newly bought snake plant, or how to improve the overall health of your air plant? Get custom care plans from Plant Parent on watering, fertilization, lighting, and pruning. Make your plant grow healthily!
- Plant Illness 101
Are your plants not looking good? Plant Parent can help you save them! Simply take a photo of the sick plant and the app will auto-diagnose the disease and set up an effective treatment plan for your plants. Never kill a plant again!
- Growing Site Recommendation
Where should I put a houseplant in my home? How much sunlight does it need? Yeah, it can be tricky sometimes. Plant Parent can sort these problems out and be your plant manager! 
With the Plant Parent Premium, you can enjoy more privileges including:
- Unlimited plant disease IDs
- Enjoy unlimited access to rich plant content
- One-on-one free consultation with gardening experts
- Set care reminders for unlimited plant number
Download the Plant Parent app today, and join millions of endeavored plant parents worldwide to create a better journey for your plant pets.
Terms of Use: https://app-service.plantparentai.com/static/user_agreement.html
Privacy Policy: https://app-service.plantparentai.com/static/privacy_policy.html

bluejetty:00070136:ios.summary:
Have you visited the cozy Merge Inn? Help Maisie with her dream and serve up delicious meals to townies and visitors! 
Merge Inn is a brand new puzzle game where you combine food items to fill customer orders, discover new cuisine, and upg
bluejetty:00070136:ios.description:
Have you visited the cozy Merge Inn? Help Maisie with her dream and serve up delicious meals to townies and visitors! 
Merge Inn is a brand new puzzle game where you combine food items to fill customer orders, discover new cuisine, and upgrade your kitchen to turn Merge Inn from a dusty old diner to a dream café.
The most casual puzzle game experience
For fans of match 3 games, Merge Inn offers you something completely new. Instead of extra hard puzzle levels that block your progress, every single move you make takes you one step closer towards your goal!
Create the perfect meal 
Merge hundreds of sweet and savory food items to create tasty meals from a wild variety of ingredients. Master new recipes and cuisine from all over the world: roll up a burrito, craft candy for kids, bake the perfect birthday cake, and prepare a feast fit for a royal mansion - the options are endless!
Upgrade your kitchen 
Find the missing components to improve your kitchen features and appliances. Progress in the game to give your menu a total makeover: add a sushi line, build a pizza oven, or access the seafood market. Unlock new options to heat things up and bring your cooking to the next level!
Complete the collection
Complete each new Episode and finish the Side Job challenges to uncover every single item, reward and treasure that Merge Inn has to offer! More Episodes, special events and challenges are added periodically, so you will never run out of customers and collectibles. 
If you're new to merge games or a longtime fan, give Merge Inn a try and you'll find an endless source of relaxation and satisfying gameplay. Immerse yourself in the best cooking puzzle game out there, and complete the fantasy cafe of your dreams!
Features: 
MERGE - Combine different items into new ones! Hundreds of combinations of tasty food await!
SERVE - Your cooking will be put to a good use to be enjoyed by your forest friends!
COLLECT - Discover every item and combination, find special items and treasure!
RELAX - Slow paced and mind jolting!
PLAY AS YOU WANT - Play as little or as much as you want. No time pressure here!

bluejetty:00066281:ios.name: Simon's Cat - Crunch Time
bluejetty:00066281:ios.summary: The tasty treats have vanished, and only Simon’s Cat can bring them back! The mischievous crow has swiped all the cookies, and now it’s up to you to connect treats, combine colors, and complete match-3 puzzles in this adorable puzzle game.
bluejetty:00066281:ios.description:
The tasty treats have vanished, and only Simon’s Cat can bring them back! The mischievous crow has swiped all the cookies, and now it’s up to you to connect treats, combine colors, and complete match-3 puzzles in this adorable puzzle game. 
Join Simon’s Cat, Maisy, Chloe, and Jazz on a delightful journey through charming locations in Simon’s Cat Crunch Time. Solve fun and challenging match-3 levels, fight off tricky villains, and uncover exciting seasonal surprises along the way!
Pawsome Features:
Simple & Addictive Gameplay – Match and connect treats to create powerful combos!
Hundreds of Levels – Explore crunch time challenges and unlock new adventures.
Fight Off Villains – Beat Sir Royston the Pug, Mr. Potts, and other snack-stealing troublemakers!
Purrfect Power-Ups – Use special boosters to boom through obstacles and complete tricky puzzles!
Play with Friends – Join a team, compare scores, and challenge your friends to see who can beat the most levels! Exciting Events – Discover limited-time challenges and treasure-filled surprises!
With regular updates, new levels, and adorable animations, there’s always something fresh in Simon’s Cat Crunch Time! Play now and enjoy a cat-puzzle game full of tasty treats and endless fun!

bluejetty:00119971:ios.name: Central Hospital Stories
bluejetty:00119971:ios.summary: Hurry up doctor, we have an emergency in Central Hospital! A pregnant woman is on her way in the ambulance to give birth, and there is a patient waiting in the laboratory to perform different medical tests to get a diagnosis to his illness
bluejetty:00119971:ios.description:
Hurry up doctor, we have an emergency in Central Hospital! A pregnant woman is on her way in the ambulance to give birth, and there is a patient waiting in the laboratory to perform different medical tests to get a diagnosis to his illness and be able to cure him. There's a lot to be done!
Central Hospital Stories is an advanced hospital, full of activities and things to do, where countless adventures and stories between doctors and patients waits for you inside their facilities full of interactions and surprises.
Designed for children, and not so children, between 4 and 14 years old, but appropriate to be enjoyed by the whole family, this new game expands the universe of the saga Stories to trigger your imagination and creativity. Creating stories from the day-to-day in a hospital such as real emergencies in this advanced health facilities.
DISCOVER AN ADVANCED HOSPITAL AND ITS FACILITIES
A five-story hospital with 8 different medical units, a reception, waiting room, ambulance entrance and restaurant that you can visit and manage as you wish. Create stories about medical checkups, diagnoses with X-rays and other advanced machines and cure different illnesses.
The hospital includes a family doctor consultation, a veterinarian, a maternity ward where pregnant women will be able to give birth, an intensive care nursing unit for children and another one for adults, a cutting-edge laboratory, a modern operating room and an staff room where the staff will rest and prepare for the next shift.
CREATE YOUR HOSPITAL STORIES
With so many locations, characters and objects you'll never run out of ideas for your stories. Have fun helping pregnant women to see their new baby in the ultrasound monitor and then help them to give birth, research diseases in the laboratory and perform urgent operations in the operating room or live the day-to-day life of a family doctor doing a routine medical check on the whole family. You Decide!
FEATURES
- Infinite ways to play on 5 floors with 8 medical units: family doctor consultation, veterinarian, maternity, intensive care nursing unit for children and another one for adults, laboratory, operating room and staff room.
- In Addition to the reception there are several common areas that you can also explore: A waiting room, an ambulance entrance and a restaurant.
- Play with 37 characters of different species, ages and genres, representing different roles, both patients and hospital staff.
The free game includes 6 locations and 13 characters for you to play unlimited and try the possibilities of the game. Once you're sure, you'll be able to enjoy the remaining locations through a unique purchase, which will unlock the 13 locations and 37 characters forever.
About PlayToddlers
PlayToddlers games have been developed to be enjoyed by all members of the family, regardless of their age. We promote responsible social values and healthy habits in a safe and controlled environment without violence or advertisements from third parties.

Are you tired of the complexities with tracking your parcels and deliveries? Say no more! CDEK is here to make revolutionary changes in your delivery and parcel
bluejetty:00083251:ios.description:
CDEK Delivery & Parcel Tracker App: Your Ultimate Package Management Solution!
Are you tired of the complexities with tracking your parcels and deliveries? Say no more! CDEK is here to make revolutionary changes in your delivery and parcel tracking experience. We understand that package management can be a real challenge, and we've designed this app to simplify your life.
- User-Friendly Parcel Tracker Say goodbye to package tracking hassles! CDEK puts the power to track your parcels at any time and place. Whether it's a business package, a personal delivery, or even an international shipment, you can easily track it all from one convenient place. No more uncertainty about your package arrival time – you'll always know its exact location and when to expect it with our parcel tracker.
- Flexible Delivery Options We offer a range of choice tailored to your needs. Select the courier delivery, convenient collection points, or parcel locker drop-off locations. We're glad to give you the flexibility to decide how and where you want your packages to be delivered. And if you're in a hurry, our express delivery service ensures your parcel reaches its destination in record time. 
- Your Parcel, Your Schedule Life can get busy, and we understand that. That's why our app lets you schedule deliveries at your convenience. Choose your preferred delivery time, and we'll make sure it happens when it suits you. No more waiting around for the courier – it's in control, especially with our parcel tracker feature.
- Earn Rewards We value your loyalty, and our Cashback Program is our way of showing it. Earn cashback points for every delivery and payment via the app. You can use these points to cover up to 99% of your future costs. Besides, our CDEK ID feature streamlines the process, allowing you to receive parcels without needing a passport.
- International Deliveries Made Simple Now, with CDEK Delivery & Parcel Tracker app, you can make orders from abroad, pay in your currency, and leave the rest to us. Fast courier delivery to your doorstep or other services are available – the global connection is easy now.
- Seamless Mobile Experience Our app is designed with your needs in mind. Creating a delivery order is a breeze. Simply enter your shipment details, shipping and pickup addresses, and choose your preferred payment method. Want to stay updated? You can enable push notifications for real-time delivery status alerts from CDEK parcel tracker.
- Convenient Payment Options Whether you prefer cash, credit card, or other online payment methods, you can choose your more convenient way for you to do it.
- Find Nearby Delivery Points Locating the nearest parcel CDEK points has never been easier. Our in-app map integrated with the parcel tracker guides you effortlessly, providing working hours and helping you plan the best route. With CDEK ID integration, you can receive your packages without the paperwork routine.
- Leave Your Review Your feedback matters to us. After each delivery, you have the opportunity to rate and review our parcel service. Your input helps us continuously improve and provide the best possible experience, whether it's parcel tracking, courier delivery, etc.
- About Us CDEK is a leading full-service logistics company with over two decades of experience. Our mission is to simplify the delivery process for businesses and individuals alike. We've earned our reputation as the top choice for Eastern Europe, offering a vast network of over 4,000 offices and 6000+ dedicated couriers.
Join Us Today Are you ready to revolutionize your parcel management experience? Install the CDEK Delivery & Parcel Tracker app now and take control of your deliveries. Say goodbye to the hassles and hello to seamless parcel management. Download the app and experience the future of delivery!

bluejetty:00087624:ios.name: ChatGum - Chat & Make Friends
bluejetty:00087624:ios.summary: Looking for a fun, safe, and free app to make friends online? Welcome to ChatGum — the best lightweight chat app to join vibrant chat communities, connect through shared interests, and express yourself with avatars, emojis, and custom profi
bluejetty:00087624:ios.description:
Looking for a fun, safe, and free app to make friends online? Welcome to ChatGum — the best lightweight chat app to join vibrant chat communities, connect through shared interests, and express yourself with avatars, emojis, and custom profiles.
Whether you're into anime roleplay, music, pop culture, language exchange, or casual socializing, ChatGum has themed chat rooms tailored just for you.
Chat in Themed Chat Rooms
Each chat room represents a unique topic or interest, so you can join communities that match your vibe. Move your avatar, talk to other users, and dive into real-time conversations. From anime chat rooms to local language groups, there's a place for everyone.
Private Messenger
Use our private chat messenger to have more personal, one-on-one conversations. Messages are delivered instantly, and your friends can reply later if they’re offline. Build closer connections in a relaxed, private space.
Message Boards (Tiles)
Want deeper discussions? Every room has message boards (we call them tiles) for slower, topic-focused conversations. Unlike regular chat, tiles don’t disappear—so you can join the conversation at any time and keep the discussion going.
Start a topic, post replies, react with emojis, and like messages to save them for later. It’s perfect for thoughtful discussions and building lasting communities.
Create Your Profile
Customize your social profile with photos, backgrounds, and a bio full of text and emojis. Show off your interests, attract followers, and grow your presence across the platform.
Unique Animated Emojis
Express yourself with a collection of custom animated emojis made just for ChatGum. Stand out in chat with reactions that are fun, colorful, and totally unique.
Control Your Privacy
We put you in control. Choose who can message you—block users, allow DMs from friends only, or disable private messages entirely. Your experience is in your hands.
Social Discovery Made Simple
Whether you're looking for friends who love K-pop, anime, roleplaying, art, gaming, or just casual chat, ChatGum helps you connect and grow your social network. You can even share your other social handles in your bio to expand your reach.
100 Percent Free – No Hidden Fees
Enjoy unlimited chatting and messaging for free. No subscription required. And we do not display full-screen ads without your permission.
Lightweight and Fast
ChatGum is under 30MB and optimized for speed, so you can download it fast, chat instantly, and save on data.
Join the Conversation
Whether you’re here to meet new people, find your community, or simply express yourself, ChatGum is your all-in-one social app.
Follow ChatGum on Social Media
Instagram https://instagram.com/make.friends
Twitter https://twitter.com/MobileChatApp
Facebook https://facebook.com/ChatGum
All users must follow our safety guidelines. Moderation is strictly enforced to keep our community respectful and fun. Please read our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy before joining.

Stay up-to-date with the latest news and weather in the Portland, Oregon and Southwest Washington area on the all-new free KGW app from KGW.
Our app features the latest breaking news that impacts you and your family, interactive weather and radar, and live video from our newscasts and local events.
LOCAL & BREAKING NEWS
• Receive real-time notifications for breaking news
• Read the latest news as it happens in your area
• Explore exclusive investigative stories
• Browse photos, news clips, and raw video
LOCAL WEATHER
• Daily and hourly forecasts for your city
• The latest forecasts from our meteorologists
• Interactive radar maps
• Automated hyperlocal severe weather alerts
LIVE VIDEO
• Watch live video newscasts and breaking news from KGW
PERSONALIZATION
• Discover and dive into topics that matter to you
• Favorite topics to receive personalized updates

• See the latest updates and behind the scenes photos from your favorite anchors and reporters
• Get information on school delays & closings as they happen
• Cast videos and livestreams directly to your TV or streaming device, so you can lean back and enjoy your favorite programming on your biggest screen.
This is the official app of KGW and KGW.com, the NBC affiliate serving the Portland, Oregon and Southwest Washington areas.

SportsID is your personal mobile partner in the world of sports.
With sports events, exclusive content, fast-breaking news, more than 10.000 events per year and over 5 million athletes and participants worldwide, you're never without somet
bluejetty:00161885:ios.description:
SportsID is your personal mobile partner in the world of sports.
With sports events, exclusive content, fast-breaking news, more than 10.000 events per year and over 5 million athletes and participants worldwide, you're never without something amazing to explore. Watch and follow your favourite athlete, compare yourself or others in the official rankings, and get detailed results of all sports events, tournaments, competitions and e-tournaments from around the world.
Featuring exclusive data from sportdata.org including the following sports types:
• Karate
• Kickboxing
• Ju-Jitsu
• Mixed Martial Arts
...and many more!
*** Top 3 Reasons to Download the SportsID App ***
1. NEVER MISS A SPORTS EVENT
Get sport news and latest announcements from sport events, tournaments, competitions and e-tournaments around the world. Get all information and sport data needed for participating or following a sports event, grab details about the registration, and get tips and quick links for preparing to participate in the event (tickets, hotels, flights and weather forecasts). Quickly find live matches, downloads, photos provided by the event and current live streams. See participating clubs and countries as well as all individual athletes and participants worldwide take will be compete in the event. Follow ongoing events and check back later for event results and videos.
2. FOLLOW YOUR FAVORITE ATHLETES
Are you interested in other athletes and want to get the latest results, event participations and recorded videos of the tournaments or do you want to follow your own athlete profile? Either way, you will get exclusive athlete profile data including the global ranking, past and future events, all individual ranking results of events and tournaments, and a map showing all event locations the athlete has been to. Following the achievements of others has never been easier!
3. GET THE LATEST RANKINGS
The SportsID app features detailed rankings from sportdata.org, separated by categories. Analyse the scores of athletes and enjoy watching improvements of yourself or others in the global rankings.
SportsID offers the largest and most diverse sports information worldwide. Including comprehensive coverage and latest news from more than 10.000 events per year and over 5 million athletes and participants from 240 countries worldwide and featuring exclusive data from sportdata.org, you can easily find what you are looking for.
So join the worldwide sports community and get moving with SportsID today!

bluejetty:00061122:ios.name: FAVES Buyer – Boutique Buying
bluejetty:00061122:ios.summary: Designed for boutique owners, fashion buyers, planners, and merchandisers, FAVES Buyer helps you capture product photos, product details, and buying decisions while ordering at markets, showrooms, trade shows, or buying online from wholesal
bluejetty:00061122:ios.description:
Designed for boutique owners, fashion buyers, planners, and merchandisers, FAVES Buyer helps you capture product photos, product details, and buying decisions while ordering at markets, showrooms, trade shows, or buying online from wholesale vendors. Everything you discover, consider, or order stays organized in one place.
Stop Relying on Your Camera Roll at Market
Buying at market can quickly fill your phone with hundreds of product photos.
FAVES keeps every product, vendor, price, and delivery organized so you always know:
• What you've already ordered
• What you're still considering
• What fits your assortment
• How much you've spent
Avoid duplicate buys, forgotten items, and budget surprises.
Capture Products Faster
Start by taking a photo of the product, then capture the product tag to record key details.
FAVES can read information directly from the tag, such as:
• Cost price
• Style number
• Color
• Delivery month
• Barcode (when available)
This helps pre-fill product information while buying so you can record items quickly and complete the remaining details later.
Buy at Market or Online
Retail buying now happens everywhere, not just at trade shows.
FAVES helps you stay organized whether you're:
• Buying at markets
• Visiting showrooms
• Buying from wholesale websites
• Reviewing products after market
Simply capture your orders into FAVES and keep every buying decision organized in one place.
Plan Your Buying Season and Stay on Budget
FAVES helps you manage your entire buying process - from planning to placing orders.
With FAVES you can:
• Capture and organize product images and order details
• Search for products by brand, category, color, delivery, or notes
• Print product collections or export them to Excel
• Budget by category or brand
• Track spending against your buying budget
• Manage open-to-buy (OTB) budgets
• Upload products directly to Shopify when you're ready to add them to your store
Track What’s On Order
FAVES gives you visibility into your incoming inventory.
You can:
• Track what products are on order
• See when items are expected to arrive
• Mark products as received when they arrive in store
• Maintain a clear overview of upcoming deliveries
FAVES helps you stay organized before inventory reaches your POS or inventory system.
Collaborate With Your Team
Multiple-user support makes it easy for buying teams to stay in sync.
Your product images and buying decisions are immediately visible to colleagues - whether back home or across the trade show floor.
Teams can review purchases, comment on products, and coordinate buying decisions.
With FAVES Buyer as your assistant, you can curate your collection with confidence, knowing that you have a complete overview of your orders and deliveries.
Start capturing products in seconds, just take a photo, capture the tag, and organize your buys.
Questions?
You can chat with us directly in the app. Just tap the help button. We’d love to hear from you!
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00023163:ios.summary:
Get the latest Oregon lottery results within minutes of the draws taking place. This easy-to-use app includes the following lotteries:
Powerball
Mega Millions
Megabucks
Lucky Lines
Pick 4
Win for Life
Powerball, Mega Millions, Megabucks,
bluejetty:00023163:ios.description:
Get the latest Oregon lottery results within minutes of the draws taking place. This easy-to-use app includes the following lotteries:
Powerball
Mega Millions
Megabucks
Lucky Lines
Pick 4
Win for Life
Powerball, Mega Millions, Megabucks, Lucky Lines and Win for Life also include a full breakdown displaying the number of winners and amount paid out for each prize level.
The following features are also included:
Ticket Checker
----------------------------
Enter and save your chosen numbers to see if you have won or to see how often they have come up in the past. You can also label your tickets – great if you play multiple lines or if you run a syndicate. The ticket checker also highlights prizes won on each ticket as well as calculating the total for each lottery. Only play lotteries on certain days of the week? Not a problem, you can exclude your checked tickets from draws you do not play.
Customizable Notifications
----------------------------
Get notified instantly when the latest lottery results and prize breakdowns become available. The App allows you to customise notifications for specific lottery games and you can also choose which days of the week you play. Want to know when the jackpot has rolled over or has reached a certain amount? Just head to the Notification section of the app to set up your alerts. There is also the option to set notifications at times that suit you - great for reminding you to purchase tickets before the draw.
Random Number Generator
-----------------------------
Stuck for numbers? Use this handy tool and let the app choose your numbers rather than having to rely on house numbers and anniversary dates!
Results Archive
----------------------------
Access to the full archive of results dating back to the first draw of each lottery.
Settings
----------------------------
Customise which lotteries display in the app and in which order.
Support
----------------------------
If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve this app, please get in touch at contact@lottery.net.

bluejetty:00140497:ios.name: Maze of Realities: Synergy F2P
bluejetty:00140497:ios.summary: Join the mystical adventure in "Maze of Realities: Synergy of Worlds", where you will help save the enchanted realm of Etheria from a dark force. This casual hidden object game free from Domini Games offers players the chance to become true
bluejetty:00140497:ios.description:
Join the mystical adventure in "Maze of Realities: Synergy of Worlds", where you will help save the enchanted realm of Etheria from a dark force. This casual hidden object game free from Domini Games offers players the chance to become true Guardians of the Tree and uncover hidden mysteries. Explore breathtaking scenes, solve mystical riddles, and immerse yourself in captivating storylines that will test your problem-solving skills. Can you unravel the truth before it's too late? The fate of Etheria rests in your hands!
The situation in Etheria has been unstable lately. The power cuts are becoming a constant occurrence, and the locals are forced to evacuate to other regions. These blackouts get fixed quickly, but rumors spread faster. Something bad is afoot, and you have to keep these rumors at bay. But they're not untrue. The World Tree, which feeds virtually everything in this world, right down to the portals through which you can no longer return home, has been struck by an unknown disease and is infecting the creatures around it, making them aggressive. The Tree has chosen several outlanders to protect the innocent etherians and find a cure. But do all of them have the Tree’s welfare at heart?
Epic Adventure!
Explore a captivating world of Etheria filled with logic puzzles, brain riddles and search and find games. Every location is a casual hidden object challenge, where you must search for hidden treasures, hidden objects and find objects in a picture and to progress in the game!
Fantasy-Themed Artwork!
Explore a magic mystery game brought to life by stunning fantasy-themed artwork and exciting point and click adventure games. Each visual element enriches the game's atmosphere and deepens your connection to the enchanting world of Etheria!
Challenging Puzzles and Mini-Games!
Sharpen your mind with over 100 logic puzzles, brain riddles and hidden objects challenges. As you explore Etheria, uncover the mystical riddles that drive the story forward, requiring you to find objects in a picture and play search and find games to reveal more secrets!
Intriguing Storyline!
Your choices throughout the game have a direct impact on the story’s outcome. As you progress, you'll engage in search and find games, find objects in a picture, and unravel secrets that will shape the destiny of Etheria, making each discovery even more significant!
Explore the magical world by Domini Games and see how your decisions can alter the course of the free-to-play version of the breathtaking adventure!
-----
Questions? Email us at support@dominigames.com
Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

Forge alliances with other players, negotiate agreements, and form powerful guilds to dominate the world together. Strength lies in unity!
◆ YOU ARE THE CONQUEROR!
Expand your territory, exploit resources, and eliminate your enemies to become the ultimate ruler.
Shape your own story today!

bluejetty:00063536:ios.summary:

HEARTMATH® SENSOR REQUIRED: This is the companion app to the Inner Balance sensor. It requires one of the HeartMa
bluejetty:00063536:ios.description:
Inner Balance™ gets your heart, mind, and emotions in sync for greater calm, focus, and a more balanced you in everyday life.
HEARTMATH® SENSOR REQUIRED: This is the companion app to the Inner Balance sensor. It requires one of the HeartMath Inner Balance sensors (e.g. Bluetooth® or the Inner Balance Lightning sensor), which connects to your device and clips to your earlobe to pick up your heart-rhythm pattern.
Inner Balance™ is a system of software and sensor that helps you strengthen your inner balance through training, guidance, and self-observation. It supports you in bringing your heart, mind, and emotions into a balanced, focused state (coherence), which you create yourself through calm breathing and positive focus.
More than 400 independent, peer-reviewed studies have been published on HeartMath technologies and methods. Inner Balance gives you a real-time coherence score as feedback, and guided meditations and dynamic graphics support you toward a calmer, more centered, and more focused state.
The HeartMath technology is for stress education and resilience training. It is not a medical device. We encourage you to consult a health professional before making any medical decisions.
LEARN HOW TO:
• Bring your heart, mind, and body into a calm, balanced state in the moment
• Settle reactive emotions and manage everyday stress
• Feel calmer, more centered, and more focused
• Access clearer thinking to support better everyday decisions
Just five minutes of coherence practice, three times a day, fits easily into your routine - and it’s enjoyable. Inner Balance guides you and tracks your progress as you shift your state and watch the changes occur in real time.
FEATURES: 
• Real-time HRV coherence feedback to guide your practice
• Guided meditations to support relaxation, focus, and a better wind-down before sleep
• Real-time coaching tips with encouraging on-screen prompts
• Advanced options: four challenge levels, customizable settings and screens
• Access to a free cloud platform to save and review all your sessions and get tips and training
WHAT REGULAR COHERENCE PRACTICE CAN SUPPORT: 
• A calmer way of handling everyday stress
• More focus and mental clarity, even under pressure
• Shifting more quickly into a state of calm and balance
• Quieting the mind and letting go of racing thoughts
• Strengthening inner resilience and recovering more quickly
• Training coordination and reaction time for athletes
• Complementing your own meditation practice
Inner Balance Bluetooth sensor: clip the sensor to your earlobe and press the soft button on the sensor pod to activate a blue flashing light. Open the app and press the “Start” arrow to scan for the sensor. When your sensor ID appears and matches the number on the back of the pod, tap to accept and wait 15–20 seconds for calibration to begin your first session.
Inner Balance Lightning sensor: follow the same steps to clip the sensor, open the app, and start your session.
You can purchase an Inner Balance sensor at https://store.heartmath.com/innerbalance.

bluejetty:00078893:ios.description:
WannaCook “Limited Ingredients, Endless Recipes!”
WannaCook is a social app where you can find all kinds of cooking recipes that you can imagine in just one place!
We believe that with the current circumstances that we all face, the decision of “what to cook” is very exhausting everyday especially for working moms. So, we thought of helping out. The app will offer a personalized menu of recipes that you can make using the ingredients you have in your kitchen.
All you need to do is download the app from Appstore/Playstore and sign up to create an account (either by normal or social signup) then you will be able to check our recipes. You can also save the ones you like, to cook later.
Our Key Features:
*Facebook sharing
* cool personalized menu of recipes that you can make using the ingredients you have in your kitchen.
* You can easily follow the steps of cooking a recipe and mark the steps you are done with to keep track.
* Over 15K recipes & still adding more everyday!
* Filter by food category to discover the perfect dish.
* Recipes are divided by kitchen type to help you find and cook your favorite country dish!
* Search for recipes and save your favorite ones to cook later.
* Vote for recipes and let the others know the best ones out there!
* You can use our app if you are on a diet, need healthy recipes for you or your kids, if you are a meat lover, salad lover, seafood lover or a dessert lover! & much more…
* You don’t have to worry about the signup process, you can use your Facebook, Google or Apple account to start using the app.

bluejetty:00078115:ios.description:
PLAY SMARTER GOLF
Arccos is the Official Game Tracker of the PGA TOUR. AI-powered game tracking and Smart Laser Rangefinder trusted by pros including Matt Fitzpatrick, and golfers at every level. Now improved with greater depth, personalization, focus, and actionable recommendations.
THE NEW ARCCOS APP — NOW ROLLING OUT ON iOS
The biggest update we've ever made. Every tab rebuilt. New AI features throughout. The app now tells you exactly what to do — not just what happened.
WHERE TO FOCUS — YOUR PERSONAL PRACTICE PLAN
Your Player tab pinpoints exactly where your next stroke is hiding across all four facets — Driving, Approach, Short Game, and Putting — using Strokes Gained analysis. Lock in a focus area and get personalized drill recommendations built from your own data. A real plan, for your game.
SHOT DISPERSION — SEE WHERE YOUR SHOTS ACTUALLY GO
Visual dispersion charts for every club. See where your shots land relative to target — consistency, miss tendencies, weapons vs. liabilities. The clearest scope of your ball-striking you've ever had.
AI ROUND SUMMARIES — YOUR ROUND, TOLD LIKE A STORY
After every round: an AI-generated summary of what actually happened. Skill Score, Club MVP, PGA Tour Quality Shots, Round Arc, and a Practice Focus with specific drills to work on before your next tee time.
COURSES — YOUR GOLF PASSPORT
A global map of every course you've ever played. Tap any course for hole-by-hole Strokes Gained, AI Course Insights, and Hole Highlights showing exactly which holes have been costing you strokes.
PRE-ROUND WARMUP — SHOW UP READY
A personalized 15, 30, or 60-minute range routine, generated based on your recent data and current focus. Specific clubs, specific drills. Practice with purpose.
ARCCOS AIR — FIRST YEAR FREE
No sensors required. Slip the Air AI wearable into your pocket and play. AI trained on 1.5 billion shots automatically detects every shot with Tour-level accuracy. Or add Smart Sensors for definitive club-by-club analysis. Your choice, every round. Link Pro users upgrade automatically — no purchase required.
SMART LASER RANGEFINDER — FIRST YEAR FREE
Know it's 176 yards to carry the bunker. Slope-only rangefinders capture just 19% of distance adjustments. Smart Laser factors in slope, wind, temperature, humidity, and altitude to capture it all, often making a club’s difference. Auto pin-setting syncs the flag to your app automatically.
AI STRATEGY & GREEN MAPS — ALL iOS SUBSCRIBERS
Recommended club and optimal target every shot, based on your tendencies, course layout, hazards, and conditions. The same strategy Matt Fitzpatrick used to win his major. Green Maps: LiDAR-mapped to 1mm precision across 9,000+ courses in the US, 3,000+ worldwide. See slopes, breaks, and exact pin position.
AUTOMATIC GAME TRACKING
Every shot tracked across 18 holes on 40,000+ courses worldwide. Strokes Gained Analytics. Smart Club Distances — your real numbers, not your best guesses.
RESULTS
New Arccos members lower their handicaps by 25% on average in the first year. Hit approach shots 14.9 feet closer and sink more birdies. With lower scores, you’ll have more to celebrate and share at the 19th hole.
- Official Game Tracker of the PGA TOUR
- 1.5 billion shots, 4 trillion data points
- Works with Arccos Air, Smart Sensors, Smart Laser, Link/Link Pro, Apple Watch
- Fast Company World's Most Innovative Companies — #3 in Sports
- Partners: PGA TOUR, PING, Cobra Golf, Club Champion, Golf Digest
Stop guessing. Start knowing. Play better golf.

bluejetty:00163395:ios.description:
The Official Caltex App offers day-to-day drivers an easy way to Pay for fuel. With more Rewards in CaltexGO, there are so many ways to maximize your petrol savings now. Earn loyalty points and redeem them on your next petrol purchase at the nearest Caltex gas station. Conveniently save and pay for petrol in a single mobile app with digital vouchers before they expire. CaltexGO is available across Singapore, Philippines, Malaysia, Australia and Hong Kong.
New: Secure PIN & Payment Authentication
We've introduced a secure PIN system to better protect your account and transactions. You'll now use your PIN to log in, update your profile, and authorize fuel payments (where applicable) - giving you more control and a safer experience.
Not all features are available in all locations. To see what CaltexGO offers in your region, visit caltex website now.
Caltex Singapore www.caltex.com/sg
Caltex Philippines www.caltex.com/ph
Caltex Malaysia www.caltex.com/my
Caltex Australia www.caltex.com/au
Caltex Hong Kong www.caltex.com/hk
How does our fuel membership work?
1. Pay for fuel with cash, credit card, or the CaltexGO app (if in-app pump & pay is available in your region) at our accepting Caltex stations.
2. Collect Loyalty Points by presenting Rewards QR code from your app / using in-app pump & pay.
3. Track your fuel transactions for smarter spending. 
4. Scan your vouchers code and redeem exclusive offers at our stations.
Where to find Caltex pump stations?
Our in-app navigation feature helps you locate the nearest Caltex petrol station to you, anywhere and anytime.
Even more rewarding for opt-in members
Get notified whenever there are new Caltex promotions or discount vouchers. More exciting petrol offers, and rewards are coming, joy made for you for being with Caltex. This is exclusively for opt-in members only.

bluejetty:00144829:ios.name: 600 Câu Lý Thuyết GPLX OTOMOTO
bluejetty:00144829:ios.summary: * Ứng dụng OTOMOTO bao gồm đầy đủ 600 câu hỏi mới nhất 2026, cùng với 60 câu điểm liệt, dùng cho ôn thi kỳ thi sát hạch cấp giấy phép lái xe (GPLX) phương tiện cơ giới đường bộ. Ứng dụng giúp ích và phù hợp với các bạn đang chuẩn bị thi bằn
bluejetty:00144829:ios.description:
* Ứng dụng OTOMOTO bao gồm đầy đủ 600 câu hỏi mới nhất 2026, cùng với 60 câu điểm liệt, dùng cho ôn thi kỳ thi sát hạch cấp giấy phép lái xe (GPLX) phương tiện cơ giới đường bộ. Ứng dụng giúp ích và phù hợp với các bạn đang chuẩn bị thi bằng lái xe máy và ô tô, có thể ôn tập phần lý thuyết một cách nhanh chóng, hiệu quả và chính xác nhất.
* Trong bộ đề 600 câu, đã có bao gồm 250 câu hỏi cho bằng lái xe máy A1 và A; và 300 câu hỏi cho bằng lái mô tô B1.
* Hỗ trợ ôn thi giấy phép lái xe - bằng lái xe, ô tô xe máy với tất cả các hạng GPLX:
 - 250 câu hỏi lý thuyết GPLX mô tô hạng A1, A.
 - 300 câu hỏi lý thuyết GPLX mô tô hạng B1.
 - 600 câu hỏi lý thuyết GPLX ô tô hạng C1, C, D1, D2, D, E, Rơ-moóc.
 - 60 câu hỏi về xử lý tình huống mất an toàn giao thông nghiêm trọng (câu điểm liệt).
* Bố cục bộ 600 câu hỏi:
 - Chương I: Gồm 180 câu về Quy định chung và quy tắc giao thông đường bộ (từ câu số 1 đến câu số 180).
 - Chương II: Gồm 25 câu về Văn hóa giao thông, đạo đức người lái xe, kỹ năng phòng cháy, chữa cháy và cứu hộ, cứu nạn (từ câu số 181 đến câu số 205).
 - Chương III: Gồm 58 câu về Kỹ thuật lái xe (từ câu 206 đến câu 263).
 - Chương IV: Gồm 37 câu về Cấu tạo và sửa chữa (từ câu 264 đến câu 300).
 - Chương V: Gồm 185 câu về Báo hiệu đường bộ (từ số 301 đến câu số 485).
 - Chương VI: Gồm 115 câu về Giải thế sa hình và kỹ năng xử lý tình huống giao thông (từ số 486 đến câu số 600).
 - Trong bộ 600 câu hỏi có 60 câu hỏi về xử lý tình huống mất an toàn giao thông nghiêm trọng, mỗi đề sát hạch có một câu, thí sinh lựa chọn đáp án sai tại câu này được tính là điểm liệt, bài thi lý thuyết sẽ không đạt yêu cầu
* Các chức năng chính của ứng dụng ôn thi giấy phép lái xe (GPLX) 2026
 - Ôn tập bộ 600 câu hỏi mới nhất 2026 với danh sách câu hỏi được chia theo từng chủ đề rõ ràng.
 - Ôn tập theo các chủ đề: câu hỏi điểm liệt; khái niệm và quy tắc; nghiệp vụ vận tải; văn hóa và đạo đức lái xe; kỹ thuật lái xe; cấu tạo và sửa chữa; biển báo đường bộ; sa hình.
 - Thi thử lý thuyết với bộ đề có sẵn hoặc ngẫu nhiên theo cấu trúc ra đề của Bộ Giao Thông Vận Tải, cho các loại bằng lái xe máy A1, A, B1; và ô tô B, C1, C, D1, D2, D, và E Rơ-moóc.
 - Danh sách 60 câu hỏi điểm liệt - tình huống vi phạm luật giao thông nghiêm trọng.
 - Lưu câu hỏi để tiện xem lại sau, đặc biệt hữu ích với các câu điểm liệt và hóc búa.
 - Xem lại các câu hỏi đã làm sai, giúp bạn ôn phần lý thuyết nhanh chóng và tiện lợi hơn.
 - Xem và học danh sách các câu hỏi thường bị sai.
 - Mẹo ghi nhớ lý thuyết và sa hình (thi thực hành).
 - Tra cứu biển báo đầy đủ giúp bạn tra cứu nhanh chóng biển báo trong khi ôn tập.
 - Tra cứu luật giao thông đường bộ thông dụng theo từng nhóm.
 - Tra cứu nhanh từng biển báo giao thông trong các câu hỏi có biển báo.
 - Hỗ trợ bình luận và trợ giúp từ cộng đồng.
* Điều khoản miễn trừ
Ứng dụng OTOMOTO là một ứng dụng tiện ích do bên thứ ba (cá nhân/tổ chức tư nhân) phát triển nhằm hỗ trợ người dùng ôn tập và chuẩn bị tốt nhất các nội dung cho kỳ thi sát hạch cấp GPLX. Nội dung trong ứng dụng được xây dựng dựa trên cách thức và đáp án từ bộ 600 câu hỏi dùng cho ôn tập và sát hạch cấp GPLX của Cục Cảnh sát giao thông. Chúng tôi không đưa ra bất cứ đảm bảo nào bao gồm nhưng không giới hạn về tính ổn định của ứng dụng, tính xác thực của thông tin mà bạn tiếp nhận khi sử dụng ứng dụng. Để đảm bảo mọi thông tin chính xác nhất, vui lòng truy cập website Cục cảnh sát giao thông.
Trong mọi trường hợp, bạn đồng ý đảm bảo rằng chúng tôi miễn trừ khỏi mọi trách nhiệm liên quan đến bất kỳ tổn thất, thiệt hại, chi phí nào gây ra bởi việc sử dụng hoặc không sử dụng ứng dụng.
Chính sách riêng tư: https://onthigiaypheplaixe.com/privacyandterms/gplx600-privacy-policy.html
Điều khoản sử dụng: https://onthigiaypheplaixe.com/privacyandterms/gplx600-terms-of-use.html

Every year our life becomes more and more unpredictable. We have done everything to help our users and make their lives easier, more exciting and better. Our apps are your personal refuge from any adversity and the best stargazer on the way to your goals. 
Numia is the best astrological service specializing in numerology, horoscopes, compatibility, biorhythms and much more. More than a million installations, constant updates and real professionals in the field of astrology.
Free sections of our astrological service:
1. Personal classic horoscope for the day/week/month/year. The horoscope is compiled by a professional astrologer, taking into account all your unique characteristics: the zodiac sign, the natal chart, the position of the planets and so on. That's why we say Numia is a daily app. 
2. Compatibility of zodiac signs in love, friendship, work, bed. It is compiled based on all your profile data, which gives the most accurate assessment taking into account the most important characteristics of your personality. It is also possible to quickly compare the biorhythm graphs of the two partners. It's easy to find out everything about compatibility with a partner, friend or girlfriend using our application. Full immersion in the study of co star astrology.
3. Numerology. You can find out the number of the personality, the personal number for the day, month and year, the number of the soul, the number of the name, the number of fate. Also included in the functionality are: The Pythagorean Matrix, the Alexandrov Matrix. 
4. The magic ball of fate. Every day you can receive advice from the ball of fate and find out what our magic artifact has prepared for you.
5. Lunar horoscope. The influence of the Moon will play into your hands if you are aware of all the important aspects phase of the moon. 
6. Easily track changes in the phases of the moon. 
7. Biorhythms. Daily indicators of your biorhythms will help you use your strength correctly and be more successful. 
8. The meaning of the name and the meaning of the letters of the name. 
9. Happy and unhappy days. 
10. Palmistry. Our service will provide interpretations of the lines of your palm and lift the veil of secrecy about your present and future. 
11. Retrograde planets. We will warn you about the retrograde of Mercury, Mars and Venus so that you are prepared for the most unexpected situations. 
When joining Numia Club, you will open the following sections: 
1. Alternative horoscopes. A huge database of horoscopes. The library consists of the following horoscopes: Zodiac, Chinese, Slavic, Turkish, Viking, Japanese, Maya, Greek, Druids, Floral, Indian, Zoroastrian, Indian horoscope.
2. Your personality. We will tell you everything about your character and temperament, identify strengths and weaknesses and teach you how to use it. 
3. Choosing a name for a child. An important section for those who are waiting for replenishment in the family. Our astrologers will choose the perfect name for your baby. 
4. Idling of the Moon. The best protection against the negative influences of the Moon is to know exactly about the periods of its idling. 
5. Dream book. A huge database of dream interpretation. 
6. Calendar of beauty, gardener, health, love, business. The best adviser on taking care of yourself, your garden and an assistant in love and business. 
Our daily app also includes the following functionality:
* Possibility to choose the European and Eastern calendar.
* Round-the-clock chats with professional astrologers. 
* Possibility to order a personal study. 
* The database contains more than 2,800 different names.
* Customizable biorhythm notifications.
Your fate depends on you! See for yourself that you can easily use our app to improve your quality of life! We take into account every review and any useful criticism or suggestions to make the app better.

bluejetty:00187243:ios.name: ScoutIQ
bluejetty:00187243:ios.summary: ScoutIQ is a scouting app designed for enterprise-level Amazon professional sellers. If you're looking to make money by selling books - or anything else - on Amazon, this is the app for you! Whether you sell Merchant Fulfilled or FBA item
bluejetty:00187243:ios.description:
ScoutIQ is a scouting app designed for enterprise-level Amazon professional sellers. If you're looking to make money by selling books - or anything else - on Amazon, this is the app for you! Whether you sell Merchant Fulfilled or FBA items on Amazon, ScoutIQ’s mission is to leverage data to help you scout SMARTER, not harder.
Key features include:
++ Downloadable Database - helps you access data faster and in areas without cell coverage
++ eScore - our proprietary data point that gives you “x-ray vision” into a book’s historical sales without leaving the app’s scout screen (no need to pull up Keepa or Camel charts!)
++ Team Mode - scale your enterprise-level scout team by adding child accounts (at a discounted rate), turn on Hidden Mode remotely, in real time, and manage your team through a centralized web portal. This is a game changer in the industry, allowing you to build your team across the country without physically touching their phone.
++ Multiple Trigger Profiles - you can tailor your scouting rules to your unique situation. Build one set for thrift stores, another for retail arbitrage, and another for garage sales. Easily switch triggers when you're out in the field to take advantage of the opportunities around you!
++ Advanced Product Lookups - manually type in ISBNs, use your phone's camera to scan a barcode, or pair the app with a Bluetooth barcode scanner at no extra cost to quickly analyze products that you're hoping to flip
++ Smart Triggers - advanced, customizable triggers look at multiple data points to help you pick a realistic list price for every item that you scan, minimizing blind spots that exist with other apps
++ ScanTracker - measure key scanning stats to identify which sources are worth returning to at a later date
++ Scout Lite Screen - a simplified screen with color-coded bars that help you make faster sourcing decisions
++ Profit-based Approach - our triggers focus on your estimated payout after a book sells, not on the expected list price, so you can make decisions that impact your bottom line, not just your top line
Built for sellers by sellers - we understand the market because we sell in it every single day. We’re proud to employ a US-based support team to help answer your questions.
ScoutIQ pulls data from the US and UK markets only (amazon.com and amazon.co.uk), but we’re looking into opportunities to expand into additional countries and markets.
If you find any bugs or have ideas for improving the app, please reach out to us! We value your feedback and are committed to providing the very best app to help eCommerce sellers manage their businesses more effectively.

Your mind deserves a space where it can breathe.
Purpose is your intelligent journaling companion—designed to help you understand your emotions, uncover hidden patterns, and grow into the person you're meant to be. It's not just a diary; it's a mirror that reflects back your truest self.
Journaling that meets you where you are. Blank pages can be intimidating. Purpose guides you with AI-powered questions crafted from your own memories, moods, and experiences. Morning intentions, evening reflections, or themed sessions for anxiety, gratitude, and emotional healing—there's always a space that fits your moment.

Interactive journals that surprise you. Find your perfect city match. Visualize your ideal soulmate. These playful experiences turn self-discovery into something you'll actually look forward to.

Start building a relationship with the most important person in your life—yourself.

Play 60 turns of Civilization VI for FREE!
————————————————————
U P G R A D E · TO · K E E P · P L A Y I N G
————————————————————
Originally created by legendary game designer Sid Meier, Civilization is a turn-based strategy game in which you attempt to build an empire to stand the test of time. Become Ruler of the World by establishing and leading a civilization from the Stone Age to the Information Age. Wage war, conduct diplomacy, advance your culture, and go head-to-head with history’s greatest leaders as you attempt to build the greatest civilization the world has ever known.
————————————————————————
 C R O S S -P L A T F O R M · C L O U D · S A V E S
————————————————————————
Civilization VI supports cross-platform cloud saves between all your favorite devices. When you own Civilization VI on multiple platforms, you can continue playing on compatible save files between your favorite devices. Link your 2K Account, tick the multi-platform cloud save box in options, and you're good to go! 
Get your 2K Account: accounts.2k.com/signup
————————————————————————
A D D I T I O N A L · C O N T E N T · A V A I L A B L E
————————————————————————
Expand your Civilization VI experience throughout world history with additional leaders, civilizations and features! 
The Rise and Fall expansion introduces new Great Ages, Loyalty, and Governors systems, expands existing Diplomacy and Government systems, and adds a variety of new units, districts, wonders, buildings, and more.
The Gathering Storm expansion adds new Environmental Effects, Engineering Projects, Power and Consumable Resources, as well as the World Congress and a new Diplomatic Victory. 
New Frontier Pass introduces 6 new game modes that allow you to play with recruitable heroes from history and myth, dial-up natural disasters in Apocalypse Mode, or join secret societies that can enhance or undermine your empire. 
With Leader Pass, explore 18 new ways to play with a new roster of 12 leaders and 6 new personas for your Civilization VI experience. Break out of your comfort zone with new approaches to diplomacy, war & expansion. Each leader has a suite of new or updated abilities.
Complete your Civilization VI experience with these expansions plus additional scenario packs, available now as In-App Purchases.

bluejetty:00175810:ios.description:
Welcome to the exciting world of DOP Yes Yes: Delete One Part! Embark on a thrilling puzzle adventure in this casual game on your mobile phone. Your objective is to conquer challenging levels by strategically removing objects to solve the puzzles. Get ready for a unique gameplay experience centered around the intriguing concept of Delete One Part!
 In DOP Yes Yes: Delete One Part, you will encounter a mysterious and somewhat scary Monster. Each level revolves around escaping or defeating this scary monster. Take part in a series of challenging puzzles in which you must deftly remove certain parts or objects to complete the level. Navigate through various intricately designed scenarios, and be prepared to encounter surprises at every level..
 How to play:
- Delete it is easy! You just need to touch the screen and drag your finger to erase one part of the picture and see what lies behind it.
- The game looks simple, but it's easy to get fooled.
- Your eraser is the key to unraveling the hidden mysteries of this delete puzzle. You will have to become a wise erase master and investigate the pictures carefully to identify clues.
 With each level, the challenges become more complex, requiring you to think outside the box. Exercise your creativity as you devise unique strategies to dismantle obstacles and outsmart the formidable Monster. Pay attention to the clues and hints scattered throughout the game to aid your progress.
 Feature:
- The delete one part puzzles demand logical and creative thinking to solve.
- Challenge yourself with hundreds of tricky delete puzzles. Each level of the Delete One Part game will stimulate your brain to approach problems in new ways.
- Clear graphics, vibrant colors, lively music, and captivating animations make the erase one part game much more enjoyable.
- Multiple language support is available in this delete puzzle game.
- If you make a wrong deletion, try again. There are no penalties for solving the puzzles incorrectly.
- If you're truly stuck, you can always ask for hints.
- New levels will be regularly updated to keep the game fresh and exciting.
 Are you ready to take on the monster and conquer all the levels in DOP Yes Yes: Delete One Part? Challenge yourself, embrace the thrill of partial removal, and prove your mastery of the puzzles. Get ready to face the Monster head-on in this addictive and exciting adventure!

bluejetty:00175344:ios.summary:
Albertsons Grocery Deals & Delivery

bluejetty:00175344:ios.description:
Albertsons Grocery Deals & Delivery 
Shop, save & simplify your meal planning with Albertsons’s all-in-one grocery app. Find everything you need, from fresh produce to pet food, pharmacy prescriptions and fuel. Choose convenience that fits your schedule: grocery delivery or DriveUp & Go™ grocery pickup service. 
CONVENIENT GROCERY DELIVERY OR PICKUP 
Get grocery delivery or choose DriveUp & Go™ for easy curbside grocery pickup. Use Schedule & Save to automate your household essentials and save more on every order. Flash™ 30-minute delivery available in select markets for additional convenience. 
SEND GROCERIES AS A GIFT 
Shop, add a personalized message & send fresh groceries, flowers, chocolates or everyday essentials to anyone — delivered to their door or ready for store pickup. Select "Make this order a gift" at checkout, with no extra gifting fees. It is the perfect way to care for loved ones, celebrate special occasions, send a thoughtful thank-you gift or help out a friend with a fully stocked fridge. 
MEET YOUR AI SHOPPING ASSISTANT 
Take the guesswork out of meals with Ask AI. Use everyday language to ask for recipe ideas, find items based on dietary needs or compare products. Whether you're asking "What can I make with chicken and rice?" or looking for "gluten-free snacks," our assistant helps you build your grocery list fast. 
MEAL PLANNING & RECIPES 
Get inspired with thousands of shoppable recipes designed to fit every budget and preference. Import your favorite recipes into the app to convert ingredients into a digital shopping list. Plan your weekly menu & add all necessary items to your grocery shopping list with a single tap. 
SHOP EASIER & FASTER 
Quickly add items to your cart based on frequent purchases, recommendations & past orders. View and reorder from your order history at any time. Save your favorite household items, scan barcodes at home to add products to your digital cart instantly and build repeatable shopping lists. 
LOYALTY, DEALS & COUPONS 
Maximize your budget by clipping digital coupons, tracking your fuel points and watching your savings stack up automatically at checkout. Find hundreds of weekly grocery coupons, digital offers and exclusive sales. Earn, track and redeem Albertsons for U™ rewards automatically as you shop. Try FreshPass® for unlimited free grocery delivery on eligible orders, exclusive perks and subscriber-only savings. 
SECURE SNAP/EBT & WIC PAYMENT OPTIONS 
Use your SNAP/EBT benefits to easily pay for online grocery delivery and DriveUp & Go™ grocery pickup orders on eligible items, subject to state availability. WIC benefits are also accepted in store at participating Albertsons locations only. 
YOUR NEIGHBORHOOD PHARMACY & HEALTH APP 
Order eligible prescriptions in the app and pick them up curbside through DriveUp & Go™ at 1,700+ participating pharmacy locations nationwide. Transfer your prescriptions to save more on your next grocery order, refill scripts for your family or pets, schedule vaccine appointments, access health tests and manage your wellness goals with Sincerely Health. Choose to bundle your Rx with your grocery pickup in one easy trip or go pharmacy-only. 
BUILD HEALTHY HABITS 
Monitor your nutrition, steps, sleep and activity. Earn rewards as you eat better, move more and stay active through the Sincerely Health wellness hub. Take advantage of custom health insights, track your daily wellness metrics, unlock premium rewards for making positive health choices and set achievable goals that support your complete physical well-being. 
FUEL 
Now you can pay and redeem Points for Fuel in the app. Save 10 cents off per gallon for every 100 Points, up to $1 off per gallon. Drive up, fill up and go! Available at select Safeway, Albertsons, Tom Thumb, Randalls, Carrs, Acme, and Vons-owned stations. 
Download the Albertsons app and sign in or create your account to start shopping, saving and simplifying your week.

bluejetty:00179363:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone into a powerful smart TV remote and control compatible TVs over Wi-Fi. Manage multiple TVs from a single app and stop searching for physical remotes.
Connect your iPhone and TV to the same Wi-Fi network, complete a simple pairing process, and start controlling your TV directly from your phone. The app provides convenient navigation tools such as keyboard input, touchpad controls, and quick access shortcuts to make everyday TV interaction easier.
Compatibility
The app supports smart TVs running compatible WebOS-based and Netcast-based systems (2012 models and later).
This app supports compatibility with certain LG Smart TV models via standard network control protocols.
Key Features
Control multiple TVs from one app
Instant channel access without scrolling through channel lists on the TV
Quick launch TV apps directly from your phone
Create channel shortcuts on your home screen for fast access
Create app shortcuts to launch TV apps with a single tap
Mute on call automatically lowers or mutes TV volume during phone calls
Easy text input using your phone’s keyboard (available in TV apps that support on-screen keyboard input)

bluejetty:00185412:ios.description:
JOIN MILLIONS IN FINDING CALM
Need to relax? Relieve stress? Sleep Better? 
Feel the soothing magic of your fingers as they glide across the screen, creating beautiful patterns and helping you enter a deeper state of calm.
Heat Pad is one of the first and most successful relaxation app in the App Store. For over 15 years, it has brought calm to millions with its signature heat-sensitive surface simulation that helps relaxing through gentle finger movements and hypnotic visual effects. We are now taking your relaxation journey to the next level by offering guided meditations and mixable soundscapes.
Heat Pad has reach #1 spot in the App Store (US Top Overall) within its first week, and has more than 5 million users worldwide.
HEAT PAD FEATURES
HEAT-SENSITIVE SIMULATION
* Experience the calming effects of moving patterns that react to your fingers in real-time
* 150+ multi-touch surfaces reacting to your fingertips in 14 families: heat, haptic, ink, kaleidoscope, clouds, flow, stripes, coral, contour, ripples, neon and more
* Slowly moving your fingers on the screen helps you regain focus and release stress in minutes.
* Our signature relaxing feature since 2009
GUIDED MEDITATIONS
* 100+ carefully selected guided meditations and sleep stories
* Mindfulness topics include Anxiety Relief or Better Sleep
* Sorted by themes: Visualizations, Body Scans, Relaxation techniques, Morning boost
* First time meditating? We got you covered with our meditations for beginners
SLEEP STORIES
* The Story of Maggie: A busy woman who learns to slow down and appreciate life after an unexpected encounter
* Castle Journey: Embark on a serene visual journey driving through the Scottish countryside
* Cozy Cabin Sleep: Imagine a cozy cabin as you prepare for a restful night's sleep
* Sleepy Train Ride: A serene and calming train journey across the countryside
... and much more!
RELAXING MUSIC & SOUND
* Ever-growing selection of relaxing music
* Add relaxing sounds and create your own mix
* Rain, Birds, Ocean, Thunder, White or Brown Noise.
Subscription pricing and terms:
Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified. You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
Read more about our terms and conditions and privacy policy here: https://heatpad-pull.b-cdn.net/terms.html

bluejetty:00185062:ios.name: Neutron Music Player
bluejetty:00185062:ios.summary: Neutron Music Player is a high-resolution audio player powered by a 32/64-bit, OS and platform independent Neutron HiFi audio engine that bypasses standard OS audio limitations. Enjoy bit-perfect playback of all major audio formats (FLAC, D
bluejetty:00185062:ios.description:
Neutron Music Player is a high-resolution audio player powered by a 32/64-bit, OS and platform independent Neutron HiFi audio engine that bypasses standard OS audio limitations. Enjoy bit-perfect playback of all major audio formats (FLAC, DSD, ALAC, WAV, MP3, OPUS and more) through USB DACs, internal Hi-Res DACs and network renderers, with a full DSP and equalizer suite.
Built for audiophiles, headphone enthusiasts and anyone who wants better sound.
HI-RES AUDIO & DAC SUPPORT
• 32/64-bit HD audio processing, Hi-Res up to 32-bit, 3.072 MHz
* OS and platform independent decoding and audio processing
• Bit-perfect playback (when supported by hardware)
• Direct USB DAC output via USB OTG (up to 32-bit, 1.536 MHz)
• Native DSD (via DoP): DFF, DSF, ISO SACD/DVD, multichannel 2.1-7.1
• DSD to PCM decoding, real-time PCM to DSD (DSD64-DSD256), output all to DSD
• Chromecast output (up to 24-bit, 192 kHz) and UPnP/DLNA Media Renderer output (up to 24-bit, 768 kHz), no limit on format or DSP effects
EQUALIZER & DSP EFFECTS
• Parametric equalizer (PEQ): 4-130 bands, per channel
• Graphic EQ mode
• Frequency Response Correction (FRC): 5,000+ AutoEq presets for 2,500+ headphones, plus user-defined
• Adaptive Loudness Compensation (ALC)
• Surround sound (Ambiophonic RACE)
• Crossfeed for better stereo perception in headphones
• Compressor / Limiter
• Speaker delay (loudspeaker time alignment)
• Dithering, pitch and tempo, phase inversion
• Pseudo-stereo for mono tracks
• Subsonic and ultrasonic speaker protection filters
• Normalization by Peak and RMS (preamp gain calculated after DSP)
• High-quality real-time resampling
NETWORK & MEDIA SOURCES
• Supports iTunes library (non DRM) and local files (inside /Documents folder)
• SMB/CIFS (NAS or PC, Samba), UPnP/DLNA media servers, SFTP (SSH), FTP, WebDAV, Navidrome/Subsonic
• Built-in UPnP/DLNA Media Server and Media Renderer (gapless, DSP effects)
• Internet radio streaming (Icecast, Shoutcast, own streams)
• Manage your local music library through the internal FTP server
FORMATS, LIBRARY & PLAYBACK
• Supports all major audio formats: FLAC, ALAC, MP3, AAC, OGG, OPUS, WMA, APE, WavPack, MPC, WAV, AIFF, AC3 and more
• Module formats (MOD, IT, XM, S3M) and voice format SPEEX
• Playlists: CUE, M3U, PLS, ASX, RAM, XSPF, WPL, with full playlist management
• Synchronized and static lyrics (LRC files, metadata)
• AI-assisted generation of queues, EQ presets and FRC profiles with Google Gemini
• Large media library support, grouped by album, artist, album artist, composer, genre, year, rating and folder
• Folder mode and bookmarks
• Tempo/BPM analysis and categorization
• Tag editing: MP3, FLAC, OGG, APE, SPEEX, WAV, WV, M4A, MP4 (internal, SD, SMB, SFTP)
• ReplayGain, gapless playback and crossfade
• Playback modes: Shuffle, Loop, Single Track, Sequential, Queue, A-B Repeat
• Hardware and Preamp volume controls, Balance (L/R), Mono mode
• Real-time spectrum, waveform and RMS analyzers
• Profiles (multiple configurations)
• Clock mode, sleep and wake timers
• Customizable interface and themes, 16 languages
• CarPlay
SUPPORT & COMMUNITY
Get specifications, technical help, report issues or discuss features on the official website and forum.
