bluejetty:00174562:ios.description:
Bedtime Stories For Kids Sleep is an audio storybook app featuring short audiobooks, gentle bedtime stories, moral fairy tales, and soothing lullaby music for babies, toddlers, and children. These comforting stories help little ones reduce anxiety and fall asleep peacefully. Storytelling is a wonderful bedtime ritual, and our professional narrator ensures your child relaxes and drifts into restful sleep filled with sweet dreams. Listen to bedtime audiobooks every night to help your child fall asleep easily — baby lullabies are perfect for calming infants. Nighty night!
With the help of child psychologists and sleep consultants, we’ve developed a unique method to help children unwind and fall asleep naturally.
Simply play one of our audio fairy tales before bed — the captivating voice of our female storyteller brings each story to life, while the soft, rhythmic lullaby music and easy-to-follow text create a peaceful atmosphere. We guarantee your child will drift into a deep and peaceful sleep.
We are passionate about what we do, which is why we create only unique, high-quality content for children.
Benefits of the Bedtime Stories For Kids Sleep app:
* Professionally written and narrated stories
* Perfect duration for each calming story
* Expert storytelling
* Meditative lullabies
* Encourages deep, restful sleep
* 100% kid-safe content
* Short and engaging audiobooks
We all grew up listening to fairy tales that sparked our imaginations and taught valuable life lessons.
These beautifully crafted tales introduce children to themes of sharing, resilience, love, and kindness.
The Bedtime Stories For Kids Sleep app is a delightful collection of audiobooks designed to nurture empathy, inspire dreams, and encourage helping others.
Each calming story also supports the development of language skills, creativity, and imagination.
List of Bedtime Audiobooks, Soothing Storybooks, and Lullaby Music for Babies:
* The Cat Does Not Sleep
* Gift for the Moon
* Candy Land
* Find Your Rainbow
* Believe in Your Dream
* Good Deeds
* The Treehouse
* Star Friend
* Toy Story
* Thanks for the Help
* Dolphin’s Adventure
* Road to the Clouds
* Night Forest
* Where Is My House?
* Good Dreams
* Bedtime Meditation
* Festive Mood
* Lost Pajamas
* Max and Microbes
* Attentive Owlet
* Who Is Faster?
* Brave Friends
* Lion and Little Mouse
* Believing in Magic
* Ralph and His Fears
* A Prickly Friend
* (Coming soon)
These bedtime audiobooks are the perfect nighttime meditation for toddlers and babies.
Thank you for choosing the Bedtime Stories For Kids Sleep app. Enjoy soothing audiobooks and lullabies with your little ones. Sweet dreams to all sleepy infants, toddlers, and children. Good night and nighty night!

Securly Flex (formerly known as FlexTime Manager) lets you get more out of the instructional time in each school day by making it easy to add flex periods to your school schedule. Securly Flex is a scheduling tool designed specifically to solve these problems. Teachers can easily customize flex period offerings, and students gain voice and choice in their education. Provide more than a typical school experience. Teachers offer, students choose. With Securly Flex, you can:
• Combat learning loss by providing more opportunities for individualized support
• Give students time to develop their unique talents with personalized learning
• Support social and emotional development with more relaxing offerings, mindfulness activities, or counselor availability
• Prepare students for college and careers by providing opportunities to manage time and develop independence

bluejetty:00019235:ios.description:
This is the third game in the series with over one million downloads.
The puzzle has 999 levels and they are all free.
Playstyle is easy so you can enjoy a smooth gameplay.
It's a great game for killing time.
* Minesweeper Lv999's strong point
- The puzzle has 999 levels.
All of the levels are free to play.
There is no time limits so you can play as much or as little as you wish.
- Autosaving
There is a built in autosave function so you donft have to worry about losing the progress you made with your current puzzle. You can restart the puzzle any time you like.
- Flag mode
When you activate flag mode, it allows you to easily put down the flags without pressing and holding the square.
- Automatic square opening
When you have marked the squares with the buried mines, you can click one of the already opened squares to quickly open a large area of squares.
- Revive function
When you happen to open a square with a buried mine you can keep on playing the game by using your coins. This function is limited to three times per puzzle.
- Hide time count
The game includes a timer that shows how much time has elapsed since you started the puzzle. If you wish to play the puzzle without thinking about the time, the timer is easily hidden.
The timer can be hidden from the Options menu by switching the "Show time count" setting to off.
- can easily be played with just one hand
Because you can play it with one hand the game is easy to play on the go.
Minesweeper Lv999 was designed so that you can play it anytime and anywhere.
* What is Minesweeper
The goal of the game is to open all the squares that doesnft have any buried mines.
Itfs the same concept that has been used to make various board games over the years. 
* How to play Minesweeper
When you open a square there will be a number shown.
This number is an indicator that there is one or more mines next to the square.
Using the numbers as clues, search for the hidden mines.
If you think you found a square with a mine, use a flag to mark it.
When you have managed to open all the squares that donft have any mines, you have completed the puzzle.
Please enjoy this free game in order to challenge yourself during your free time!
In order to make "Minesweeper Lv999" free for everyone to use it relies on advertising.
Thank you for your understanding and please enjoy our application!

bluejetty:00140624:ios.description:
BXNG offers you short guided at-home boxing video lessons for learning new skills & improving techniques either for beginners or advanced. We’ve also added bodyweight cardio & strength workouts to help you build your physical and mental power, improve health & perfect your body.
No equipment needed.
Download the app and try BXNG with a FREE 3-days trial!
ALWAYS AT HAND
You can workout a routine that fits into your existing schedule, and though your usual routine isn’t disrupted, and you’re more likely to form a long-term habit. Boxing from home means you can learn boxing in the privacy and comfort of your home whenever it suits. 
NO EQUIPMENT
You don’t need any special equipment to learn boxing with BXNG. It is not the same as hitting a punching bag, but training the skills & shadowboxing is the essential part of professional training used to improve their technique. 
PERSONALIZED PLAN
Every day you get available a new boxing lesson and a strength workout. You move learning new skills according to the plan created by professional trainers depending on your boxing experience, fitness level, goals and schedule. You can manage your data and rebuild the plan if needed.
STEP-BY-STEP BOXING LEARNING FOR ALL LEVELS
Start from the basics if you're a beginner or improve your skills if advanced. The step-by-step boxing course covers either the fundamentals of boxing – punching, footwork, offensive and defensive moves, or the advanced combinations & masterclass -including multi-punch combos, boxing drills and best boxer's styles, tips&tricks.
EASY-TO-FOLLOW INSTRUCTIONS
Video guided lessons with detailed instructions on the proper techniques and common mistakes for you to be sure you do everything the right way! (to avoid any harm and get a greater effect from your workouts)
BOXING SIMULATOR
A unique tool for practicing & automating the learned skills or just for fun)
BODYWEIGHT FITNESS WORKOUTS
Short but effective bodyweight workouts based on professional boxer’s routines to help you get in a lean fighting shape together with mastering the skills. Follow your plan or choose any workout in the Explore Section.
FAVOURITES
Save & repeat the items you loved or simply save the unfinished workout to come back to later! The Favorites section allows you to manage and access your favorite lessons and workouts whenever you like. 
FREE TRIAL
Download the app and try BXNG with a FREE 3-days trial! iTunes will only charge you after 3 days trial.
SUBSCRIPTION & TERMS
Start BXNG with a 3-days Free Trial and get a full access to your personal learning plan and workouts. The ongoing use requires any active subscription: monthly or annual. 
For your convenience, BXNG subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period. There is no increase in price when renewing. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your iTunes account settings. Please note, that you would not be able to use app features without active subscription.
GET ALL THE BODY & MIND BENEFITS OF BOXING WITH BXNG APP!
- Boxing improves health: it normalizes metabolism, hormone levels, strengthens bones, and even increases libido.
- Boxing helps you quickly lose weight: in one workout, you spend up to 1000 kcal.
- Boxing helps to cope with stress: due to endorphins production, your mood after the training rises, while the level of aggressiveness and irritability decreases.
- Boxing provides better sleep quality: after training your body is worn out physically and your mind is clear.
NOTE! If you have any injuries or health concerns, please contact a medical practitioner for advice before starting any workouts.

https://bxng.online/en/privacy/

bluejetty:00060759:ios.description:
Tap and Play - This links the text to the audio. You can now search for a quote, highlight it, and then press a button to start playing at that location!
Read Along - Read Along scrolls the page as needed to keep the text on the page as the audio is playing.
Highlights and Notes - You can assign your highlights to more than one category. For example, a Quote that you would like to remember about the influence of music on young people could be tagged in many categories like Children, Influence, and Music. You do not have to choose the “best” category to store the highlight in. Later when you are researching any of those subjects, that quote is not missing.
Subtitle - Subtitle is a Read Along mode that has been formatted to appear as large as possible on the screen with as few distractions as possible. One of its designed uses would be in a church for the projection of the text as you are listening to the sermon. Many Tablets support adapters that allow an external monitor or projector to mirror the display. This allows many people to view the screen at the same time. The Subtitle viewer also works well if you need larger text to read. This feature will really shine as we start adding foreign languages to the app in the future.

bluejetty:00084610:ios.description:
flomo is the Next Generation note-taking tool, focusing on helping your record more ideas rather than complex articles. 
We are overjoyed to announce that we ranked in the No.4 of the Golden Kitty Awards 2021 on Product Hunt in the Mobile Apps category. 
Thank you for your support and suggestions. We can’t keep making progress without your voice.
Key features
- Easy typing like Twitter
- Full platform sync
- Manage MEMOs by #tags/sub-tags
- Daily review of past MEMOs
- Relevant MEMOs
- Quantify daily records
- Quick entry with API
- No ads or privacy sharing
What flomo doesn't do well
We know it's hard enough to be good at one small thing, so we won't try to be ALL-IN-ONE in features.
Here's what we're NOT good at, and we recommend you to choose a better product.
- Not good at Document writing or markdown
- Not good at Web Clipper
- Not good at TODO 
- Not good at Mind mapping
flomo CARES about privacy and security
- All content is only visible to you
- All data transfers are encrypted
- No commercial advertising
- No sharing or selling of personal data
- Real-time database backup

bluejetty:00132088:ios.summary:

RiverApp gives you access to one of the world’s most comprehensive hydrometric datasets, with data from over 40,000
bluejetty:00132088:ios.description:
Get quick access to the latest river levels, flows and conditions across the US and more than 20 other countries worldwide.
RiverApp gives you access to one of the world’s most comprehensive hydrometric datasets, with data from over 40,000 monitoring stations.
Whether you kayak, canoe, packraft, paddleboard, fly fish, surf rivers, manage irrigation, operate hydropower infrastructure or monitor flood risk, RiverApp helps you stay informed with reliable, easy-to-read river data.
FREE FEATURES
‣ Current water levels and flows for over 20,000 rivers
‣ Water temperature data where available
‣ Detailed maps of hydrometric stations and whitewater sections
‣ Custom alerts for each station when a defined level or flow is reached
‣ Favourite stations and whitewater sections for quick access to the latest readings and conditions
FREE FEATURES FOR WHITEWATER SPORTS
‣ More than 4,000 referenced whitewater sections
‣ Section conditions based on current water level or flow
‣ Detailed section maps with quick access to put-in and take-out points
‣ Hazards, rapids and other points of interest, including photos where available
‣ Information on difficulty, length and average gradient
‣ Community-based addition and editing of whitewater sections
RIVERAPP PREMIUM
Unlock additional tools for deeper river monitoring and trip planning:
‣ Historical water level and flow data going back several years
‣ Forecasts for selected stations
‣ Satellite map layers from multiple providers, with comparison tools
‣ Customizable Home Screen Widgets to keep your favourite river gauges visible at a glance
‣ Monthly streamflow statistics to understand seasonal variations and plan river trips at the right time and place
DATA SOURCES
RiverApp brings together data from over 100 official and public hydrometric sources worldwide, including, among others:
NVE
California Data Exchange Center
Government of Canada — Wateroffice
USGS
NOAA
PEGELONLINE — www.pegelonline.wsv.de
HVZ Baden-Württemberg
HDN Bayern
Kanton Bern

Český hydrometeorologický ústav
HVZ Sachsen-Anhalt
Land Salzburg
Scottish Environment Protection Agency
Slovak Hydrometeorological Institute
Agencija Republike Slovenije za okolje
HWZ Steiermark
BAFU
HNZ Thüringen
Land Tirol
Shoothill
Vigicrues
Serveur de données hydrométriques temps réel du bassin Rhône-Méditerranée
Land Vorarlberg
Bureau of Meteorology — Australia

bluejetty:00029755:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00029755:ios.description:
Schengen Simple answers the key question that other apps don't: what's the longest I can travel on any given date without jeopardising a future trip or breaking the 90/180 rule?
Here's an example. Say you have a trip next week and another in 2 months, and you want to add one in between. Schengen Simple tells you exactly how long that middle trip can be without causing an overstay.
You'll always know how long you can travel while ensuring you can still take every trip in your calendar.
FEATURES
- No need to nominate a date of entry. Schengen Simple analyses your full trip calendar at once, so you always know how long you can travel on any date without affecting trips you've already planned.
- Multi-traveller support. Track Schengen allowance for your whole family or travel group in one app, each with their own calendar and calculations.
- Passport Control mode displays exactly how long you've been in the Schengen Area in a given 180-day period.
- See your allowance under every date in the calendar, so you can spot when it changes and plan accordingly. Often, waiting a few days gives you a longer stay. 
- Allowance Analysis. Easily probe why your allowance is what it is for a given date, so you know which trips you could edit to stay longer.
- Personalised customer support. Questions about your trips or the rules? Get a real reply from a real person.
- The Schengen Simple algorithm is thoroughly tested, including against the official EU calculator, so you can fully trust its calculations.
- Clear, simple and easy to use. Even calculators deserve beautiful design.
PRICING
Get started with a one-week free trial, after which an annual subscription gives you full access to all features. Prices vary by country.
Your subscription supports ongoing updates as Schengen rules evolve, personalised support from a real person when you need it, and we'll never sell your data or show ads.
Try Schengen Simple for free, with no obligation to continue. We think you'll love it.
Privacy Policy: https://schengensimple.com/privacy-policy 
Terms of Use: https://schengensimple.com/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00090717:ios.name: Metro Transit
bluejetty:00090717:ios.summary: Make transit trips in the Minneapolis/St. Paul metro area as mobile as you are with the official Metro Transit app. Now you can plan your trip, see departure information for buses and trains, and buy transit tickets all on the go! Just down
bluejetty:00090717:ios.description:
Make transit trips in the Minneapolis/St. Paul metro area as mobile as you are with the official Metro Transit app. Now you can plan your trip, see departure information for buses and trains, and buy transit tickets all on the go! Just download the free app, create an account with your method of payment, and get moving.
The Metro Transit app is a tool to make riding the bus, METRO system and Northstar in the Twin Cities a little bit easier. After you’ve identified your desired trip and transit departure time, you can buy and use Metro Transit mobile tickets right from your smartphone – it’s like having a ticket machine right in your pocket!
KEY FEATURES:
Find the right bus, light rail, or train for you through the Trip Planner.
See the next available bus, light rail, or train for your desired trip with NexTrip.
Pay a single fare or multiple fares for a group of riders, and store multiple tickets on your phone for future use.
Simply create an account and enter your credit/debit card information in our secure system.
If you’re looking to pay with cash, you can use a pre-paid debit card or pre-paid gift card.
HOW IT WORKS:
1. SELECT RIDER TYPE: Adult, Senior/Youth/Medicare, Mobility, Family
2. SELECT SERVICE: Local Bus/METRO, Express Bus, or Northstar
3. SELECT: Station for Northstar or time-based fare for Bus/METRO
4. CHECKOUT: Pay with Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover, pre-paid debit or gift card, or Apple Pay
COMMON QUESTIONS:
Do I need to be connected?
An internet connection is required create an account, sign-in and purchase and activate tickets.
What if my battery dies?
Just like with paper tickets, you're responsible for making sure you have a valid fare at all times, so be sure to plan ahead!
IMPORTANT REMINDERS:
• Activate your ticket when you see your bus or train approaching. Your ticket must be activated before boarding a vehicle.
• Watch your battery level... Just like with paper tickets, you're responsible for making sure you have a valid fare at all times.

bluejetty:00024322:ios.description:
Welcome to Bingo Wild!
Embark on a wild bingo adventure! Explore exciting destinations, join live bingo tournaments, and discover a world filled with amazing animals. Start your journey with Leo the Lion and see where the adventure takes you next!
Bingo Wild combines classic 75-ball bingo with special bingo cards, exciting challenges, collectible puzzles, and fun mini-games. Whether you enjoy classic bingo or competing in live tournaments, there is always something new to explore.
1. BINGO CARDS
TWO TYPES OF CARDS: Enjoy classic bingo cards and special bingo cards with unique gameplay experiences. Play classic 75-ball bingo and explore 13 different ways to win.
CHOOSE YOUR CARDS: Play with 1, 2, or 4 bingo cards at a time. Choose your preferred challenge and test your bingo skills!
POWER-UPS: Use 7 different power-ups to enhance your bingo experience. Earn power-ups through gameplay and use them to help you complete your cards.
JIGSAW PUZZLES: Collect puzzle pieces as you play bingo. Complete jigsaw puzzles, discover new pictures, and enjoy additional in-game challenges.
2. DAILY ACTIVITIES & REWARDS
DAILY BONUS: Visit Bingo Wild every day to collect in-game coins and continue your bingo adventure.
LUCKY SCRATCH: Enjoy the Lucky Scratch mini-game during your play sessions and discover what’s waiting for you.
QUICKTAP LOTTO: Try QuickTap Lotto for a chance to collect additional in-game coins.
EGG SMASH: Complete challenges, collect hammers, and crack open silver and golden eggs to discover in-game rewards.
WELCOME BACK REWARDS: Return to Bingo Wild to collect coins, gems, and other in-game rewards.
3. WILD GALLERY
Discover the Wild Gallery as you progress through your bingo adventure. Collect photos while playing bingo, unlock new gallery items, and complete your collection. Keep exploring to discover more animals and memorable moments along the way!
4. LIVE BINGO TOURNAMENTS
Join the Royal League and compete in real-time bingo tournaments with players from around the world. Follow your ranking, take on new challenges, and see how you perform against other bingo players.
5. EXPLORE THE WORLD OF BINGO WILD
Travel through animal-themed destinations, enjoy classic bingo gameplay, collect puzzle pieces, and take part in fun mini-games. Every session brings another opportunity to explore and progress.
Follow Bingo Wild for the latest news and updates:
https://www.facebook.com/Bingo-Wild-107779441087989

Bingo Wild is a free bingo game to play, but you can make in-app purchases with real money.

apple-macos:6478506272.name: Grab HD Video Frames - VidGrab
apple-macos:6478506272.description:
VidGrab – Save Perfect Frames From Video
Turn any video into high-quality still images in seconds. VidGrab makes it easy to scrub through your videos frame by frame, save the exact moment you want, and enhance it with AI upscaling up to 4K.
Whether it's action shots, sports clips, slow-motion moments, or the perfect freeze frame, VidGrab gives you precise control with a simple, focused workflow.
VidGrab is free to download and use. Some features are limited on the free plan, and an optional Premium subscription (auto-renewing, purchased in-app) unlocks everything — details below.
Two Powerful Views
Player View
• Play and pause video smoothly
• Skip forward or back 1 frame at a time
• Jump 5 frames for faster navigation
• Save the exact frame you see
All Frames View
• Instantly view every frame in the video
• Pinch to zoom between 2, 3, and 4 columns
• Scroll and select the best shots
• Save multiple frames quickly
4K AI Upscaler (Premium)
• Enhance any frame — or any photo from your library — with AI
• Upscale up to 4K for crystal-clear detail
• Compare original and upscaled side by side before saving
Features
• Save high-quality frames from any video
• Frame-accurate controls for precision
• Simple, distraction-free interface
• Export images in full resolution
• Perfect for sports, action, creators, and highlights
Free vs Premium
VidGrab is a free app with in-app purchases. Here's exactly what you get:
Free
• Save a limited number of frames
• Exports include a small VidGrab watermark
• Browse and preview every frame with no limits
Premium (auto-renewing subscription)
• Unlimited frame saves

apple-itunes:543364901.description:
Trusted by millions of iOS users around the world and hailed by meteorology fans, Weather 14 Days is the official free App from Meteored. Fully optimized for iOS 27, iPadOS 27 and watchOS 27, the app is available for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch. Featuring its own forecasts produced and weather alerts, using the best prediction model in the world. You will have an accurate weather forecast and you can enjoy a modern and original layout based around Liquid Glass to access detailed and highly accurate local weather data quicker and easier than ever before. With over 20 years of forecasting experience, we won't let the weather surprise you.
- ALERTS AND NOTIFICATIONS -
Receive Official Weather Warnings from NOAA (National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration) for your location live thanks to our notifications and daily alerts. We send alerts about any weather phenomenon: rain, storms, temperatures, wind, hurricanes, and tropical storms, as well as severe weather forecasts.
- REALTIME RADAR, FORECAST MAPS AND SATELLITES -
Now available! A new animated world forecast map based on the ECMWF showing the weather forecast for the coming days. Enjoy our live radar service and also our hurricane tracker and storm, access animated weather radar of the last few hours provided by the NWS along with visible, infrared and water vapor satellite images provided by NOAA.
- WEATHER NEWS -
Check the new section of our news to be up to date of the latest weather events. Be informed about trending topics and the most recent forecast. You will learn about the weather phenomena thanks to our science articles, made by our experts in meteorology.
- WEATHER VIDEOS -
Discover videos of impactful weather phenomena, along with exclusive scientific content to help you understand the atmosphere and the weather.
- WEATHER FORECAST -
Check the current conditions along with the forecast for the next 14 days with a simple slide of your finger. Select a day to view detailed hourly information including heat index or temperature, precipitation, wind speed and direction, wind chill, pressure, cloudiness, humidity, UV index, sunset and sunrise times and even the phase of the moon.
- WIDGETS -
Use our widget to see at a glance the current time and detailed summary of the week in your favorite city.
- SHARE -
Share weather forecasts with your friends and family anytime you want with whatever device or social network you like to use such as: WhatsApp, Twitter or Facebook.
- AVAILABILITY -
Find the forecast most relevant to your exact current position or search for your favorite locations from over 6,000,000 all around the world. Available in over 110 countries and 50 languages.
